Wir suchen erfahrene IT-Experten mit fundierten Kenntnissen in Microsoft Workplace / Endpoint Technologien. Zudem solltest du Spaß an der Betreuung und Weiterentwicklung von Kundenumgebungen haben, da dies einer der Schwerpunkte der Rolle sein wird.

| WHOM WE ARE LOOKING FOR

* Technische Ausbildung: Du hast eine abgeschlossene technische Ausbildung im IT-Bereich.

* Modern Workplace-Expertise: Du verfügst über fundierte Kenntnisse in Intune & Configuration Manager für Endpoint Management.

* Systemkompetenz: Du bist versiert in OS- & Application Management, Inventory- & Patch-Management für Windows, iOS, macOS & Android.

* Kommunikationsstärke: Du bist ein Teamplayer mit ausgeprägter Kommunikationsfähigkeit und hoher Kunden- und Lösungsorientierung.

* Eigenverantwortung: Du arbeitest verantwortungsbewusst, genau, strukturiert und eigenverantwortlich.

jobs.title: Senior DevOps / Platform Engineer - GCP
jobs.description:
Headquarters: Cyprus
URL: http://gomining.com

Description

We are looking for a Senior DevOps / Platform Engineer to develop and operate GoMining's cloud platform.

The primary focus of this role is GCP and Kubernetes, infrastructure and application delivery automation, and the reliability and security of production services.

You will maintain and improve our existing infrastructure, contribute to the development of the next generation of our platform, and help product teams ship changes safely and efficiently.


Responsibilities

  • Develop and operate infrastructure in GCP, including GKE, virtual machines, networking, load balancers, storage, and managed services.
  • Manage Infrastructure as Code with Terraform: develop modules, manage state and dependencies, ensure reproducible changes, and identify configuration drift.
  • Operate Kubernetes: upgrade clusters and platform components, configure autoscaling, workload placement, network policies, and resource allocation.
  • Develop CI/CD and GitOps using GitLab CI and Flux / Argo CD, automating builds, checks, deployments, controlled releases, and rollbacks.
  • Build observability across metrics, logs, distributed tracing, and actionable alerting. Define and improve SLIs/SLOstogether with engineering teams.
  • Troubleshoot production incidents and performance issues, conduct root cause analysis, and eliminate recurring failure patterns.
  • Implement least-privilege access, environment and service isolation, secure secrets management and rotation, and infrastructure audit controls.
  • Maintain backup processes and regularly validate recovery of critical data and infrastructure according to agreed RPO/RTO.
  • Help engineering teams prepare services for production, including health checks, resource configuration, telemetry, and deployment procedures.
  • Optimize cloud infrastructure usage and costs while maintaining reliability requirements.
  • Maintain infrastructure documentation, operational runbooks, and recovery procedures.


Requirements
  • Strong hands-on experience independently operating production infrastructure and Kubernetes, including upgrades, troubleshooting, and disaster recovery.
  • Strong experience with GCP, including GKE, Compute Engine, VPC, IAM, and Cloud Storage; good understanding of Cloud SQL, Cloud Logging, and Cloud Monitoring.
  • Hands-on experience with Terraform, including modules, remote state, locking, importing existing resources, and safely applying infrastructure changes through CI.
  • Deep knowledge of Kubernetes and containerization: Deployments, StatefulSets, Services, Ingress, storage, requests/limits, probes, autoscaling, RBAC, and NetworkPolicy.
  • Experience with Helm and Kustomize.
  • Strong Linux administration skills, preferably Debian/Ubuntu: processes, systemd, filesystems, disks, and resource troubleshooting.
  • Strong networking fundamentals: TCP/IP, DNS, HTTP(S), TLS, routing, NAT, load balancing, and firewalls.
  • Ability to troubleshoot connectivity issues across applications, Kubernetes clusters, networks, and cloud services.
  • Experience building CI/CD pipelines, preferably with GitLab CI, and strong understanding of Git and GitOps principles.
  • Understanding of runner permissions, secrets protection, and production deployment controls.
  • Automation skills with Bash and Python, including maintainable infrastructure scripts and API integrations.
  • Experience with monitoring, logging, and alerting using tools such as Prometheus, Grafana, or Cloud Monitoring.
  • Practical experience operating PostgreSQL and understanding Redis and RabbitMQ, including availability, connections, replication or clustering, backup, and recovery.
  • Strong understanding of cloud security principles: least privilege, service accounts, Workload Identity, secrets management, network segmentation, and access auditing.
  • Ability to independently deliver infrastructure changes to a validated production result, explain technical trade-offs, and collaborate effectively with Engineering and Security teams.

Nice to Have

  • Experience with Flux CD, Argo CD, Ansible, and HashiCorp Vault.
  • Experience with OpenTelemetry and distributed tracing.
  • Experience migrating infrastructure between clouds or Kubernetes clusters, including database migrations with limited downtime.
  • Experience designing disaster recovery strategies and conducting recovery exercises.
  • Cloud cost optimization and capacity planning experience.
  • Experience with DigitalOcean, Hetzner, or AWS.
  • Ability to read and troubleshoot JavaScript / TypeScript applications.
  • Experience operating financial or payment services with strict requirements around access control, auditing, reliability, and data integrity.


Benefits
  • Professional growth: support for courses, conferences, and English learning (up to 100% coverage).
  • Work-life fit: remote or hybrid format with flexible hours across international teams.
  • Paid leave: up to 20 vacation days +  8 company holidays + 5 personal days per year
  • Recognition programs: structured performance reviews and team awards.
  • Team culture: retreats in international locations (for example, company apartments in Cyprus).

To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/gomining-senior-devops-platform-engineer-gcp

jobs.title: Senior DevOps Engineer (DHDP)
jobs.description:
Headquarters: Armenia, Georgia, Kazakhstan, Kyrgyzstan, Ukraine, Uzbekistan
URL: http://epam.com

We are looking for a Senior DevOps Engineer to support the Digital Health Data Platform (DHDP) by driving CI/CD, infrastructure automation, deployment, environment configuration, monitoring, and operational support across DEV, QA, PRE-PROD, and PROD. In this role, you will work closely with Data Engineering, Data Architecture, Cloud/Infrastructure, Security, and QA teams to ensure DHDP changes are deployed securely, consistently, and according to established architecture, security, and change-management requirements.

Responsibilities

  • Design and maintain CI/CD pipelines across DHDP environments
  • Automate deployment and controlled promotion across DEV, QA, PRE-PROD, and PROD
  • Maintain environment-specific deployment configuration and parameters
  • Ensure deployments are version-controlled, repeatable, traceable, and auditable
  • Troubleshoot deployment and pipeline failures
  • Develop and maintain Infrastructure as Code, preferably using Terraform, to automate provisioning and configuration of DHDP Azure resources
  • Maintain reusable infrastructure modules and minimize configuration drift
  • Support DHDP services including Azure Databricks, ADLS Gen2, Key Vault, Event Hubs, PostgreSQL, Cosmos DB integrations, Monitor / Log Analytics, and Purview components
  • Collaborate with Cloud teams on networking, DNS, Private Endpoints, and shared infrastructure
  • Automate deployment of Databricks jobs, workflows, notebooks, data pipelines, and configuration, and implement and maintain Databricks Asset Bundles
  • Support compute and Unity Catalog configuration, as well as Service Principals and Managed Identities used for Databricks automation
  • Integrate CI/CD with Microsoft Entra ID, Managed Identities, Service Principals, and Azure Key Vault, applying least-privilege principles to deployment identities
  • Ensure credentials and secrets are securely managed and not stored in source code
  • Support automation of DHDP access-control configuration where applicable
  • Maintain deployment consistency across all DHDP environments and support release promotion, configuration validation, rollback, and recovery
  • Ensure production data and credentials remain isolated from non-production environments
  • Support DHP/DHDP change-control processes and maintain deployment evidence
  • Implement monitoring and alerting using Azure Monitor and Log Analytics, and monitor Databricks jobs, deployments, and infrastructure
  • Troubleshoot operational issues and support root-cause analysis
  • Maintain Git-based development and Pull Request workflows

Requirements

  • 3+ years of experience as a DevOps Engineer, with hands-on expertise in Microsoft Azure, Azure DevOps / GitHub CI/CD, and Terraform / Infrastructure as Code
  • Experience with Azure Databricks and Databricks Asset Bundles
  • Proficiency in Git and Pull Request workflows
  • Knowledge of Azure Key Vault, Microsoft Entra ID, Managed Identities, and Service Principals
  • Familiarity with Azure Monitor / Log Analytics, Azure networking, and Private Endpoints
  • Skills in PowerShell, Bash, and/or Python
  • Understanding of multi-environment deployment and cloud security practices
  • Proficiency in English at a B2+ level

Nice to have

  • Experience with Unity Catalog, ADLS Gen2, and PostgreSQL
  • Familiarity with Cosmos DB and Event Hubs
  • Knowledge of Microsoft Purview and Power BI integration

To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/epam-systems-senior-devops-engineer-dhdp

jobs.title: Staff DevOps Engineer
jobs.description:
Headquarters: Czechia
URL: http://bloomreach.com

Bloomreach is building the world’s premier agentic platform for personalization.We’re revolutionizing how businesses connect with their customers, building and deploying AI agents to personalize the entire customer journey.
  • We're taking autonomous search mainstream, making product discovery more intuitive and conversational for customers, and more profitable for businesses.
  • We’re making conversational shopping a reality, connecting every shopper with tailored guidance and product expertise — available on demand, at every touchpoint in their journey.
  • We're designing the future of autonomous marketing, taking the work out of workflows, and reclaiming the creative, strategic, and customer-first work marketers were always meant to do.
And we're building all of that on the intelligence of a single AI engine — Loomi — so that personalization isn't only autonomous…it's also consistent.From retail to financial services, hospitality to gaming, businesses use Bloomreach to drive higher growth and lasting loyalty. We power personalization for more than 1,400 global brands, including American Eagle, Sonepar, and Pandora.

Are you looking for a cutting-edge tech stack to work with daily? We are currently expanding our Infrastructure team and are looking for a new colleague to join as a Staff DevOps / Infrastructure Engineer. You can work from home or one of our Central Europe offices (Bratislava, Brno, Prague) on a full-time basis. The base salary range for this position is 1 520 000 - 1 900 000 CZK. The pay range actually offered will take into account a variety of potential factors considered in compensation, including but not limited to skills, qualifications, geographic location, accomplishments, experience, credentials, internal equity and business needs, and may vary from the range listed above. Are you ready to grow with us?

What tech stack do we have for you?

  • Kubernetes (GKE), Terraform, GitLab
  • Google Cloud, including a wide range of managed products such as Cloud SQL, BigQuery, Bigtable, Dataflow, and Pub/Sub
  • Self-hosted stack: MongoDB, Kafka, Elasticsearch, Etcd, Victoria Metrics, InfluxDB, Sentry
  • Python, Golang

Minimum requirements:

At least 5 years of production experience with:

  • Kubernetes - we are looking for an engineer who not only deploys applications to a cluster, but also understands what is happening behind the scenes and can operate 24x7 production
  • GCP (preferred)/AWS/Azure - our solution is built on top of the GCP platform. Candidate should be comfortable working with public cloud, understand the risks and benefits associated with running applications in the public cloud, be familiar with infrastructure as a code principle, and have the ability to make design choices between using cloud-managed solutions versus self-hosted alternatives
  • Python/Go - you should be able to read and understand code with confidence, and to review and evaluate AI-generated Python code for correctness, security, and fit. Hands-on coding skills matter less than before, but you should still be able to develop custom tooling when needed, with or without AI assistance

 

If you don’t meet these requirements, don’t worry; take a look at the Senior DevOps position - Czechia: https://job-boards.greenhouse.io/bloomreach/jobs/8329244, Slovakia: https://job-boards.greenhouse.io/bloomreach/jobs/8329243

 

How to know if you are a good fit:

The qualifications outlined below serve as a guide to determine if your skills and experience align with the requirements of this position:

  • Design and Specification: You turn loosely defined problems into designs and specifications that others can execute. You write design proposals, weigh trade-offs between managed and self-hosted solutions, and review the designs of others.
  • Cross-team Leadership: You have led projects spanning multiple teams, from scoping and planning through delivery, coordinating engineers who do not report to you.
  • Independent Delivery: You take a specified maintenance or project task and drive it to completion on your own. AI assistants are a given part of your toolkit, but you always understand and can explain how and why every change was made.
  • AI as a Tool, Not a Replacement: You use AI assistants to work faster, not to hand your work over. You understand what the AI produced, question and verify it, and steer it toward the outcome you want rather than accepting whatever it gives you. You stay in control and remain accountable for everything you ship.
  • Continuous Learning: You have a keen interest in Kubernetes and related technologies, as demonstrated by your active engagement in reading and staying up to date on them.
  • Conference Participation: You have participated in DevOps-related conferences, showcasing your commitment to continuous learning and networking in the field.
  • Configuration Proficiency: You have hands-on experience configuring pod/container security context, network policies, roles and role bindings, pod affinity, host path, pod disruption budgets, priority classes, node taints, to name a few.
  • Resource Optimization: You have analyzed resource usage of applications hosted on a cluster and implemented or suggested changes to resource requests/limits, Horizontal Pod Autoscalers (HPAs), or Vertical Pod Autoscalers (VPAs).
  • Cluster Management: You have a deep understanding of the clusters you manage, including the types of machines used in node pools, the reasons for their selection, which cluster features are enabled or disabled, the cluster version, and the node autoscaling configuration. You have successfully upgraded the Kubernetes cluster versions without interrupting live applications hosted on the cluster.
  • Terraform Proficiency: You have written a Terraform module with multiple interconnected resources.
  • Monitoring and Alerting: You have experience setting up monitoring systems and configuring alerts. On-duty experience is preferred, along with experience with Grafana and Prometheus.
  • DevOps and CI/CD Experience: You have experience with DevOps, Orchestration/Configuration Management, and Continuous Integration technologies, including Terraform, GitLab, Ansible, and Docker.
  • Team Onboarding and Training: You have experience with onboarding and training new team members, demonstrating your leadership skills and commitment to team growth.

About your team:

The Infrastructure team operates and maintains Bloomreach Engagement core infrastructure built on Google Cloud with security, high availability, costs, and scalability in mind. Our vision is to identify and implement opportunities to achieve a robust, reliable, and efficient infrastructure and development platform. We strongly support DevOps culture: each team is responsible for releasing, operating, and monitoring their own applications.

The role of the Infrastructure Team is to provide a strong foundation upon which all teams can build, for example, manage big infrastructure components like Kubernetes, databases, and cloud components in Google Cloud. An important role of the team is also to provide support to developers, review design proposals, validate the performance and availability of applications, and sometimes even develop new core application components such as logging or authorization.

Tasks and responsibilities:

In the position of Staff DevOps Engineer, you’d be expected to work with other Engineering teams to design sustainable infrastructure, microservice solutions, and an efficient and robust production environment. Additionally, you’ll be working on a variety of tasks and projects, including automating tools and infrastructure to reduce manual work, monitoring applications and participating in an on-call rotation as required.

You’ll own the design and specification of infrastructure initiatives, break them down into tasks the team can execute, and lead projects that span multiple engineering teams. AI assistants are a given part of your toolkit, and you retain full understanding of, and responsibility for, what gets shipped.

The ideal candidate will be passionate about learning new things, creative, willing to take the initiative, and able to think outside the box to solve problems strategically.

#LI-KP1

More things you'll like about Bloomreach:

Culture:

  • A great deal of freedom and trust. At Bloomreach we don’t clock in and out, and we have neither corporate rules nor long approval processes. This freedom goes hand in hand with responsibility. We are interested in results from day one. 
  • We have defined our 5 values and the 10 underlying key behaviors that we strongly believe in. We can only succeed if everyone lives these behaviors day to day. We've embedded them in our processes like recruitment, onboarding, feedback, personal development, performance review and internal communication. 
  • We believe in flexible working hours to accommodate your working style.
  • We work virtual-first with several Bloomreach Hubs available across three continents.
  • We organize company events to experience the global spirit of the company and get excited about what's ahead.
  • We encourage and support our employees to engage in volunteering activities - every Bloomreacher can take 5 paid days off to volunteer*.
  • The Bloomreach Glassdoor page elaborates on our stellar 4.7/5 rating. The Bloomreach Comparably page Culture score is even higher at 4.9/5

Personal Development:

  • We have a People Development Program - participating in personal development workshops on various topics run by experts from inside the company. We are continuously developing & updating competency maps for select functions.
  • Our resident communication coach Ivo Večeřa is available to help navigate work-related communications & decision-making challenges.*
  • Our managers are strongly encouraged to participate in the Leader Development Program to develop in the areas we consider essential for any leader. The program includes regular comprehensive feedback, consultations with a coach and follow-up check-ins.
  • Bloomreachers utilize the $1,500 professional education budget on an annual basis to purchase education products (books, courses, certifications, etc.)*

Well-being:

  • The Employee Assistance Program -- with counselors -- is available for non-work-related challenges.*
  • Subscription to Calm - sleep and meditation app.*
  • We organize ‘DisConnect’ days where Bloomreachers globally enjoy one additional day off each quarter, allowing us to unwind together and focus on activities away from the screen with our loved ones.
  • We facilitate sports, yoga, and meditation opportunities for each other.
  • Extended parental leave up to 26 calendar weeks for Primary Caregivers.*

Compensation:

  • Restricted Stock Units or Stock Options are granted depending on a team member’s role, seniority, and location.*
  • Everyone gets to participate in the company's success through the company performance bonus.*
  • We offer an employee referral bonus of up to $3,000!
  • We reward & celebrate work anniversaries -- Bloomversaries!*

(*Subject to employment type. Interns are exempt from marked benefits, usually for the first 6 months.)

Excited? Join us and transform the future of commerce experiences!

If this position doesn't suit you, but you know someone who might be a great fit, share it - we will be very grateful!

Any unsolicited resumes/candidate profiles submitted through our website or to personal email accounts of employees of Bloomreach are considered property of Bloomreach and are not subject to payment of agency fees.

#LI-Remote

To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/bloomreach-staff-devops-engineer

jobs.title: Director of Content Strategy
jobs.description:
Headquarters: Remote
URL: http://wevote.us

Help Shape How Millions of Voters Engage with Reliable Civic Information

WeVote is a nonpartisan civic technology nonprofit dedicated to increasing voter participation through innovative digital tools and trusted voter education resources. As a Fast Forward nonprofit technology grantee, WeVote empowers voters with the information they need to make informed decisions and participate confidently in democracy.

We are seeking a strategic and innovative Director of Content Strategy to lead the development and execution of WeVote's content vision across digital channels. This volunteer leadership role is ideal for an experienced content strategist, communications leader, digital marketer, or media professional who is passionate about civic engagement and audience growth.

As Director of Content Strategy, you will define how WeVote communicates with voters, volunteers, supporters, and stakeholders through impactful content initiatives. You will oversee content planning, messaging strategy, editorial priorities, audience engagement efforts, and cross-functional collaboration to expand WeVote's reach and influence.

What You'll Do

Develop Content Strategy

Create and lead a comprehensive content strategy that aligns with WeVote's mission, organizational goals, audience needs, and voter engagement objectives.

Drive Audience Growth & Engagement

Identify opportunities to expand audience reach, increase engagement, and strengthen relationships with voters, volunteers, donors, and supporters through strategic content initiatives.

Lead Content Planning

Oversee content roadmaps, editorial calendars, and campaign planning across blogs, newsletters, voter education resources, thought leadership content, and digital communications.

Shape Organizational Messaging

Develop messaging frameworks and content guidelines that ensure consistency across all channels while reinforcing WeVote's nonpartisan mission and brand voice.

Collaborate Across Teams

Partner with leaders across Product, Political Data, Communications, Marketing, Partnerships, and Volunteer Recruitment to identify content opportunities and align messaging efforts.

Analyze Content Performance

Monitor content effectiveness, audience behavior, engagement metrics, and communication trends to continuously improve content strategy and impact.

Lead Content Contributors

Provide strategic guidance and leadership to volunteer writers, editors, researchers, content creators, and communications team members.

Support Thought Leadership Initiatives

Help position WeVote as a trusted leader in civic technology, voter education, and democratic participation through compelling storytelling and content innovation.

What We're Looking For

Content Strategy Experience

3+ years of experience in content strategy, communications, digital marketing, content leadership, audience development, media, publishing, or related fields.

Strategic Thinking

Demonstrated ability to create and execute content strategies that drive awareness, engagement, audience growth, and organizational impact.

Audience & Engagement Expertise

Experience understanding audience needs, developing content journeys, and optimizing content performance across digital channels.

Strong Communication Skills

Exceptional writing, editing, messaging, and storytelling abilities with the ability to translate complex topics into clear, accessible content.

Data-Informed Decision Making

Comfortable using content analytics, engagement insights, and performance metrics to guide strategic decisions.

Cross-Functional Leadership

Experience collaborating with diverse stakeholders and managing projects across multiple teams and initiatives.

Mission Alignment

Passion for democracy, civic engagement, voter education, and leveraging content to create meaningful social impact.

Self-Starter Mentality

Ability to thrive in a remote, volunteer-driven environment while independently driving strategic initiatives forward.

Why Join WeVote?

  • Help shape how millions of voters access and engage with trusted civic information.
  • Lead content strategy for a nationally recognized civic technology nonprofit.
  • Build executive-level experience in digital strategy, communications, and audience development.
  • Collaborate with mission-driven professionals in technology, media, civic engagement, and nonprofit leadership.
  • Make a measurable impact on voter participation and democratic engagement.

Position Details

Location: Remote (U.S.-based volunteers preferred)

Time Commitment: Approximately 5–10 hours per week

Compensation: Volunteer Position

* Fraud and phishing warning * 

Please apply directly via our volunteering portal/ATS at https://wevote.applytojob.com/apply. Do not apply via any other job portals, aggregators, or sites, as your information may not be secure, or the role may no longer be accepting applications. Thank you!!

To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/wevote-director-of-content-strategy

jobs.title: Creative Design Team Lead (AI & Performance Marketing)
jobs.description:
Headquarters: Tallinn, Remote, Estonia
URL: http://capslock.global

CapsLock is a global IT marketing company that pioneers unique, scalable customer acquisition solutions for B2C clients. We solve complex sales challenges across a wide range of industries, primarily for large North American partners. By integrating our expertise in Digital Marketing, IT, Design, AI-driven analytics, proprietary MarTech, and sales consulting, we deliver powerful, data-informed customer acquisition solutions.

At CapsLock, people, technology, and forward-thinking innovation lie at the heart of everything we do. Our diverse, global team, fluent in over 10 languages, thrives on open collaboration and the exchange of new ideas, pushing boundaries to ensure our clients' success.


Role overview

We're looking for a Marketing Design Team Lead who is equal parts creative leader, marketer, and AI geek, someone who knows how to achieve business goals through visuals that actually sell. 

You will take a team of 3 AI-driven Creative Designers and scale it to 6. The team produces static ad creatives, photorealistic AI visuals for performance campaigns across paid media channels, and source assets for our video production pipeline.

Your job is to build the company's visual creative engine. Whatever the starting point- a brief, a hypothesis, a raw idea - it leaves the team as a creative that performs.

You'll work closely with Creative Producers, Marketers, Copywriters, Media Buyers, and the Video Editing team, and partner with our Generative AI Pipeline Engineer on tooling and workflows.


What you will work on

  • Lead, mentor, and scale a team of 3 to 6 AI-driven Creative Designers - grow people, not just output;
  • Own the production flow: task distribution, capacity planning, and strict QC - production-grade, not demo-grade;
  • Drive creative direction: concepts, hooks, and visual angles that stop the scroll and convert;
  • Generate ideas yourself and push the team beyond safe iterations - informed by visual trends and competitor creatives;
  • Own the creative testing loop: build a database of winners, analyze failures, turn performance data into next iterations;
  • Track new AI models and tools; be the company's go-to expert on what's creatively possible with AI, staying hands-on in the tools;
  • Run regular R&D and build prompt and style libraries that keep quality consistent as the team grows;
  • Stay hands-on: jump into the tools (Figma, Adobe Suite, AI platforms) when needed to unblock the team, take on the most complex creatives, or test new approaches;
  • Partner with the Generative AI Pipeline Engineer to turn the team's creative needs into pipelines, presets, and automation;
  • Work tightly with Creative Producers, Marketers, Media Buyers, and Video Editors: align on strategy, negotiate deadlines, solve bottlenecks.


Your must-haves

You don't need to meet every single requirement. If you're excellent in most of these areas and can show shipped work, we'd love to hear from you.

  • 5+ years of Leadership Experience: You have successfully managed creative/design teams in digital marketing. (This is not a role for a senior designer looking for their first management gig);
  • Mature Leader & Problem Solver: You build clear processes, guide your team, gracefully resolve conflicts, remain highly proactive, and stay completely open to new ideas and approaches;
  • Strong Project Manager: You drive every project cleanly to the finish line. You guarantee top-tier quality, maintain absolute order, and hit strict deadlines without excuses;
  • Strong Visual Craft: composition, lighting, color, typography, anatomy. You can articulate exactly why a creative works or doesn't;

Who we are

Since 2013, Digital Moment has led digital education for Canadian youth, expanding the reach and impact of our foundational programs each year.

We are shaping AI-fluent leaders for a future-ready Canada with our innovative programs and initiatives.

We’re currently looking for a Senior Project Manager to join our team.

Here’s an overview of the Position

You will serve as a primary operational liaison for our national grantors, corporate funders, and project partners across Canada. In this role, you will bring deep project management expertise and relationship-building capabilities to manage our most complex, multi-stakeholder initiatives from inception to closeout, ensuring all organizational commitments are delivered on time, on scope, and on budget.

Our organizational culture is highly collaborative and hands-on—everyone at Digital Moment rolls up their sleeves to get the work done. You are both a strategic problem-solver and a hands-on "do-er" who thrives on turning complex funding commitments into organized project plans, building authentic relationships with external partners, and stepping in directly to execute deliverables alongside internal teams.

Key Responsibilities

External Relationship Management & Primary Funder Point of Contact

  • Serve as a primary operational point of contact for external partners, grantors, and corporate funders throughout the project lifecycle; foster warm, professional, and trust-based relationships.
  • Host, facilitate, and lead partner meetings, kickoff sessions, recurring progress updates, and milestone check-ins with external stakeholders across Canada.
  • Proactively communicate project progress, navigate scope modifications with diplomacy, and act as a solution-oriented problem-solver when external roadblocks or timeline risks arise.
  • Represent Digital Moment with polished professionalism across written communications, partner presentations, and executive briefings.

Project Management Governance and Operational Excellence

  • Establish, standardize, and maintain best-in-class project management frameworks, templates, and governance models across all Digital Moment initiatives.
  • Set the benchmark for operational excellence by building real-time tracking systems that monitor project health, scope, timelines, deliverables, and budgets.
  • Audit, optimize, and manage the organization’s digital project tools (e.g., Monday.com,); model workflow best practices and drive internal accountability.
  • Translate complex funder agreements and grant proposals into clear, actionable, and trackable project schedules.

Cross-Functional Delivery & Internal Alignment

  • Act as the central operational bridge between departments such as Programs, Fund Development, Marketing, Digital Product, and Finance to drive seamless alignment on project deliverables and dependencies.
  • Build and maintain a dynamic, centralized reporting matrix for all funder requirements, ensuring clear assignment and follow-up on milestones across internal teams.
  • Partner with Fund Development and Marketing to operationalize opportunities for impact storytelling, testimonial collection, and asset creation tied to funded milestones.

Financial Tracking, Time Management & Hands-On Execution (Doer Mindset)

  • Lead project budget tracking in close coordination with Finance to prevent scope creep, monitor burn rates, and ensure fiscal compliance on all funded deliverables.
  • Champion standardized time-tracking practices across teams to support accurate labor cost distribution, grant compliance, and resource planning.
  • Roll up your sleeves daily to build tracking dashboards, troubleshoot data discrepancies, and assist cross-functional teams in overcoming execution hurdles.

Funder Reporting, Written Documentation & Renewal Support

  • Translate complex program activities, regional data, and technical outcomes into clear, compelling narratives that funders easily understand—effectively "telling the story" of our impact, progress, and context.
  • Lead, draft, or contribute to high-impact funder reports, progress updates, project renewal applications, and grant proposals—ensuring all written deliverables effectively communicate program context, metrics, and achievements.
  • Maintain clear, reliable documentation by capturing and distributing concise, structured meeting notes, action items, decision logs, and project status updates for internal teams and external partners.
  • Review, edit, and synthesize inputs across departments to ensure all written deliverables meet a high standard of professional quality and clarity.

Ideal Candidate Profile

Experience

  • 6–8+ years of progressive, hands-on project management experience delivering complex, multi-stakeholder projects in non-profit, educational, tech, or public sector environments.
  • Demonstrated track record serving as a key external point of contact for high-value funders, government grantors, or corporate partners.

  • Proven track record in project financial tracking, budget oversight, time-tracking implementation, and funder report writing.

  • Technical fluency in modern project management platforms (Monday.com, Asana, Trello, ClickUp) and workflow automation.

Skills

  • Outstanding interpersonal and relationship-building skills; comfortable pitching, negotiating, and presenting to executive-level external partners.
  • Pragmatic problem-solving capability; able to de-escalate partner concerns quickly with clear, executable action plans.
  • Strong written communication and storytelling skills—able to break down complex projects, provide necessary context, and write clear, compelling funder reports, progress updates, meeting notes, and contribute to renewal proposals.

Personal Attributes

Qui sommes-nous?

Depuis 2013, Digital Moment est un chef de file en éducation numérique auprès des jeunes canadiens. Chaque année, nous élargissons la portée et l’impact de nos programmes..

Mais nous ne nous arrêtons pas là. Nous innovons continuellement afin de donner aux jeunes les compétences nécessaires pour tirer parti des technologies émergentes et relever certains des défis sociaux les plus urgents de notre époque.

Grâce à nos programmes et initiatives novateurs, nous contribuons à former une génération de leaders qui maîtrisent l’intelligence artificielle et qui sont prêts à bâtir le Canada de demain.

Notre travail repose sur trois valeurs fondamentales : l’innovation, l’inclusion et l’impact. Nous donnons à la prochaine génération les moyens de façonner la technologie pour le bien collectif. Travailler chez Digital Moment, c’est avoir l’occasion de faire une différence chaque jour en donnant aux jeunes les compétences numériques essentielles pour évoluer dans un monde où la technologie occupe une place centrale.

Nous sommes une petite équipe, dynamique et ambitieuse, qui travaille entièrement à distance. Nous valorisons l’innovation, remettons en question les façons de faire établies et expérimentons avec de nouvelles idées afin de créer des changements significatifs. Nous avons bâti une culture positive et collaborative, axée sur la mission et l’impact que nous souhaitons créer.

Nous sommes actuellement à la recherche d’un·e gestionnaire senior de projets pour se joindre à notre équipe.

Aperçu du poste

Vous serez la principale personne-ressource auprès de nos bailleurs de fonds nationaux, partenaires corporatifs et partenaires de projets partout au Canada. Dans ce rôle, vous mettrez à profit votre forte expertise en gestion de projets et vos aptitudes exceptionnelles en développement de relations afin de gérer nos initiatives les plus complexes, impliquant de multiples parties prenantes, de leur conception jusqu’à leur finition.

Vous veillerez à ce que tous nos engagements organisationnels soient respectés dans les délais, selon la portée prévue et dans les limites budgétaires établies.

Notre culture organisationnelle est hautement collaborative et axée sur l’action : chez Digital Moment, tout le monde met la main à la pâte pour faire avancer les choses. Vous êtes à la fois une personne stratégique, capable de résoudre des problèmes complexes, et une personne d’action qui aime passer de la planification à l’exécution. Vous excellez à transformer des engagements complexes envers les bailleurs de fonds en plans de projets structurés, à bâtir des relations authentiques avec nos partenaires externes et à intervenir directement dans la réalisation des livrables aux côtés des équipes internes.

Principales responsabilités

Gestion des relations externes et rôle principal auprès des bailleurs de fonds

  • Agir comme principale personne-ressource auprès des partenaires externes, bailleurs de fonds et partenaires corporatifs tout au long du cycle de vie des projets, en développant des relations chaleureuses, professionnelles et fondées sur la confiance.
  • Organiser, faciliter et diriger les rencontres avec les partenaires, les réunions de démarrage, les suivis réguliers et les rencontres liées aux principaux jalons avec les parties prenantes partout au Canada.
  • Communiquer de façon proactive l’avancement des projets, gérer avec diplomatie les modifications à la portée des projets et agir comme personne-ressource axée sur les solutions lorsque des obstacles ou des risques liés aux échéanciers surviennent.
  • Représenter Digital Moment avec professionnalisme et assurance dans les communications écrites, les présentations aux partenaires et les séances d’information destinées aux cadres.

Gouvernance de la gestion de projets et excellence opérationnelle

  • Établir, standardiser et maintenir des cadres, modèles et mécanismes de gouvernance de gestion de projets de haut niveau pour l’ensemble des initiatives de Digital Moment.
  • Établir les meilleures pratiques en matière d’excellence opérationnelle en développant des systèmes de suivi en temps réel permettant de surveiller la santé des projets, leur portée, les échéanciers, les livrables et les budgets.
  • Auditer, optimiser et administrer les outils numériques de gestion de projets de l’organisation (p. ex. Monday.com), tout en favorisant les meilleures pratiques en matière de flux de travail et la responsabilisation des équipes.
  • Transformer les ententes complexes avec les bailleurs de fonds et les propositions de financement en échéanciers de projets clairs, concrets et facilement traçables.

Réalisation interfonctionnelle et alignement interne

  • Agir comme point de liaison opérationnel central entre les différents services — notamment les Programmes, le Développement de financement, le Marketing, les Produits numériques et les Finances — afin d’assurer un alignement fluide sur les livrables et les interdépendances des projets.
  • Élaborer et maintenir une matrice centralisée et dynamique des exigences de tous les bailleurs de fonds, en veillant à ce que les jalons soient clairement attribués, suivis et réalisés par les équipes concernées.
  • Collaborer avec les équipes du Développement de financement et du Marketing afin de concrétiser les occasions de raconter notre impact, de recueillir des témoignages et de créer du contenu et des outils de communication liés aux jalons financés.

Suivi financier, gestion du temps et exécution concrète — esprit d’action

  • Diriger le suivi des budgets des projets en étroite collaboration avec l’équipe des Finances afin de prévenir les dépassements de portée, de surveiller le rythme des dépenses et d’assurer la conformité financière de tous les livrables financés.
  • Promouvoir des pratiques uniformisées de suivi du temps au sein des équipes afin de permettre une répartition précise des coûts de main-d’œuvre, d’assurer la conformité aux exigences des subventions et de soutenir la planification des ressources.
  • Mettre quotidiennement la main à la pâte pour créer des tableaux de bord de suivi, résoudre les écarts de données et aider les équipes interfonctionnelles à surmonter les obstacles liés à l’exécution.

Rapports aux bailleurs de fonds, documentation et soutien au renouvellement des financements

  • Transformer des activités de programmes complexes, des données régionales et des résultats techniques en récits clairs et convaincants que les bailleurs de fonds peuvent facilement comprendre, en racontant efficacement notre impact, nos progrès et le contexte dans lequel nous travaillons.
  • Diriger, rédiger ou contribuer à la préparation de rapports destinés aux bailleurs de fonds, de mises à jour sur l’avancement, de demandes de renouvellement de projets et de propositions de financement à fort impact, en veillant à ce que tous les documents présentent clairement le contexte, les indicateurs et les réalisations des programmes.
  • Assurer une documentation claire et fiable en préparant et en diffusant des comptes rendus de réunions concis et structurés, les suivis à effectuer, les décisions prises et les mises à jour sur l’état des projets, tant pour les équipes internes que pour les partenaires externes.
  • Réviser, modifier et synthétiser les contributions provenant des différents services afin de garantir un haut niveau de qualité, de clarté et de professionnalisme pour tous les documents écrits.

Profil recherché

Expérience

  • 6 ans ou plus d’expérience progressive et concrète en gestion de projets, avec une expérience démontrée dans la réalisation de projets complexes impliquant de multiples parties prenantes dans des environnements sans but lucratif, éducatifs, technologiques ou du secteur public (ou domaine connexe).
  • Expérience éprouvée à titre de personne-ressource principale auprès de bailleurs de fonds importants, d’organismes gouvernementaux offrant des subventions ou de partenaires corporatifs.
  • Forte expérience dans la mise en place de cadres de gestion de projets, de systèmes de suivi et d’outils numériques de collaboration au sein d’équipes distribuées.
  • Expérience démontrée en suivi financier de projets, gestion budgétaire, mise en place de pratiques de suivi du temps et rédaction de rapports destinés aux bailleurs de fonds.
  • Maîtrise des méthodologies de gestion de projets (normes PMI/PMP, Agile ou modèles hybrides) adaptées aux environnements sans but lucratif ou axés sur l’impact social et évoluant à un rythme soutenu.
  • Aisance avec les plateformes modernes de gestion de projets (Monday.com, Asana, Trello, ClickUp) et l’automatisation des flux de travail.
  • Une bonne connaissance des modèles de financement des organismes sans but lucratif au Canada, des cycles liés aux subventions et des exigences de conformité des partenaires constitue un atout.

Compétences

  • Bilinguisme français/anglais requis, avec une excellente maîtrise professionnelle des communications écrites et verbales dans les deux langues.
  • Excellentes aptitudes interpersonnelles et relationnelles; aisance à présenter, négocier et interagir avec des partenaires externes de niveau exécutif.
  • Excellente capacité à résoudre les problèmes de façon pragmatique et à désamorcer rapidement les préoccupations des partenaires grâce à des plans d’action clairs et réalisables.
  • Excellentes aptitudes en communication écrite et en vulgarisation narrative; capacité à expliquer des projets complexes, à fournir le contexte nécessaire et à rédiger des rapports convaincants pour les bailleurs de fonds, des mises à jour sur l’avancement et des comptes rendus de réunions, ainsi qu’à contribuer à des propositions de renouvellement.
  • Fort sens des affaires et excellente compréhension des données financières, notamment pour le suivi du rythme des dépenses, des écarts budgétaires et de l’allocation des ressources.

Qualités personnelles

  • Bâtisseur·euse de relations et professionnel·le — accessible, diplomate et éloquent·e, tant dans les échanges avec les bailleurs de fonds externes qu’avec les membres de l’équipe interne.
  • Personne d’action — motivé·e par la résolution des enjeux opérationnels, la prise en charge des responsabilités et la réalisation des livrables interfonctionnels jusqu’à leur aboutissement.
  • Fort sens des affaires et souci constant de la précision, de l’exécution et du contrôle de la qualité.
  • Excellent esprit de synthèse et sens narratif — capacité à expliquer clairement le « pourquoi » et le « alors, qu’est-ce que cela signifie? » derrière les principaux jalons d’un projet, afin que les partenaires externes comprennent pleinement le contexte et la valeur de notre travail.
  • Personne engagée envers la mission, passionnée par la littératie numérique, l’éducation et l’autonomisation des jeunes partout au Canada.

Vous vous reconnaissez dans cette description? Nous voulons vous connaître!

Ce que nous offrons

  • Travail entièrement à distance
  • Salaire concurrentiel
  • Politique généreuse de congés : 10 jours de bien-être et 20 jours de vacances par année
  • Assurance collective : couverture dès le premier jour
  • Programme de cotisation de l’employeur au REER

jobs.title: Paid Media Strategist
jobs.description:
QRY 101

Hey there! We're QRY, a media-buying agency that specializes in scaling retail brands. We connect brand awareness and performance media to unlock growth, use sophisticated data analytics, and employ a full-funnel marketing strategy to help brands reach their most valuable consumers. We’re a high‑performance, high‑ownership team that values candor, curiosity, and results. We love what we do and the people we do it with.

We’re hiring a Paid Media Strategist to own channel performance across a portfolio of clients. You’ll plan, launch, and optimize social campaigns, keep budgets and pacing tight, and translate data into crisp decisions. You love the details, move with urgency, and can explain complex ideas simply, internally and with clients.

Your day-to-day

This role involves successfully managing client campaigns in the digital advertising space across 4 main sectors:

  • Media Strategy:
    • You plan, book, and optimize paid media campaigns (i.e. Meta, TikTok, Pinterest, and Reddit) for 6-8 clients, utilizing available media planning tools to develop media plans.
    • You strategize and implement A/B experiments to test audiences, creative, landing pages, offers, etc.
    • You facilitate campaign implementation, including asset collecting and trafficking.
    • With support from Associate Directors, you’ll manage the channel's monthly reporting and strategy sessions with the client, owning overall communication for all channel initiatives.
  • Performance:
    • You scope, develop, and manage channel initiatives to consistently hit the goals for channels across all clients.
    • You act as a strategic advisor and recommend strategic pivots to increase the channel's performance.
  • Reporting + Forecasting:
    • You enthusiastically present reports to clients, highlighting the performance of your channels, how it assisted other channels in the funnel, how it affects the client's business, and recommended next steps.
    • You complete a monthly forecast for respective channels based on budget and/or revenue goals.
  • Cross Channel Strategy + Collaboration:
    • You collaborate with the other media and creative agency team members to ensure the creative specifications of negotiated plans are met.
    • You consistently identify cross-channel strategies / collaborations with clients to improve performance.
    • You effectively communicate with clients on teams' capabilities and opportunities, and proactively offer solutions for ad hoc issues.

How you win

  • Channel performance: You hit agreed KPI targets for your channels (e.g., MER/ROAS, CAC/LTV, revenue, efficiency) within budget and platform guardrails.
  • Learning velocity: You run a disciplined test program with documented hypotheses, win rate, rollout decisions, and measurable lift.
  • Forecast accuracy: You run accurate forecasts on a monthly basis and tie expectations to realistic assumptions.
  • Execution: You deliver decks, reports, and campaign launches with low error rates related to QA or data and you ensure QRY quality is represented in every outcome.

What’s it like here

We’re a high‑performance culture with high support. We’re serious about setting clear goals, providing direct feedback, documenting our progress, and celebrating our wins. You’ll get real ownership, supportive teammates, and the tools to do excellent work.

  • Your first month: You’ll build trust with client and internal partners, learn each brand’s goals and constraints, and align on how success will be measured. You’ll review current channel setups and performance at a high level and agree on priorities and near‑term wins. By the end of the month, you’ll have a good understanding of our clients, their channel set ups, and how our pods work.
  • After month one: You’ll own steady, predictable performance against plans and keep budgets and timelines on track. You’ll communicate often, surface risks early with options, and highlight opportunities for smart growth. The result is consistent delivery, fewer surprises, and clear momentum.

Requirements

✍️​ Experience: You have 2-5 years of successful hands-on paid media management experience in an agency environment. You know the ins and outs of making things run smoothly and have applied successful tactics in a previous role. You have experience leading and managing large media budgets for retail and e-commerce brands, with hands-on experience across paid media platforms including Meta, TikTok, Pinterest, and Reddit. Ideally, you also have experience with programmatic display advertising.

📚 Education: Ideally, you have a bachelor's degree in marketing, science, or a related field.

🔢 Analytical Mindset: You're an analytical thinker. You have experience turning complex data into digestible reports, seeing the big picture, and breaking it down into an actionable plan that gets results. You also have experience with platform-native reporting, GA4, and Looker Studio.

💬​ Communication: Your communication skills are top-notch and you can communicate with senior stakeholders effectively and efficiently.

🧪 Experimentation: You have hands-on experimentation experience, including running A/B tests on audiences, creative, landing pages, or offers and turning results into rollout decisions.

🖥️​ Remote Work Environment: You understand the importance of a clean and quiet work environment suitable for video conferencing. You respect digital etiquette and ensure smooth virtual collaboration.

Benefits

🤑 Competitive salary. We offer a market-rate salary of up to $85,000.00 USD/year, based on experience.

💰 Quarterly bonuses. Enjoy quarterly bonuses tied to company revenue.

🏠 USA remote flexibility. Choose your ideal workspace, whether it’s your home office or a coffee shop.

🌴 Time off made easy. Take advantage of our unlimited PTO policy.

🏥 Comprehensive healthcare. We offer exceptional health, dental, and vision insurance, fully covered for employees by QRY. We also offer a $100 monthly budget for your wellbeing, i.e. gym memberships, coworking day pass, etc.

📈 Secure your future. Participate in our 401k program with a company match.

🌱 Growth and development. Nurture your learning and development with our investment to L&D, growth opportunities, and tools such as our Learning & Development Philosophy + Policy, role matrices, and skill assessments.

💻 Latest tech. Team members are provided with the latest Macbook Pro and a one-time $500 stipend to set up their at-home workspace.

🥳 Celebrate and connect. Join us for annual team retreats (we’ve been to Austin, Tennessee, and Utah to name a few), weekly Coffee Chats, and monthly Happy Hours to foster our vibrant culture.

Day-to-Day

  • Track priorities, metrics, and accountability

  • Draft CEO communications (internal & external)

  • Coordinate board and investor materials

  • Resolve cross-functional blockers

  • Own “CEO-only” initiatives end-to-end

  • Surface risks early and proactively close gaps

jobs.title: Channel Account Manager, Taiwan
jobs.description:
AVEVA is a global leader in industrial software. Our cutting-edge solutions are used by thousands of enterprises to deliver the essentials of life – such as energy, infrastructure, chemicals and minerals – safely, efficiently and more sustainably.

We’re the first software business in the world to have our sustainability targets validated by the SBTi, and we’ve been recognized for the transparency and ambition of our commitment to diversity, equity, and inclusion. We’ve also recently been named as one of the world’s most innovative companies.

If you’re a curious and collaborative person who wants to make a big impact through technology, then we want to hear from you! Find out more at AVEVA Careers.

For more information about our privacy policy and how to manage cookies, visit our Privacy Policy.

Job Title: Channel Account Manager, Taiwan

Location: Taiwan, Remote

Employment Type: full-time

The job

AVEVA Taiwan is seeking a highly execution-driven Channel Account Manager to build, develop, and scale the partner ecosystem, while driving joint business growth through close collaboration with system integrators (SI) and direct engagement with end users.

This role is responsible for incubating and growing Certified and Registered System Integrators, expanding AVEVA’s coverage across manufacturing industries, and ensuring disciplined execution of joint opportunities.

The ideal candidate combines channel development capability with strong end-user sales experience, and is able to lead partners in winning complex industrial projects.

Key Responsibilities

1. Partner Ecosystem Development (Core Mission)

  • Identify, recruit, and incubate new Registered and Certified System Integrators (SI) in Taiwan

  • Develop partners across different maturity levels:

  • New partners (onboarding and enablement)

  • Registered partners (pipeline development)

  • Certified partners (scaling and execution)

  • Drive structured partner development plans, including:

  • Sales capability

  • Solution positioning

  • Project execution alignment

2. Partner Driving & Execution Discipline

  • Strongly drive assigned partners to:

  • Build and maintain qualified pipeline

  • Provide weekly updates on opportunities

  • Follow structured deal progression

  • Conduct regular pipeline reviews and enforce execution discipline

  • Ensure partners actively engage in sales activities rather than passive support

3. Joint Account Development (Co-sell with SI)

  • Work with partners to jointly develop and manage key end-user accounts

  • Engage directly with customers together with SI partners, including:

  • Engineering teams

  • Operations teams

  • Decision makers

  • Drive account expansion by identifying new use cases and opportunities

4. Opportunity & Deal Driving

  • Support and lead opportunities through:

  • Requirement clarification

  • Solution positioning

  • Stakeholder alignment

  • Deal closing

  • Define and execute win strategies with partners

5. SCADA / OT Solution Positioning

  • Promote AVEVA solutions including:

  • AVEVA System Platform

  • AVEVA InTouch

  • AVEVA Historian / PI System

  • Position solutions based on customer needs and use cases

  • Support early-stage spec-in activities and project influence

6. Industry Expansion (Manufacturing Focus)

  • Drive growth across:

  • Semiconductor / Electronics

  • General manufacturing

  • Industrial sectors

  • Expand partner and account coverage into new applications and industries

Essential Requirements

  • 5–10 years experience in Industrial automation / SCADA / OT sales and Channel sales or SI ecosystem development

  • Proven experience in working with or managing system integrators (SI) by engaging end users directly and driving or supporting project-based sales cycles

  • Strong understanding of SCADA / industrial automation environments (conceptual level sufficient)

  • Experience in enterprise sales methodologies such as Pipeline management and deal progression, Competitive positioning and ability to drive partners with structure and discipline

  • Language fluency in English and Mandarin

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in Partner recruitment and development and SI certification or enablement programs

  • Familiarity with some AVEVA products such as AVEVA Wonderware (InTouch, System Platform), AVEVA PI or similar industrial data solutions

  • Good knowledge of competitive landscape and channel ecosystem in Taiwan

Desired Competencies

  • Strong ownership and execution mindset

  • Ability to influence and lead partners

jobs.title: DSP Designer
jobs.description:
Fidus is a global high-tech design firm headquartered in Ottawa, with additional design centres in Kitchener-Waterloo and San Jose. We specialize in leading-edge electronic product development, with hardware, embedded software, FPGA/ASIC, and signal integrity teams working together to design and deliver next-generation products for clients in emerging technology markets.

Position Overview/Mandate:

The DSP Designer plays a key role in developing and delivering complex signal processing algorithms for Fidus clients, from concept through simulation, fixed-point implementation, and hardware bring-up. You will work directly with customers and internal Fidus FPGA/hardware teams to design algorithms, perform quantization and bit-width analysis, and translate DSP concepts into feasible hardware architectures.

This role is ideal for someone who enjoys moving between application domains (communications, radar/sensing, industrial, medical), is comfortable working across the algorithm-to-hardware boundary, and takes pride in producing well-documented, bit-true designs.

Make an Impact with US:

At Fidus, you'll work on high-speed, high-complexity electronic systems, often using emerging technologies before they reach the broader market. You'll collaborate across FPGA/DSP, hardware, embedded software, verification, SI/PI, PCB layout, and mechanical/thermal design as part of cross-functional teams delivering real products for our clients.

In practice, that means contributing to projects across communications, Aerospace & Defense, Space & Satellite, Industrial Automation, Automotive, Medical Devices, and Semiconductor engagements. You won't be limited to a single product or industry—your work will follow the technology, not just one roadmap.

What You'll Be Doing:

  • Develop and simulate DSP algorithms (equalization, filtering, estimation, detection) in MATLAB/Simulink and/or Python, from concept through fixed-point validation
  • Perform quantization/bit-width analysis and produce bit-true fixed-point models suitable for HDL implementation
  • Collaborate with FPGA/HDL and hardware teams to translate algorithms into feasible hardware architectures (pipelining, MAC/resource budgeting, timing closure)
  • Support HDL verification through golden-model test vectors and co-simulation
  • Support lab bring-up, characterization, and tuning of DSP-based hardware against real-world channel/sensor behavior
  • Adapt existing DSP toolkits to new client domains and standards across multiple engagements (e.g., communications, Aerospace & Defense, Space & Satellite, Industrial Automation, Automotive, Medical Devices, and Semiconductor)
  • Document algorithm design decisions, trade-offs, and validation results for client and internal reference

Who You are:

  • BS/MS/PhD in Electrical Engineering, Applied Physics, or related field
  • Strong foundation in signals and systems: Fourier/Z-transform, digital filter design (FIR/IIR), sampling theory
  • Practical experience with estimation/detection theory (e.g., matched filtering, MMSE, Kalman filtering) or adaptive filtering (LMS/RLS)
  • Proficiency in MATLAB/Simulink and/or Python for algorithm design and simulation
  • Experience with fixed-point conversion and quantization trade-off analysis
  • Demonstrated ability to work across the algorithm-to-hardware boundary (collaborating directly with HDL/FPGA teams)
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills - ability to explain algorithm trade-offs to non-DSP stakeholders
  • Embraces AI as part of a modern engineering toolkit

Nice to Have:

  • Experience in one or more of: optical/wireless communications, radar/sensing, motor control, biomedical signal processing, semiconductor test
  • Experience with high-speed SerDes and PAM4 signaling (e.g., PCIe Gen6, 400G/800G Ethernet electrical) - equalization (FFE/CTLE/DFE), link training, and FEC awareness
  • Familiarity with AMD's Adaptive Computing portfolio (Versal, Alveo) or embedded x86 product lines
  • Familiarity with HDL Coder, HLS, or Simulink-to-HDL co-simulation workflows
  • Hands-on lab experience (scope, VNA, BERT, or domain-equivalent test equipment)
  • Exposure to safety-critical or regulated development processes (DO-178C/DO-254, ISO 26262, IEC 62304/60601) - valued for A&D, automotive, and medtech engagements specifically
  • Experience adapting quickly across multiple industries or client domains (consulting/services background a plus)
  • Exposure to AI/ML techniques applied to signal processing on FPGAs, GPUs, NPUs, or CPUs
  • Experience with dedicated DSP processors (e.g., Analog Devices, Texas Instruments)
  • Experience with RF front-end systems and data converter interfaces (ADC/DAC), including digital up/down-conversion (DUC/DDC)

Location and travel: Fully remote role and requires around 15% travel, including domestic and international.

Benefits

Our competitive compensation package also includes a comprehensive benefits package, including medical, dental, and vision plans, matching 401(k) contributions, annual profit-sharing bonus, along with other supplementary benefits.

We also recognize that candidates show interest throughout different career stages and welcome all applications. When there is a great fit, the level of the role may be shifted as applicable.

About Fidus & Why Work Here

Since 2001, Fidus has completed over 4,000 projects for more than 400 customers across industries including Telecom/Datacom, Aerospace & Defence, Consumer, Semiconductors, Industrial/Automotive Controls, and Medical. As a Premier Adaptive Computing Partner for AMD North America, we combine deep technical expertise with industry-leading tools to solve complex design challenges.

Fidus designs high-speed, high-complexity electronic systems using emerging technologies, often well before they reach the broader market. Our teams work across FPGA/DSP, hardware, embedded software, verification, SI/PI, PCB layout, and mechanical/thermal design to deliver real products for our customers.

Our work spans space and satellite systems, next-generation communications and networking, high-performance compute and storage platforms, advanced video and imaging, and industrial, medical, and automotive systems. We are not tied to a single product or industry—our work follows the technology, not just one roadmap.

At Fidus, collaboration is at the core of how we work. We value openness, trust, and shared ownership, and we create an environment where people are encouraged to contribute ideas, learn from one another, and have a meaningful impact through the work they do.

If all of this excites you, has your attention, and you can't wait to join our amazing team and work environment, then we want to hear from you!

Curious what it's actually like to work here? Take a look at our Working at Fidus page.

Fidus has a commitment to ensure a fair and transparent recruitment process. Automated tools (including AI) support our initial screening of applicants against our job posting to identify candidates whose qualifications, experience, and skills align most closely with the position requirements. All further candidate assessments and final selection are conducted by our human recruitment team. AI does not make any final hiring decisions.

Thank you for your interest in Fidus. We welcome and encourage diverse candidates to apply. Accommodations are available upon request for candidates taking part in all aspects of the selection process. Fidus is committed to creating a diverse environment and is proud to be an equal opportunity employer.

jobs.title: Signal Integrity and Power Integrity Designer
jobs.description:
Fidus is a global high-tech design firm headquartered in Ottawa, with additional design centres in Kitchener-Waterloo and San Jose. We specialize in leading-edge electronic product development, with hardware, embedded software, FPGA/ASIC, and signal integrity teams working together to design and deliver next-generation products for clients in emerging technology markets.

Position Overview/Mandate:

The Senior Signal Integrity and Power Integrity Specialist plays a critical role in ensuring the performance, reliability, and compliance of high-speed electronic systems designed by Fidus. You will lead and support SI/PI analysis from early architecture through final validation, working closely with hardware designers, PCB layout, FPGA, and system teams to optimize signal quality and power distribution.

This role is ideal for someone who thrives on solving complex high-speed challenges, enjoys working across multiple industries, and takes pride in delivering robust, production-ready designs backed by strong analytical and lab validation skills.

Make an Impact with US:

At Fidus, you’ll work on complex, high-speed systems across a diverse set of industries including telecommunications, wireless devices, biomedical instruments, avionics, maritime, and more .

You’ll contribute to projects ranging from evaluation boards and reference designs to high-speed backplanes and systems involving DDR memory interfaces and SERDES . Your work will directly influence product performance, manufacturability, and compliance.

In practice, this means engaging from early concept and stack-up definition through simulation, layout guidance, lab validation, and final product release. You won’t be limited to a single application domain — you’ll work where the technology demands deep SI/PI expertise.

What You’ll Be Doing:

  • Lead PCB layer stack-up design and optimization
  • Perform waveform integrity, crosstalk, timing, eye diagram, and jitter analysis
  • Conduct power integrity analysis including DC IR drop and decoupling strategy optimization
  • Model insertion and return loss and support EMC analysis
  • Use industry tools such as Cadence Sigrity, HSPICE, ADS, HFSS, and Hyperlynx for simulation and analysis
  • Support and execute lab validation using TDR, vector network analyzers, spectrum analyzers, and high-speed oscilloscopes
  • Estimate turnkey projects and execute work from concept through development, lab testing, and final product delivery
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams including hardware, layout, FPGA, and system engineers to ensure SI/PI best practices are embedded early in the design cycle

Who You are:

  • MS or PhD in Electrical/Electronics Engineering
  • Minimum five (5) years of experience designing and analyzing high-speed circuits or RF structures
  • Strong background in signal integrity, power integrity, electromagnetics, RF, antennas, or EMC
  • Hands-on experience with high-speed interfaces such as DDR memory and SERDES
  • Proficiency with SI/PI simulation and analysis tools such as Cadence Sigrity, HSPICE, ADS, HFSS, and Hyperlynx
  • Solid lab validation experience using tools such as TDR, vector network analyzers, spectrum analyzers, and high-speed oscilloscopes
  • Strong communication skills with the ability to interact effectively with customers and cross-functional teams
  • Comfortable adapting to new technologies and working across diverse industries
  • Committed to disciplined engineering practices and delivering high-quality designs
  • Embraces AI as part of a modern engineering toolkit

This role is being posted to fill an existing vacancy

Annual base salary ranges from $105,000 to $155,000. The final offer within this range takes into account the variations in knowledge, skills, experience, and market conditions, and with consideration to internal equity.

Our competitive compensation package also includes a comprehensive benefits package, including medical, dental, and vision plans, matching GRSP contributions, annual profit-sharing bonus, along with other supplementary benefits.

We also recognize that candidates show interest throughout different career stages and welcome all applications. When there is a great fit, the level of the role may be shifted as applicable.

About Fidus & Why Work Here

Since 2001, Fidus has completed over 4,000 projects for more than 400 customers across industries including Telecom/Datacom, Aerospace & Defence, Consumer, Semiconductors, Industrial/Automotive Controls, and Medical. As a Premier Adaptive Computing Partner for AMD North America, we combine deep technical expertise with industry-leading tools to solve complex design challenges.

Fidus designs high-speed, high-complexity electronic systems using emerging technologies, often well before they reach the broader market. Our teams work across FPGA/DSP, hardware, embedded software, verification, SI/PI, PCB layout, and mechanical/thermal design to deliver real products for our customers.

Our work spans space and satellite systems, next-generation communications and networking, high-performance compute and storage platforms, advanced video and imaging, and industrial, medical, and automotive systems. We are not tied to a single product or industry—our work follows the technology, not just one roadmap.

At Fidus, collaboration is at the core of how we work. We value openness, trust, and shared ownership, and we create an environment where people are encouraged to contribute ideas, learn from one another, and have a meaningful impact through the work they do.

If all of this excites you, has your attention, and you can’t wait to join our amazing team and work environment, then we want to hear from you!

Curious what it's actually like to work here? Take a look at our Working at Fidus page.

Fidus has a commitment to ensure a fair and transparent recruitment process. Automated tools (including AI) support our initial screening of applicants against our job posting to identify candidates whose qualifications, experience, and skills align most closely with the position requirements. All further candidate assessments and final selection are conducted by our human recruitment team. AI does not make any final hiring decisions.

Thank you for your interest in Fidus. We welcome and encourage diverse candidates to apply. Accommodations are available upon request for candidates taking part in all aspects of the selection process. Fidus is committed to creating a diverse environment and is proud to be an equal opportunity employer.

jobs.title: Underwriter
jobs.description:
Headquarters:
URL: http://www.hometap.com

Here at Hometap, we’re collaborative, passionate, and always ready to roll up our sleeves to create solutions that help people get more out of homeownership — and out of life. Our first product, a home equity investment, gives homeowners the opportunity to quickly access the equity they’ve built in their home to pay for what’s most important to them, from handling debt to finally making much-needed renovations, without taking on debt.  

We work hard, and have some fun along the way, too. You don’t have to take our word for it: The Boston Globe and Forbes have recognized us as a great place to work, and we’ve been honored for our commitment to innovation in the fintech space by Inc., HousingWire, and more! 

In case you need any more convincing, we also provide competitive compensation, healthcare coverage, generous PTO, a meaningful equity package, and a strong culture with plenty of opportunities for team-building and camaraderie.

Interested in joining us on our mission to make homeownership less stressful and more accessible? We’d love to talk.

Who you are:

As an Underwriter, you'll play a critical role in Hometap's home equity investment process, making recommendations on both the homes and the homeowners we work with. You'll analyze a broad set of home and homeowner information to assess the risk profile of each application and make investment eligibility recommendations against the standards in our underwriting guidelines. This is a strong fit if you bring underwriting experience, a passion for real estate, and exceptional organizational skills.

What you'll do:

  • Work closely with our Sales and Processing teams to review homeowner applications quickly and accurately
  • Evaluate applicant and property information against our underwriting criteria, confirm the application is complete, and make informed investment recommendations
  • Review and analyze appraisal reports for accuracy and compliance with guidelines, evaluating comparables, market trends, and property conditions to confirm value is supported
  • Flag applications that raise concerns around completeness or risk
  • Determine eligibility amounts based on your analysis of applicant and property information
  • Collaborate with a cross-functional team of Sales and Operations associates to complete each application review

What you bring:

  • 2+ years of underwriting experience, ideally in mortgage, home equity, HELOC, or a similar real estate lending environment
  • Sharp attention to detail in a fast-paced environment, including strong proofreading and fact-checking skills
  • Strong judgment, with comfort making recommendations against a rules rubric and escalating issues and questions as needed
  • Ability to work independently and as part of a team
  • Comfort handling multiple responsibilities and staying proactive under deadlines
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with a client-oriented approach
  • An interest in real estate and fintech, and excitement about joining a growing tech company
  • Bachelor's degree preferred, ideally in business, finance, or a related field

The base salary for this role is $75,000 with additional earning potential through a performance-based monthly incentive. You’ll also receive meaningful equity, giving you a real stake in the company’s growth and success. We offer generous medical, dental, and vision coverage, a work-from-home stipend, parental leave, and plenty of paid time off to recharge.

Hometap is on a mission to make homeownership less stressful and more accessible. Our home equity investment product provides homeowners with a fast, simple, and straightforward way to access the equity in their home without taking out a loan or having to sell. By investing alongside homeowners, Hometap offers debt-free cash in exchange for a share of their home’s future value — all without any monthly payments over the life of the investment. Through a combination of financial innovation and best-in-class customer service, Hometap enables people to get more from homeownership so they can get more from life.
 
Hometap believes that our differences are what bring us together, and one of our biggest priorities is creating a diverse workplace that welcomes and values each team member’s unique perspective, background, and ideas. All roles here are filled based solely on candidates’ qualifications and our business needs. 

Hometap is an equal opportunity employer. We provide employment opportunities regardless of race, age, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender, gender identity, gender expression, genetic information, national origin, pregnancy, marital, veteran, or disability status. If there is an accommodation that would support your ability to apply and interview with Hometap, please let us know by emailing work@hometap.com.
