At OneStream, we're on a mission to empower every Finance organization and professional to exceed their potential. Our global teams span continents, cultures, and time zones, united by a shared purpose as we build the operating system for modern Finance and help organizations move with greater speed, clarity, and confidence.

That mission comes to life through our people. Behind every innovation, customer success, and milestone are talented people working together to make a difference. That's why we're looking for people who are bold enough to think big, authentic in how they lead and collaborate, curious about what's possible, and committed to delivering results.

Want a closer look before you apply? Explore our Careers site to learn more about our people, culture, and benefits.

Summary

Reporting to the Senior Director of Enterprise Enablement, the AI Architect will help OneStream responsibly adopt and scale artificial intelligence by identifying high-value business opportunities, translating them into practical architecture and transformation plans, and aligning delivery with enterprise architecture, security, privacy, data and responsible AI expectations. The role connects business process redesign, enterprise architecture, solution design, governance alignment and adoption enablement. This ensures AI initiatives move beyond isolated experimentation and deliver measurable productivity, automation, decision-support and process improvement outcomes. The AI Architect will coordinate progress from initial idea through assessment, pilot and scaled adoption, while formal policy ownership, approvals, funding decisions and implementation accountability remain with the appropriate teams.

Primary Duties and Responsibilities

AI Opportunity Discovery and Portfolio Shaping 

  • Identify opportunities across business functions where AI can improve productivity, efficiency, decision quality, customer or employee experience, and business outcomes. 
  • Create and maintain a structured inventory of AI opportunities, including business ownership, value hypothesis, users, dependencies, risks, readiness and status. 
  • Develop and apply intake, scoring and prioritisation methods that consider impact, effort, data readiness, governance complexity, adoption complexity and ownership clarity. 
  • Partner with business and technology leaders to shape a sequenced AI opportunity roadmap aligned to strategic priorities and enterprise capabilities. 

AI Solution Architecture and Design 

  • Design end-to-end AI solution approaches spanning enterprise applications, data sources, integrations, workflows, user experiences and measurable outcomes. 
  • Define reusable architecture patterns for AI agents, copilots, (e.g. GitHub Copilot, Claude, and similar assistants), workflow automation, knowledge discovery, decision support, orchestration and human-in-the-loop controls. 
  • Document architecture decisions, integration requirements, data dependencies, security considerations, ownership, support models and implementation trade-offs. 
  • Partner with application owners, data teams and platform teams to embed approved AI capabilities into existing systems and business processes. 

Business Process Transformation and Readiness 

  • Evaluate processes for automation, augmentation, knowledge retrieval, decision support and workflow optimisation opportunities. 
  • Conduct practical AI readiness assessments across departments, processes and business capabilities. 
  • Translate broad business challenges into clearly scoped transformation opportunities with defined outcomes, users, constraints, dependencies and adoption needs. 
  • Create transformation blueprints connecting process improvement, people impacts, application dependencies, data readiness, governance requirements and value measurement. 

Responsible AI, Governance and Risk Alignment 

  • Partner with Security, Legal, Compliance, Data, IT and business owners to align AI initiatives with responsible AI and enterprise governance expectations. 
  • Embed review checkpoints for privacy, security, data usage, transparency, accountable human oversight, compliance and operational support. 
  • Document risks, controls, data exposure, approval dependencies and accountable ownership for proposed solutions and tools. 
  • Promote approved capabilities, reusable patterns and consistent governance routing to reduce fragmented or unmanaged experimentation. 

Enablement, Adoption and Value Measurement 

  • Create playbooks, templates, workshops, demonstrations and best-practice guidance that accelerate responsible AI adoption. 
  • Help teams understand where AI is appropriate, where added caution is required and which stakeholders must be engaged before a solution is scaled. 
  • Define and track meaningful outcome measures such as hours saved, cycle-time reduction, quality improvement, cost avoidance, adoption and user feedback. 
  • Use lessons from pilots and production solutions to improve architecture patterns, governance guidance, enablement materials and roadmap decisions. 

Cross-Functional Architecture Leadership 

  • Facilitate collaboration across IT, Enterprise Applications, Data, Security, Legal, Compliance, Operations, Finance, HR, Engineering and business teams. 
  • Build alignment around value, feasibility, risk, readiness, reusable patterns, implementation recommendations and measurable next steps. 
  • Drive progress through influence, structured facilitation, strong documentation and evidence-based architecture recommendations. 
  • Maintain visibility of the applications, data sources, workflows, integrations and ownership dependencies required to support trusted, scalable AI solutions. 

Required Education and Experience

  • Demonstrated experience, 8+ years, in enterprise, solution or application architecture, with responsibility for translating business needs into implementable designs.
  • Practical experience designing or enabling AI, automation, digital assistant, agent, knowledge or decision-support solutions in an enterprise environment.
  • Strong understanding of enterprise applications, integrations, APIs, data flows, identity, security, privacy and operational support considerations.
  • Experience assessing business processes, shaping transformation roadmaps and building business cases tied to measurable outcomes.
  • Working knowledge of responsible AI principles, risk assessment, human oversight and governance review processes.
  • Experience creating architecture artefacts, reusable patterns, standards, decision records, playbooks and executive-level recommendations.
  • Proven ability to facilitate senior business and technical stakeholders, manage ambiguity and influence decisions without direct authority.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain complex AI and architecture topics to executive and technical audiences.

Preferred Education and Experience

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience.
  • Relevant architecture, cloud, data, security or AI certifications, such as TOGAF, AWS/Azure/GCP architecture certifications.
  • Experience working in a global SaaS or software business.
  • Experience with enterprise AI platforms, agent or copilot capabilities, workflow automation, knowledge solutions and integration technologies.

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities

  • Business and transformation acumen.
  • Enterprise and solution architecture.
  • Responsible innovation and sound risk judgement.
  • Structured problem solving and prioritisation.
  • Executive and technical communication.
  • Cross-functional facilitation and stakeholder influence.
  • Self-motivation, learning agility and delivery discipline.

Job Description:

Position Overview  

RMI seeks a dynamic Senior Manager, based in the New York tri-state area, to serve as a frontline fundraiser and senior relationship manager on its team focused on individual and family philanthropy. This role is responsible for securing gifts of $25K+ from individuals and family offices in support of building a sustainable future powered by affordable, resilient, clean energy. The position advances RMI’s highest-priority initiatives, including the Acceleration Fund, legacy giving, and unrestricted giving through strategic, end-to-end donor engagement that drives sustained philanthropic support. The position reports to the Development Director, Individual Giving. The ideal candidate brings executive presence and confidence engaging high-net-worth individuals, family offices, and leaders from the finance, technology, and impact investing sectors, and can speak credibly about how capital and philanthropy together drive the clean energy transition.


Key Responsibilities

  • Manage a portfolio of approximately 100-125-high-net-worth individuals and family offices, including current donors and prospects.
  • Conduct donor discovery and qualification activities regularly; meet with funders and identify their interests, priorities, and philanthropic capacity.
  • Execute tailored best-practice cultivation and solicitation strategies.
  • Meet an annual fundraising goal of at least $1.5 million in the first years of the position. Once the portfolio is fully matured, meet an annual fundraising goal of at least $3 million.
  • Align prospects’ philanthropic goals with RMI’s high-impact priorities for the clean energy transition.
  • Articulate RMI’s market-based, systems-change approach in terms that resonate with impact investors, entrepreneurs, and philanthropists.
  • Represent RMI in meetings and events, traveling regularly within the New York region and elsewhere to identify, cultivate, and deepen relationships with funders.
  • Partner with RMI’s New York–based senior leadership to represent RMI at family office gatherings, investor convenings, and donor events, engaging confidently with leaders from philanthropy, finance, technology, and impact investing. 
  • Leverage internal networks and external partnerships to map relationships and create strategic pathways to engagement with high-net-worth individuals and family offices.
  • Provide strategic leadership to cross-functional engagement teams, ensuring clarity of roles and responsibilities across executive, program, and volunteer leadership.
  • Partner with program teams and Development Communications to develop compelling funding proposals and stewardship reports, translating technical details into clear, outcomes-driven narratives.
  • Maintain accurate and up-to-date donor data in Salesforce, documenting all interactions to ensure data integrity and provide accurate financial projections.
  • Contribute actively to the development team’s strategic goals through participation in staff meetings, task forces, and ongoing collaboration with program colleagues.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s Degree  
  • 7–10+ years of progressive professional experience, which may include a combination of nonprofit fundraising, major or principal gifts, impact investing, philanthropic advising, wealth management, family office, or climate and clean energy finance roles.
  • Proven record of successfully soliciting multiple gifts of $100K or more annually.
  • Demonstrated success in building, cultivating, and soliciting a pipeline of both new and repeat donors.  
  • Demonstrated ability to strategically manage and track a portfolio of prospects and donors. 
  • Strong record of effective partnership with executives and senior leaders in fast-paced, data-driven environments.
  • Experience working in or with a nonprofit organization required; experience at an impact investment firm, family office, or foundation will also be considered.
  • Experience working alongside or within the finance, technology, impact investing, or family office sectors strongly preferred.
  • Demonstrated executive presence and the confidence to engage peer-to-peer with sophisticated investors and high-net-worth donors.  
  • Experience in the environment, climate, energy, sustainable finance, impact investing, or related fields required. 
  • Proven experience with legacy and planned giving preferred.
  • Willingness and ability to travel, primarily in New York and the Northeast US 20-25% of the time.
  • Knowledge of RMI’s mission and objectives and the principles and practices of non-profit organizations.  
  • Strong communication skills, both verbal and written.  
  • Ability to establish and maintain effective working relationships with RMI staff, Board members, community groups, and other associated agencies.  
  • Able to navigate and understand a complicated funding environment with the flexibility to change course quickly, with a positive attitude.

Candidates with strong experience in client-facing business development or impact investing in clean energy (instead of traditional frontline fundraising experience) are encouraged to apply.  


Applications will be reviewed on a rolling basis, with full review beginning in January 2027.   


Visa Sponsorship

Please note: At this time, RMI is not able to sponsor employment visas or hire candidates who require visa sponsorship to work in the United States. All candidates must have current, independent authorization to work in the U.S. without present or future sponsorship from RMI. We will update our hiring pages if this status changes.


Location

We are a remote-ready company with team members around the globe. Our beautiful and welcoming offices are available for meetings or focused work, whether you are traveling through or living nearby. Our U.S. offices are in New York City; Washington DC; Oakland, California; Boulder, Colorado, and Basalt, Colorado. While this role can be located from anywhere in the continental United States, there is a strong preference for this person to be based in the New York City region.


We provide you with the essential IT equipment plus a one-time home technology payment and a monthly work from home/commuter allowance to ensure you have a comfortable home office set up and necessary supplies.


We love seeing each other in person! We occasionally gather for shared time together like retreats and learning experiences. Be ready to travel for occasional in-person meetings (and of course, we cover travel costs).


Compensation   

At RMI, we prioritize fairness in our pay practices. Salaries are determined based on a mix of experience, market benchmarks, and internal equity across similar roles. The salary range of this position is $115,670-$133,000. New hires typically start toward the lower end of the range, depending on experience and alignment with the role’s scope. In addition to base salary, this position includes an annual bonus target of 10% and eligibility for merit-based increases, which are tied to both individual and organizational performance.

  

Benefits:    

We offer an array of benefits including:

  • Medical, dental, vision insurance

  • Optional voluntary life, AD&D and accident plans

  • Potential for bonuses and merit increases
  • Discount marketplace (gym memberships, pet insurance, etc.)
  • Hybrid / remote work options
  • Team retreats and geographic meetups
  • Rewards and recognition programs

  

Diversity         

We know that the diversity of our teams makes us stronger as an organization, and RMI is dedicated to the principles of equal employment opportunity as outlined in U.S. federal law. We prohibit discrimination against applicants, interns, and employees on the basis of any legally recognized basis, including but not limited to: age (40 and over), race, color, sex, pregnancy (including lactation, childbirth, or related medical conditions), religion, national origin, ancestry, physical or mental disability, genetic information (including testing and characteristics), sexual orientation, gender expression/identity, uniformed service member status, veteran status, citizenship status, or any other applicable status protected by applicable law.

jobs.title: Vulnerability Management Manager (Virtual, US)
jobs.description:
About Avaya

Avaya is an enterprise software leader that helps the world’s largest organizations and government agencies forge unbreakable connections.

The Avaya Infinity™ platform unifies fragmented customer experiences, connecting the channels, insights, technologies, and workflows that together create enduring customer and employee relationships.

We believe success is built through strong connections – with each other, with our work, and with our mission. At Avaya, you'll find a community that values your contributions and supports your growth every step of the way.

Learn more at

Job Description

Reduce Risk. Accelerate Remediation. Strengthen Security.

Are you passionate about reducing cybersecurity risk, improving vulnerability remediation, and leading teams that strengthen enterprise security? Do you believe in proactive risk management, operational excellence, and using actionable security intelligence to drive measurable improvements? We’re looking for a Vulnerability Management Lead to help advance vulnerability management and remediation across the cloud environments that support our applications and services.

The Opportunity

As a Vulnerability Management Lead, you’ll lead a team of vulnerability management engineers responsible for identifying, tracking, prioritizing, and driving vulnerabilities through remediation to resolution. You’ll collaborate with application owners, infrastructure teams, vendor managers, and security partners to reduce exposure, accelerate remediation timelines, and strengthen the security posture of a SaaS cloud environment supporting Unified Communications (UC) services.

You’ll help align vulnerability remediation with enterprise security standards, risk management objectives, and BOD 26-04 requirements. Working across security operations, application engineering, and infrastructure teams, you’ll use vulnerability intelligence, security monitoring, and risk metrics to identify gaps, improve processes, and drive measurable reductions in technology risk.

This role is ideal for a security leader who enjoys solving complex technical challenges, coordinating cross-functional teams, improving operational effectiveness, and building repeatable processes that deliver lasting security improvements.

Your Mission-Critical Responsibilities

Vulnerability Management & Remediation: Lead the identification, tracking, prioritization, and remediation of infrastructure and application vulnerabilities. Maintain visibility into the vulnerability portfolio and drive findings through resolution within established remediation timelines.

Team Leadership & Workload Management: Lead and develop the vulnerability management engineering team. Establish priorities, balance workloads, coordinate assignments, and provide technical guidance to support timely and effective remediation.

Risk Management & Compliance: Drive remediation activities aligned with enterprise risk requirements, security policies, and BOD 26-04 obligations. Partner with application owners, vendor managers, and risk stakeholders to resolve vulnerabilities within required time frames.

Security Operations & Incident Response: Represent infrastructure vulnerability management during incident calls involving application vulnerabilities. Coordinate escalations, communicate remediation status, and collaborate with security teams to address emerging risks and operational concerns.

Vulnerability Intelligence & Threat Analysis: Monitor industry trends, emerging vulnerabilities, threat intelligence, and adversary techniques to assess potential organizational impact. Apply knowledge of common attack vectors, intrusion techniques, and the MITRE ATT&CK framework to support vulnerability prioritization and risk reduction.

Security Monitoring & Technical Analysis: Leverage vulnerability assessment tools, SIEM platforms, network traffic analysis, and security event correlation to investigate findings, validate remediation progress, and identify potential security gaps.

Risk Metrics & Executive Reporting: Develop, maintain, and quality-assure monthly vulnerability and risk metrics for management and executive stakeholders. Provide clear visibility into remediation progress, outstanding risks, compliance status, and opportunities for continued improvement.

Process Engineering & Continuous Improvement: Identify gaps in vulnerability management processes, compliance controls, and operational workflows. Develop and implement improvements that strengthen remediation accountability, improve efficiency, and reduce recurring security issues.

Documentation & Knowledge Management: Create and maintain team processes, procedures, operational standards, and training documentation. Ensure vulnerability management practices are consistent, repeatable, and aligned with enterprise security objectives.

Training & Team Development: Support onboarding, training, and ongoing development of vulnerability management engineers. Promote knowledge sharing, technical consistency, and effective collaboration across cybersecurity and infrastructure teams.

Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with application engineering, infrastructure operations, security operations, vendor management, and risk teams to resolve technical and process-related challenges and maintain accurate vulnerability records in the system of record.

Operational Excellence & Technology Evolution: Evaluate emerging security tools, assessment methodologies, and industry practices to improve vulnerability detection, remediation workflows, and overall security program effectiveness.

What You Bring to the Team

  • The Security Leader: Demonstrated ability to lead vulnerability management engineers, coordinate remediation activities, balance team workloads, and drive accountability across technical teams.
  • The Vulnerability Management Expert: Hands-on experience with cybersecurity tools and technologies such as Qualys, Nessus, and Symantec, including vulnerability assessment, prioritization, tracking, and remediation.
  • The Risk Management Mindset: Understanding of enterprise risk management, vulnerability remediation requirements, security controls, and compliance frameworks, including BOD 26-04, NIST CSF, NIST SP 800-53, ISO 27001, and PCI DSS ASV.
  • The Threat Intelligence Foundation: Knowledge of common attack vectors, adversary tactics and techniques, threat intelligence, security hardening, and the MITRE ATT&CK framework.
  • The Security Operations Toolkit: Experience with Security Information and Event Management (SIEM) platforms, including Splunk, security event correlation, monitoring programs, and investigation of security-related issues.
  • The Technical Troubleshooter: Ability to investigate complex security, network, system, and application issues; analyze network traffic and packets; and identify practical solutions to vulnerability and remediation challenges.
  • The Compliance and Reporting Partner: Experience maintaining vulnerability records, preparing risk metrics, supporting management reporting, and communicating remediation status and exposure to technical and executive stakeholders.
  • The Process Improvement Driver: Ability to identify operational gaps, develop actionable solutions, establish repeatable processes, and build roadmaps that align vulnerability management activities with broader cybersecurity operations goals.
  • The Collaborative Communicator: Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to coordinate across teams, manage competing priorities, communicate technical findings, and drive remediation through resolution.
  • The Technical Foundation: A bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Cybersecurity, or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education and relevant experience.
  • The Operationally Ready Professional: Ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines, work independently and collaboratively, and participate in after-hours and weekend on-call rotations as business needs require.

Extra Credit (The Nice-to-Haves)

  • Security Certifications: Industry-recognized cybersecurity certifications such as CompTIA Security+, CISSP, GIAC certifications, or GCIH.
  • Cloud Security & Risk Assessment: Experience with cloud enterprise security tools, risk assessment methodologies, security controls, and vulnerability management in SaaS or other cloud-based environments.
  • Security Proxy & Network Analysis: Experience with URL filtering, web proxy technologies, network troubleshooting, packet analysis, and network security controls.
  • Executive Reporting & Visualization: Demonstrated experience developing management presentations, executive dashboards, and operational reporting using tools such as PowerPoint and Visio.
  • Regulatory & Compliance Expertise: Familiarity with vulnerability remediation mandates, security compliance requirements, and enterprise risk reporting, particularly BOD 26-04
  • Operational Excellence: A track record of improving remediation timelines, reducing outstanding vulnerabilities, strengthening compliance, and delivering measurable reductions in security risk over time.

Why Join Us?

Meaningful Security Challenges: Help protect cloud-based Unified Communications services by reducing vulnerabilities and strengthening enterprise security.

Security Leadership & Impact: Lead a team of engineers and collaborate across application, infrastructure, and security organizations to drive measurable improvements in risk reduction.

Data-Driven Risk Management: Use vulnerability intelligence, security monitoring, and executive metrics to prioritize remediation and improve security decision-making.

Continuous Improvement: Shape vulnerability management processes, strengthen compliance practices, and implement solutions that improve operational efficiency and security outcomes.

Collaborative Cybersecurity Operations: Work with cross-functional teams to resolve complex technical challenges, improve remediation accountability, and advance cybersecurity operations.

A Culture of Operational Excellence: Help establish scalable, repeatable vulnerability management practices that support a more secure, resilient, and compliant cloud environment.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Cybersecurity, or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education and relevant experience.
  • 6+ years of relevant IT or cybersecurity experience.
  • 5+ years of security experience with hands-on exposure to cybersecurity products such as Qualys, Symantec, or Nessus.
  • 3+ years of experience with Security Information and Event Management (SIEM) platforms.
  • 3+ years of experience supporting or analyzing adversary tactics and techniques using the MITRE ATT&CK framework.
  • Knowledge of cybersecurity standards and frameworks, including ISO 27001, NIST CSF, NIST SP 800-53, PCI DSS ASV, and BOD 26-04.
  • Strong written and verbal communication, organizational, analytical, and problem-solving skills.
  • Ability to coordinate multiple initiatives, manage competing priorities, and drive remediation activities across cross-functional teams.
  • Ability to support after-hours and weekend on-call rotations as required.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Industry-recognized cybersecurity certification in one or more of the following: CompTIA Security+, CISSP, GIAC, or GCIH.
  • Experience with URL filtering, web proxy technologies, and troubleshooting.
  • Experience creating executive presentations, developing risk metrics, and supporting management reporting.
  • Demonstrated ability to improve vulnerability remediation timelines and deliver sustained, measurable reductions in organizational risk

The pay range for this opportunity is up to $193,869 in total compensation, inclusive of base salary and bonus. Actual total compensation will vary based on factors such as a candidate’s qualifications, skills, competencies, and relevant experience.

Job Description: 360° Video Recorder (Insta360 / GoPro MAX)

Role Type: Contractor
Location: Remote

About the Role

We are seeking individuals with access to compatible 360° or action cameras to capture immersive, high-quality third-person footage in real-world environments. Recordings will support AI training and include everyday activities, movement through different environments, vehicle navigation, and animal-mounted POV scenarios.

Camera Requirements

Applicants must own or have access to a compatible camera with:

  • Minimum 170° field of view (FOV).
  • Minimum recording resolution of 720p.
  • Support for 360° capture or reframing.

Compatible cameras include:

  • Insta360 (any model)
  • DJI Osmo 360
  • GoPro MAX / MAX2
  • Other cameras meeting the minimum requirements.

Mounting Equipment

Required equipment may include:

  • Rigid backpack, harness, or third-person mounting rig with an extension arm.
  • Secure vehicle camera mount for driving-related recordings.

Owning compatible mounting equipment is an advantage but not mandatory. Reasonable costs for required mounting hardware may be reimbursed.

Recording Requirements

  • Mount the camera above and behind the body, angled slightly downward.
  • Keep the entire body consistently visible during normal movement.
  • Capture surrounding environments and natural activities.
  • Record a variety of indoor and outdoor activities.
  • Securely mount the camera during vehicle navigation tasks.
  • Ensure each continuous clip is at least 60 seconds long.
  • Record at a minimum resolution of 720p.
  • Follow all recording, quality, and safety instructions.

Note: Handheld selfie sticks, chest mounts, shoulder clips, and stationary tripods do not meet the required third-person perspective.

Compensation

  • Rate: $20 per hour of approved video (PPT).
  • Payment is based on the duration of footage that passes quality review and is accepted.

Start Timeline & Availability

Immediate availability is preferred. Start dates may depend on the delivery time of required equipment to your location.

jobs.title: 🇩🇪 Product Engineer / Entwickler (100% Remote) – Deutsch fließend
jobs.candidate_required_location: Bulgaria, Croatia, Czechia, Egypt, Estonia, Hungary, Latvia, Lithuania, Morocco, Romania, Serbia, Slovakia, Slovenia, Tunisia
jobs.description:
In den meisten Firmen bekommt ein Entwickler ein Ticket, baut es und nimmt sich das nächste. Mit dem Kunden hat jemand anderes geredet, was gebaut wird, hat jemand anderes entschieden, und ob es am Ende geholfen hat, fragt keiner.

Wir suchen Entwickler, die die ganze Arbeit machen wollen: mit den Leuten reden, die die Software nutzen, entscheiden, was gebaut wird, es bauen und dranbleiben, bis es für sie funktioniert. Das meinen wir mit Product Engineer. Den Begriff haben wir von PostHog, die ihn in ihrem Product Engineer Handbook gut beschreiben.

Unsere Kunden sind Hausverwaltungen in Deutschland. Du sprichst direkt mit ihnen, deshalb ist fließendes Deutsch für diese Stelle Pflicht.

Über uns

ist Software für Hausverwaltungen in Deutschland. Inbox, CRM, Dokumente, Telefonie, Videocalls, Team-Chat und KI-Agenten in einer Plattform, damit Hausverwalter ihre tägliche Arbeit an einem Ort erledigen. Wir sind ein kleines Team mit Sitz in Worms und arbeiten komplett remote. Wir finanzieren uns selbst und sind profitabel.

Was ein Product Engineer bei uns macht

  • Du redest mit Kunden. Du liest die Supportanfragen und das Feedback zu deinem Bereich, schaust dir an, wie Kunden ihn nutzen, und sprichst direkt mit ihnen, auf Deutsch. Niemand filtert das für dich.

  • Du entscheidest, was gebaut wird. Für deinen Bereich legst du fest, was als Nächstes kommt, nach dem, was Kunden brauchen und was für die Firma wichtig ist. Du schreibst auf, warum, damit das Team folgen und Feedback geben kann.

  • Du lieferst früh. Die erste Version geht an ein paar Kunden, sobald sie nützlich ist. Dann verbesserst du sie nach dem, was sie sagen und tun.

  • Du baust alles. Datenmodell, Backend, Frontend und UI. Das Ergebnis muss aufgeräumt, einfach und verständlich sein, nicht nur funktionieren.

  • Du machst den Support für deinen Bereich. Wenn etwas kaputt ist oder ein Kunde nicht weiterkommt, behebst du es und sagst ihm Bescheid.

  • Du prüfst, ob es funktioniert hat. Deine Arbeit ist nicht fertig, wenn das Feature live ist. Du schaust, ob Kunden es nutzen und ob es ihr Problem gelöst hat.

  • Du automatisierst, was geht. Wenn ein Kunde eine Supportfrage stellt, trägst du die Antwort in unsere Wissensdatenbank ein und passt unseren internen Agenten an, damit es beim nächsten Mal von selbst läuft. Vieles läuft bei uns schon automatisch, Bugfixes werden bereits halbautomatisch bearbeitet, und wir automatisieren weiter.

Beispiele, woran du arbeiten könntest

  • Ein Kunde will seine alte Dateiablage in unsere Dokumentenverwaltung holen, mit eigener Ordnerstruktur und tausenden Dokumenten, schnell und mit KI-Unterstützung. Du schaust dir an, wie er seine Dateien sortiert hat, baust den Import als allgemeines Feature für alle Kunden, richtest ihn für ihn ein und testest ihn mit seiner Ordnerstruktur. Danach prüfst du, ob die KI jedes Dokument dem richtigen Gebäude, der richtigen Wohnung oder dem richtigen Kontakt zugeordnet hat, und korrigierst, was nicht passt.

  • Ein Kunde meldet, dass der Inbox-Agent einem Mieter eine falsche Antwort gegeben hat. Du schaust dir an, was der Agent gemacht hat, korrigierst das Tool oder seine Anweisungen und gibst dem Kunden Bescheid.

  • Nur wenige Kunden bauen eigene Agenten in der Sandbox. Du findest heraus, warum, über die Daten und Gespräche mit Kunden, machst die Einrichtung einfacher und prüfst, ob danach mehr Kunden sie nutzen.

  • Hausverwalter machen dieselbe Aufgabe fünfzigmal am Tag und brauchen dafür zu viele Klicks. Du merkst das, redest mit ihnen darüber, wie sie arbeiten, und machst es schneller.

Unser Tech-Stack

Alles ist TypeScript, vom Datenbankschema bis zum Frontend.

Backend: Convex (Datenbank & Serverless Functions)

Frontend: Next.js, React, Tailwind, shadcn/ui

Agenten: Vercel AI SDK, LiveKit für Telefonie

Du baust mit Claude und bekommst so viele KI-Tokens, wie du brauchst.

Gehalt

  • 1.500 – 3.000 $ pro Monat brutto, mit Luft nach oben in den nächsten Monaten und Jahren

  • Unbefristeter Arbeitsvertrag in deinem Wohnland über unseren Partner Deel (EOR)

Benefits

  • 100 % remote

  • Flexible Arbeitszeiten

  • Selbst finanziert und profitabel, kein Investorengeld, das verbrannt werden muss

  • Kleines Team, was du baust, geht live

  • Schnelle Entscheidungen, keine unnötigen Meetings und keine Freigabeschleifen

Unser Gesundheitsprogramm

  • Einzelzimmer im Krankenhaus, weltweiter Schutz

  • Freie Arzt- und Facharztwahl, keine Gesundheitsprüfung, Vorerkrankungen spielen keine Rolle

  • Partner und Kinder sind mitversichert

  • Operationen, Krebsbehandlung, MRT/CT/PET und Diagnostik voll abgedeckt

  • Zahnbehandlung und Zahn-OP zu 90 % abgedeckt

  • 675 $ pro Jahr für Physiotherapie, Osteopathie, Chiropraktik und Akupunktur

  • 100 $ Krankenhaustagegeld pro Nacht, bis zu 20 Nächte

  • Medikamente, Impfungen, Brillen/Kontaktlinsen, häusliche Pflege und Krankentransport abgedeckt

Unsere Grundprinzipien

  • Speed of Implementation: Wir setzen schnell um. Eine erste Version geht früh live und wird mit dem Feedback der Kunden besser.

  • Radikale Ehrlichkeit: Wir sagen offen, was ist, im Team und gegenüber unseren Kunden. Gerade dann, wenn es unangenehm ist.

  • Hohe Ansprüche an die eigene Arbeit und an die der anderen

Requirements

Voraussetzungen

  • Fließendes Deutsch (mindestens C1), du kannst mit Kunden telefonieren und schreiben

  • Gutes Englisch

  • Mehr als ein Jahr Erfahrung mit Code, der produktiv im Einsatz ist

Worauf wir achten

  • Dir ist wichtiger, dass Kunden ihre Arbeit erledigt bekommen, als die perfekte Umsetzung.

  • Du hast ein gutes Auge für Gestaltung und UI. Du lieferst nicht einfach, was die KI erzeugt, sondern arbeitest an der Oberfläche, bis sie aufgeräumt und für die Nutzer so einfach und verständlich wie möglich ist.

  • Du machst Dinge fertig. Ein Feature, das zu 80 % fertig ist, hilft niemandem, deshalb bleibst du dran, bis es gut funktioniert.

  • Du hast eine Meinung dazu, was gebaut werden soll, und begründest sie mit dem, was Kunden sagen und tun. Wenn das Feedback etwas anderes sagt, änderst du deine Meinung.

  • Du nimmst Feedback gut an und gibst selbst ehrliches Feedback.

  • Du schreibst klar. Als Remote-Team arbeiten wir viel schriftlich: Issues, kurze Vorschläge, PR-Beschreibungen.

  • Du verstehst die Grundlagen des Geschäfts: wer unsere Kunden sind, wofür sie zahlen und warum sie bleiben.

  • Du schreibst fast deinen gesamten Code mit KI und verstehst Architektur gut genug, um zu beurteilen, was sie schreibt.

  • Du automatisierst eine Aufgabe lieber, als sie zweimal zu machen.

  • Du bist Generalist und lernst schnell Neues.

Schön zu haben

  • Du hast ein eigenes Produkt oder Nebenprojekt gebaut, das echte Menschen genutzt haben, oder schon direkt mit Kunden gearbeitet.

  • Erfahrung mit Datenbankdesign und der Optimierung von Abfragen nach Geschwindigkeit und Kosten

  • Erfahrung mit Agenten, Queues und lang laufenden Workflows im Produktivbetrieb

Die Stelle passt nicht zu dir, wenn

  • du willst, dass jemand anderes entscheidet, was du baust, und dir Tickets gibt

  • du lieber nichts mit Kunden oder Support zu tun haben willst

  • du Code wochenlang polieren willst, bevor ihn jemand sieht

  • du gern zur nächsten Idee springst, bevor die letzte wirklich funktioniert

So stellen wir ein

  1. Kennenlerngespräch

  2. Interview mit unserem Gründer über deinen Werdegang und das, was du gebaut hast

  3. Referenzgespräch mit einer früheren Führungskraft

  4. Angebot

Mehr über das, was wir bauen, siehst du auf unserem YouTube-Kanal.

  4. Apply your knowledge of Mexican Spanish vocabulary, idioms, slang, colloquialisms, indigenismos (such as chamba, cuate, chido, güey, and words of Nahuatl origin like aguacate and tianguis), code-switching (such as Spanglish and Spanish mixing with indigenous languages), and spelling to enhance the linguistic accuracy of project data.

We practice transparency in everything we do, including compensation. The salary range for this position reflects our commitment to fair, competitive pay based on your qualifications, experience, skills, education, and location. Together, we'll find the right fit for your expertise and our shared mission.

Job Summary

The Director, Commercial Process & GTM Technology is responsible for defining and advancing WCG’s future-state selling motion and the technology-enabled processes that support the complete lead-to-cash and customer relationship lifecycle. The role positions Salesforce.com not simply as a customer relationship management system or source of truth for sales activity, but as the foundational platform within an integrated commercial technology ecosystem.

This leader owns the vision, governance, roadmap, adoption, and continuous improvement of Salesforce.com while working across Commercial, Marketing, Finance, Legal, Operations, Information Technology, and other stakeholders to connect customer engagement, opportunity management, forecasting, contracting, and downstream commercial processes. The role will establish an end-to-end operating model that uses Salesforce.com, Gong, WCG’s contract lifecycle management solution, and other go-to-market technologies to improve visibility, consistency, user experience, decision-making, and execution across the customer journey.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES/RESPONSIBILITIES: To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty and responsibility satisfactorily. The accountabilities listed below are representative of the knowledge, skills, and/or ability required.

  • Develop and maintain the future-state vision, strategy, and multi-year roadmap for WCG’s selling motion, commercial processes, and go-to-market technology ecosystem.
  • Position Salesforce.com as the foundational commercial platform within the end-to-end lead-to-cash and customer relationship lifecycle, connecting business processes and information across customer engagement, opportunity management, forecasting, contracting, and post-sale handoffs.
  • Own Salesforce.com product strategy, platform governance, system roadmap, release priorities, data standards, user experience, adoption, and ongoing optimization for the Commercial organization.
  • Lead the design, standardization, documentation, and continuous improvement of scalable commercial processes that support how WCG identifies, engages, develops, forecasts, contracts, wins, and transitions customer opportunities.
  • Define the integrated operating model for customer engagement using Gong and other relevant tools, including expectations for capturing customer interactions, insights, risks, commitments, and next actions.
  • Advance opportunity management by aligning Salesforce.com and Gong workflows, data, and user practices to create consistent visibility into opportunity health, progression, stakeholder engagement, and required actions.
  • Partner with Commercial and Finance leadership to strengthen forecasting processes and fully leverage Gong forecasting capabilities, supported by clear definitions, governance, cadence, and accountability.
  • Collaborate with WCG’s Legal team to fully leverage the contract lifecycle management solution and improve visibility, workflow alignment, status transparency, and data continuity from opportunity development through contracting.
  • Identify and resolve process, data, integration, and workflow gaps across the commercial technology ecosystem, with a focus on reducing manual work, duplicate entry, disconnected handoffs, and inconsistent user practices.
  • Establish governance forums and decision rights for commercial process and technology priorities, coordinating requirements and tradeoffs across Commercial, Marketing, Finance, Legal, Operations, and Information Technology.
  • Translate business strategy and user needs into process designs, platform requirements, implementation priorities, acceptance criteria, and measurable outcomes.
  • Develop and monitor adoption, data quality, process compliance, pipeline, forecasting, cycle-time, and user-experience measures to identify trends and improvement opportunities.
  • Lead change management, stakeholder communication, training strategy, and reinforcement activities required to embed new commercial processes and technology capabilities.
  • Maintain a disciplined intake and prioritization process for enhancements, defects, integrations, reporting needs, and new capabilities, balancing strategic value, business risk, user impact, and delivery capacity.
  • Partner with technology teams and external providers to ensure solutions are scalable, secure, supportable, and aligned with enterprise architecture and data governance expectations.
  • Serve as a strategic advisor to Commercial leadership on selling-process design, commercial technology capabilities, and opportunities to improve effectiveness across the customer lifecycle.
  • Lead by example, fostering a culture of accountability, collaboration, innovation, customer focus, and continuous improvement.
  • Other duties as assigned by supervisor. These may, on occasion, be unrelated to the position described here.

EDUCATION REQUIREMENTS:

  • Bachelor’s degree in business, information systems, technology, data, life sciences, or a related field required; advanced degree preferred.

CERTIFICATIONS/LICENSE/REGISTRATION REQUIREMENTS:

  • Salesforce certification preferred; relevant product management, process improvement, change management, or commercial operations certification is a plus.

QUALIFICATIONS/EXPERIENCE:

  • Minimum of 10 years of progressive experience in commercial operations, revenue operations, sales operations, business process transformation, product management, or go-to-market technology.
  • Demonstrated experience defining and implementing end-to-end lead-to-cash, opportunity-to-contract, or customer lifecycle processes in a complex, matrixed organization.
  • Deep functional knowledge of Salesforce.com, including platform governance, roadmap management, data quality, adoption, reporting, integrations, and workflow design.
  • Experience using Gong or a comparable revenue intelligence platform for customer engagement, opportunity management, and forecasting.
  • Experience partnering with Legal and business stakeholders on contract lifecycle management processes and technology.
  • Ability to think beyond individual systems and design an integrated commercial operating model across process, data, technology, governance, and user behavior.
  • Proven ability to translate commercial strategy and business needs into clear process designs, platform requirements, priorities, and executable roadmaps.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to use data and business insights to evaluate performance, diagnose root causes, and guide decisions.
  • Demonstrated success leading cross-functional transformation, influencing senior stakeholders, and driving adoption without relying solely on direct authority.
  • Excellent written, verbal, facilitation, and executive communication skills, with the ability to make complex process and technology concepts clear to varied audiences.
  • Experience in clinical research, life sciences, healthcare services, or another complex business-to-business services environment preferred.
  • High attention to detail with the ability to manage multiple priorities, dependencies, and deadlines in a dynamic environment.

SUPERVISORY RESPONSIBILITIES: Overall responsibility of management including direction, coordination, performance, and evaluation of the assigned team and staff. Responsibilities include training employees; planning, assigning, and directing work; appraising performance; rewarding and disciplining employees; addressing complaints and resolving problems.

jobs.title: Senior Media Buyer
jobs.description:
PLEASE NOTE THIS ROLE IS FOR OVERSEAS APPLICATION, NON -U.S. ONLY. NO DOMESTIC (U.S.) APPLICATIONS WILL BE CONSIDERED.

About the role:

Senior Media Buyer in the User Acquisition team, reporting to the Director of User Acquisition. Meta is our biggest acquisition channel, with a seven-figure monthly budget.

We are growing the UA team and adding a media buyer who will lead a project we care about a lot: building the best buying automation in the industry. We want the machine to handle the whole routine, pacing, scaling, kills, alerts, reporting, so the team's time goes to tests and growth. Meta first; the same approach then extends to our other channels.

You will buy on Meta alongside the team, and on top of that you own the automation roadmap. You map the routine, decide what to automate next, write the spec, and an engineer builds it. You test what comes back on the live account, accept it or send it back, and keep the logic current when the market or the offer changes. As the routine moves to the machine, you and the team put that time into experiments: new structures, audiences, offers, landing pages, creative angles.

What You'll Be Responsible For:

  • Buy on Meta as part of the team: run your share of campaigns against ROI and spend targets.
  • Lead the automation project: budget pacing, scaling and kill rules, alerts, reporting. Turn each piece of the routine into a clear spec for the engineer, test the result, and flag it when a rule breaks.
  • Help the team adopt the tools: show how they work, take their feedback, improve them.
  • Run a steady pipeline of tests: campaign structure, bidding, audiences, offers, landing pages. Set them up so the result is readable, and tell a real effect from noise.
  • Answer day-to-day data questions yourself in Mixpanel and with AI tools, and work with our analytics team on deeper research.
  • Keep tracking healthy: pixel, CAPI, event setup, attribution, and how Meta numbers match our internal data.

What You'll Need To Have:

  • 4+ years of hands-on Meta buying with large budgets (ideally $500K+/month), subscription or DTC e-commerce.
  • You have taken a buying account from manual to automated before, and you can show what was built and what it replaced. You know what is possible with the Marketing API, rules engines (Meta rules, Revealbot, Madgicx), scripts and AI agents. Coding is not required: you write specs an engineer can build from without guessing.
  • Comfortable with Mixpanel or similar product analytics and with spreadsheets. You use AI tools (ChatGPT, Claude or similar) every day for analysis and routine tasks.
  • You think in ROI, CPA and LTV, and you can explain why a number moved.
  • Fluent English. Russian is a strong plus.
  • Nice to have: experience with other channels (TikTok, Snapchat, AppLovin, Google), landing page and funnel A/B testing, launching new markets, reading a script (Python, JS) and seeing what it does

What We'll Love About You

  • You like running your own project: give you a goal, and you come back with a plan, results and the next ideas.
  • You bring your own ideas every week, without waiting for a task.
  • When you see the same task done by hand twice, you start thinking about how to automate it.

What You'll Love About Us

  • Competitive base compensation
  • Bonus program
  • Paid Time Off and Work From Home
  • A fun, creative and energetic work environment

About Scentbird

Scentbird inspires fragrance lovers to go beyond the ordinary and sample scents that evoke passion, confidence, and the unknown. Our mission is to revolutionize the way we perfume by bringing the ultimate fragrance playground right to your fingertips and offering a digital subscription service that lets members choose from over 500+ designer perfumes each month.

About the Brands:

  • Scentbird: The easiest way for fragrance lovers to discover, try, and buy their favorite scented products without a commitment
  • Deck of Scarlet: Deck of Scarlet is on a mission to break the clean category, redefining what clean fragrances should smell like. Composed entirely of vegan, cruelty-free ingredients, our fragrances bridge the gap between the clean and luxury categories, using the highest eau de parfum concentrations housed in sculptural, eye-catching bottles. You shouldn’t have to choose between being luxe and refined, or clean and vegan—now, you don’t have to.
  • Confessions Of A Rebel: We were born in 2018, holding fast to the idea that the fragrance industry was in dire need of a change. When we looked around, all we saw was a sea of sameness: outdated archetypes of femininity and masculinity paired with unrelatable images of luxury that we had no say in. In truth, we are complex in ways that cannot be contained in the traditional heteronormative stereotypes, existing beyond the binary with raw, unfiltered voices that deserve to be heard.
  • Goodhabit: Enriched with a blend of essential oils, Goodhabit’s clean, vegan, cruelty-free fragrances act as bottled intentions you set free with each mist. Our scents are designed to help you align with the good habits you’re building, while working to enhance and boost your mood. Inhale, exhale, and let the good energy flow through you.
  • Sanctuary: Created for those who care about the fate of our planets, Sanctuary offers fragrance for a better future. Our clean, community-driven fragrances are inspired by endangered species and their habitats, each aimed at raising money and awareness for the preservation of their namesake.
  • Drift: Drift began as an alternative to all of the tacky air care products on the market. Our products are designed to blend in, with amazing scents that stand out. We take pride in our fragrances, keeping them free from the traditional chemicals used in the fragrance industry. We are always phthalate and paraben free. We never skimp on quality of our scents or the products that deliver them. Our design ethos is simple but effective. We love our community, those who won’t settle for ordinary, and we want to deliver a best in class experience.

Scentbird is committed to bringing individuals from different backgrounds and perspectives into the Nest. We strive to uphold an inclusive environment where individuals of all different backgrounds, ages, colors, ethnicities, gender, or gender identities, genetics, physical or mental abilities, protected veteran status, race, religious or sexual orientation, thrive. jobs.description:
Job Description

Required Certificates and Licenses

  • Appropriate state Department of Education Licensure in area of Visual Impairments or related field Required

Residency Requirements

  • This position is virtual and open to residents of the 50 states and Washington, D.C.

This is an Independent Consultant position (1099) that is a Part-Time Monday-Friday between the hours of 8am and 5pm

K12, a Stride Company, believes in Education for ANY ONE. We provide families with an online option for a high-quality, personalized education experience. Students can thrive, find their passion, and learn in an environment that encourages discovery at their own pace.

Passionate Educators are needed at the Stride K12 program, Stride Therapy: Accelerating Growth for Every Student (STAGES). We want you to be a part of our talented team!


The STAGES Teacher of Students with Visual Impairments (TVI) -CONTRACTOR is a state certified teacher responsible for providing services to eligible special education students with visual impairments. The scope of services and supports provided by the teacher will be determined by the students’ Individualized Education Plans (IEPs). The teacher serves as a collaborative member of a team that supports students in a virtual academic environment.


The Teacher of Students with Visual Impairments (TVI) - Contractor may be asked to obtain licensure in multiple states and serve students across multiple schools.

ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS: Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential duties.

  • Ensure all assigned services are provided as determined by the IEP team by.
  • Communicating with parents and teachers to develop a schedule that encourages regular attendance and participation by the student
  • Developing progress reports and other state-specific required special education documentation
  • Using provided resources to ensure accommodations and modifications for students with disabilities such as assistive technology, supplemental curriculum, and accessible text are made available
  • Maintain compliance with state, school, and company regulations
  • Instruct students/families/teachers in the use of appropriate communication strategies and technologies for the purpose of minimizing the adverse educational impact of visual impairments and improving student success in the classroom
  • Serve as Teacher of Record (TOR) for assigned caseload
  • Maintain files and/or records using specified systems, e.g., progress reports, activity logs, treatment plans, reports, etc. for the purpose of ensuring the availability of information as required for reference and/or compliance
  • Collect data and work samples to monitor student progress toward Individual Education Program (IEP) goals and objectives
  • Document all contact with parents and interventions with students
  • Provide rich and engaging educational experiences for students
  • Commitment to personalizing learning for all students
  • Demonstrate a belief in all students’ ability to succeed and meet high expectations
  • Understand that a primary responsibility is to establish and maintain a positive rapport with families and regularly communicates with and responds to students and learning coaches/parents in a timely manner
  • Participates in meetings, workshops, and seminars for the purpose of conveying and/or gathering information
  • Develop and maintain positive relationships with students, caregivers, and school staff
  • Be available to students, caregivers, and staff during designated work hours
  • Work from a professional home office environment, conducive to video and audio needs and a structured schedule
  • Must be self-motivated, dependable, creative, and passionate about meeting the needs of students

Supervisory Responsibilities:

This position has no formal supervisory responsibilities.


MINIMUM REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS:

Minimum 2 years experience in public school environment as a Teacher of Students with Visual Impairments (TVI)


DESIRED QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Ability to work independently, with availability during typical school hours of at least 20 hours per week is required. Ability to maintain a professional home office without distraction during workday, typically 9 - 5 as defined by the school and time zone
  • Experience teaching in an online/virtual environment
  • Strong familiarity with assistive technology for those with visual impairments
  • Strong content and subject-matter knowledge
  • An ability to support and guide adults as well as students
  • Receptive to receiving coaching on a regular basis with administrators
  • Ability to embrace change and adapt to ensure excellent student outcomes
  • Ability to create and deliver staff development
  • Exceptionally strong verbal and written communication skills
  • Strong organizational and time management skills
  • Ability to rapidly learn and adapt to new technologies and teaching platforms
  • MS365 Proficient

jobs.title: Application Security Engineer
jobs.description:
Role Description

As part of the Product Security Engineering team, you’ll focus on reducing risk at scale by building the security infrastructure, automation, and tooling that empowers engineers to ship secure products with confidence. We work closely with engineering and product teams throughout the software development lifecycle (SDLC), embedding secure-by-default practices and delivering scalable solutions.

Product Security Engineers create impact by implementing security tooling, writing custom security rules, and building frameworks that address broad classes of vulnerabilities. In addition to proactive development, we support teams through threat modeling, documentation, and education to uplift security culture across Dropbox.

Our Engineering Career Framework is viewable by anyone outside the company and describes what’s expected for our engineers at each of our career levels. Check out our blog post on this topic and more here.

Responsibilities

  • Build and maintain security tools, automation, and libraries to enable secure-by-default development across engineering teams.
  • Design and implement custom security rules (e.g., Semgrep, CodeQL) to detect and prevent common and emerging vulnerability patterns.
  • Act as a subject matter expert on application security across web, mobile, and desktop environments.
  • Improve and scale the Secure Development Lifecycle (SDLC) by integrating tools, checks, and processes into engineering workflows.
  • Perform targeted code reviews, and develop follow-up tooling or controls to prevent regressions.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with engineering, product, GRC, and AI/ML teams to proactively address security risks, especially in fast-moving and emerging tech areas.

Many teams at Dropbox run Services with on-call rotations, which entails being available for calls during both core and non-core business hours. If a team has an on-call rotation, all engineers on the team are expected to participate in the rotation as part of their employment. Applicants are encouraged to ask for more details of the rotations to which the applicant is applying.

Requirements

  • 4+ years of experience in application security or security engineering roles.
  • Hands-on experience building or using security automation tools to improve developer workflows and product security.
  • Demonstrated ability to work across the SDLC, including supporting and interpreting findings from penetration tests and bug bounty reports.
  • Familiarity with modern tech stacks, including microservices, CI/CD pipelines, and cloud-native environments.
  • Solid understanding of common vulnerability classes (e.g., injection, XSS, authN/authZ issues) and practical mitigation strategies.
  • Comfortable working in cross-functional environments and supporting multiple product and engineering teams simultaneously.
  • Experience participating in or supporting incident response or security on-call rotations is a plus

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in application security engineering, with a strong focus on security tooling and automation.
  • Demonstrated ability to write and maintain custom security rules and integrate them into developer workflows.
  • Experience with machine learning systems, particularly generative AI, and the ability to support secure development in AI-driven products.
  • Experience developing internal libraries or frameworks that reduce or eliminate entire classes of vulnerabilities.
  • Proficient in software development, with experience contributing production-level code in one or more modern languages.
  • Familiarity with securing diverse application types, including web, mobile, and native platforms.
  • Experience with data security, including tooling for data protection, access control, and encryption.
  • Strong communication skills and ability to build trusted partnerships with cross-functional teams.

Durable Skills

AI fluency means using these tools to amplify human judgment, not replace it. We believe people with these skills will thrive as work and technology continue to evolve:

  • Awareness: Understand yourself and others.
  • Judgment: Evaluate information and make decisions in complex situations.
  • Adaptability: Learn, adjust, and stay effective through change.
  • Connection: Communicate, collaborate, and build trust.

To learn more about why these skills matter and what the data shows about thriving through change, read this blog post from our Chief People Officer, Melanie Rosenwasser.

jobs.description:
About Clipboard

Our mission is to uplift as many communities as possible. We do this through our app-based marketplace that connects healthcare professionals with the workplaces that need amazing workers. This enables hundreds of thousands of people to achieve financial stability for themselves and their families while providing essential care to millions of people across the U.S.

Founded in 2016, we are a remote-first team of over 1,000 people building a top Y-Combinator company and have been profitable since 2022. We’re the leader in Long-Term Care staffing and are rapidly expanding into Home Health, Hospitals, and more, meaning we have more work to do than people to do it, and are growing our team to support millions more people and their communities.

Overview

📍 Remote Global - Central and South America

We are seeking a WFM Central - Real Time Analyst to serve as the central governance layer for live operations across multiple Lines of Business (LoB). This is not a traditional monitoring role; it is designed for a high-caliber, forensic operator who functions as an operational architect. You will be a trusted partner to operational leadership, responsible for continuing to evolve our operations to a standardized, and fiscally sound control model.

The ideal candidate possesses the technical "know-how" of a forensic analyst and the communication prowess of a business consultant, capable of telling a compelling story through data to stakeholders ranging from Team Leads to Directors. You won't just report that a queue is at risk; you will diagnose the business impact, identify the root cause, and prescribe the specific levers leadership must pull to preserve SLA and the customer experience. You will be the owner of all aspects of the support queues and ensure we are meeting our customers where they need us.

Responsibilities

  • Stakeholder Storytelling: Distill complex, "noisy" operational signals into high-impact narratives. You must be able to share in-depth observations and supporting data that tell a clear story to stakeholders, at all levels of leadership, on exactly what actions must be taken.

  • Business-Level Analysis: Go beyond the "what" and the "why" to analyze long-term business trends. Evaluate the financial efficiency of SLA safeguarding and the fiscal impact of current staffing vs. demand density.

  • Operational Control & Forensic Auditing: Serve as the authoritative "voice of reason" during incidents. Conduct forensic audits of agent behaviors such as "On Hold" abuse or status irregularities to ensure hidden capacity drains are eliminated.

  • Centralized Core Governance: Enact queue management playbooks for real-time levers across multiple LoBs, ensuring aggressive SLAs are preserved through structured accountability.

  • Strategic Planning & Optimization: Partner with WFM to create a concise feedback loop for continued improvement in planning and scheduling.

Qualifications

  • Exceptional Communication: Proven ability to translate complex data into a clear jargon-free business story. You must be comfortable presenting actionable insights to senior leadership under high-pressure conditions.

  • Advanced Forensic Analysis: Expert proficiency in Google Sheets is required, familiarity with Metabase preferred. You must be able to build complex, automated tracking tools and forensic audits from scratch. Not just for basic queue health, but also analyzing business data that influences our operations.

  • Strategic Judgment: Demonstrated experience making high-judgment decisions that impact the entire business, particularly in environments with aggressive SLAs and fluctuating volume patterns.

  • Operational Architecture: Take ownership in documenting best practices into governed frameworks and playbooks.

  • Resilient Mindset: Comfortable operating autonomously in a 24/7 environment, with the flexibility to adapt to operational needs as part of a high-impact, interdependent team.

  • Systems Fluency: Familiarity with Amazon Connect, Zendesk Omnichannel routing, and Assembled WFM is highly preferred.

What Success Looks Like

  • Operational anomalies are quickly investigated, with root causes clearly identified and communicated, reducing repeat issues and leadership uncertainty

  • You evolve queue management processes from reactive to a documented, standardized, and predictive operating model.

  • Champion of the team’s brand with Operational Leadership. You are looked to as the primary source of truth, relying on your data-driven stories to make critical staffing and operational decisions.

  • Live queues remain stable, governed, and resilient across all supported lines of business, even during unexpected spikes, outages, or incidents

  • Stakeholders receive timely, clear updates during incidents that explain impact, cause, and corrective actions in a concise and actionable manner.

Hiring Process

  • Application

  • Intro Call with Recruiter

  • Case Study

  • Interview with Central WFM - RTA Team Lead

  • Interview with Queue Operations Manager - Core Services

  • Interview with Head of Core Services

  • Final Culture Interview with Executive Leadership

Quick Note on Scammers:

Clipboard would never ask you for money or your bank details to participate in our hiring process. Report any scammers impersonating the Clipboard hiring team members here.

Als Account Manager bouw je je eigen klantenportefeuille uit alsook ben je verantwoordelijk voor het opvolgen van onze bestaande klanten.

Je gaat actief op zoek en zorgt voor langetermijnrelaties. Dit nadat je een interne opleiding gekregen hebt, die jou laat groeien in jouw functie en dat allemaal door de collega’s en zaakvoerder!

Amplify helps teachers bring delight and rigor to students every day. We have become a leader in K–12 literacy, biliteracy, math, and science by building inspiring teaching and learning experiences based on research. The Amplify Classroom platform combines curriculum, assessment, and supplemental learning into one coherent high-quality instructional system. A pioneer in education since 2000, Amplify has developed deep relationships in states and districts by partnering with educators to drive implementation quality and improved outcomes. Today, Amplify serves more than 18 million students and teachers across all 50 states and on six continents. For more information, visit Amplify.com.

Job Description Summary:

Amplify seeks a Product Owner to partner with our Accounting and FP&A teams. This is an exciting opportunity to be part of a dynamic and growing team. As the Product Owner, you will be responsible for Record to Report, Revenue & FP&A product lifecycles, defining the product vision and strategy and driving product roadmap initiatives. This role will collaborate closely with Amplify leadership, business partners, business systems, and the development and integration teams to translate complex workflows and compliance requirements into intuitive product features that solve real-world problems and drive efficiencies in Finance Revenue Management, Closing activities, and FP&A business processes.

Essential Responsibilities:

  • Own the 'Record to Report' value chain by managing and ruthlessly prioritizing the product roadmap for NetSuite, BlackLine, and Pigment to align with enterprise goals and protect financial system investments.

  • Act as the primary Subject Matter Expert (SME) bridging technical accounting (e.g., ASC 606, month-end close, audit readiness) with system architecture, ensuring NetSuite Advanced Revenue Management (ARM), BlackLine, Zip, and Pigment comply with evolving accounting standards.

  • Collaborate with business analysts to detail business requirements and convert these requirements into clearly articulated epics and user stories following delivery team agreements around timing, design planning and solutioning timelines, according to a defined Agile framework
