jobs.title: Clinical Insights Solutions Lead, Data & Insights
jobs.description:
About WCG

WCG delivers transformational solutions that accelerate clinical research and advance human health. We serve the experts, innovators, and pathfinders on the frontlines of science and medicine—empowering them to develop breakthrough therapies while ensuring the risks of progress never outweigh the value of human life. Together, we stimulate growth, maximize efficiency, and shape the future of clinical trials.

Why WCG

At WCG, we invest in our people because you are the driving force behind our mission. When you grow, our impact grows. When you thrive, research accelerates. We empower you to build a meaningful career while advancing the work that improves lives.

What we offer:

Comprehensive health and financial protection – Medical, dental, vision, life and disability insurance, 401(k) with company match, and flexible spending accountsResources that support your whole life – Employee assistance programs and work/life balance toolsInvestment in your growth – Referral bonuses, tuition reimbursement, on-the-job training, certification assistance, and continuing education supportTime to recharge – Paid holidays, vacation, and sick timePathways forward – Career development opportunities across One WCG

We practice transparency in everything we do, including compensation. The salary range for this position reflects our commitment to fair, competitive pay based on your qualifications, experience, skills, education, and location. Together, we'll find the right fit for your expertise and our shared mission.

Job Summary

The Clinical Insights Solutions Lead, Data & Insights (D&I) serves as a strategic analytics partner throughout the commercial process, collaborating with Business Development to translate complex sponsor and CRO questions into rigorous, data-driven insights. The role evaluates study placement, site enrollment potential, and historical operational performance to develop defensible recommendations that strengthen WCG proposals and inform client decision-making.

This is a hands-on, client-facing analytical role. This position scopes and runs the analyses themselves: site targeting and site identification, operational performance benchmarking, protocol deep-dives, competitive trial landscape assessments, and enrolment feasibility modelling. They then present the findings directly to clients, translating methodology and its limits into language a clinical operations lead can act on.

The role partners closely with Business Development, Data & Insights delivery teams, product, and therapeutic subject matter experts to qualify client needs, position the right combination of data, analytics, and advisory services, and ensure the operational assumptions sold are the ones that hold up once the work is awarded.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES/RESPONSIBILITIES: To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty and responsibility satisfactorily. The accountabilities listed below are representative of the knowledge, skills, and/or ability required.

Solution Consulting & Client Engagement

  • Partners with Business Development to qualify client business and technical needs, then scopes the data, analytics, and advisory solution that answers them within the value and timeline of the opportunity.
  • Serves as the analytical voice in client meetings, capability presentations, product demonstrations, bid defenses, and strategic workshops, presenting findings and defending methodology under scrutiny.
  • Acts as subject matter expert on WCG’s data assets, analytical products, and consulting capabilities, and advises clients on which combination fits their question rather than defaulting to the largest scope.
  • Authors the data and insights content of proposals, RFI and RFP responses, and follow-up materials, ensuring the narrative and the numbers agree.

Site Targeting & Site Identification

  • Designs and executes site identification analyses, combining trial landscape data, investigator performance history, epidemiology, referral patterns, and site-level operational metrics.
  • Builds ranked, defensible site and country lists with explicit selection logic, so that internal teams and clients can see why a site made the list — and why others did not.
  • Assesses site capability against protocol-specific requirements (procedures, equipment, staffing, patient population, prior experience in the indication) rather than generic historical volume.
  • Flags concentration risk, competing-trial overlap, and over-solicited sites early enough to influence country allocation and enrolment assumptions.

Operational Performance & Benchmarking

  • Produces operational performance analyses — start-up cycle times, screen failure and dropout rates, enrolment rate distributions, query and deviation rates — benchmarked against comparable studies rather than portfolio-wide averages.
  • Applies and documents benchmarking methodology, including cohort selection, normalization, small-sample handling, and known sources of bias in the underlying data.
  • Diagnoses historical underperformance in analogous studies and converts those findings into specific, actionable mitigations in the proposed approach.
  • Maintains a reusable library of benchmarks, assumptions, and analytical templates so that recurring questions are answered consistently across opportunities.

Protocol Deep-Dives & Feasibility

  • Conducts protocol deep-dives that identify the design elements most likely to drive screen failures, site burden, patient dropout, or start-up delay, and quantify their impact where the data supports it.
  • Models the operational trade-offs of protocol alternatives — eligibility criteria, visit schedule, assessment burden, decentralized elements — to support protocol optimization conversations with clients.
  • Translates protocol requirements into enrolment models and realistic timeline scenarios, stating assumptions and confidence ranges explicitly rather than presenting single-point estimates.
  • Pressure-tests analytical conclusions with therapeutic, regulatory, and ethical review subject matter experts before they reach the client.

Data, Product & Continuous Improvement

  • Feeds gaps identified in live engagements back to Data Engineering and Product to improve the underlying data assets, tooling, and analytical workflows.
  • Documents methodology and maintains version control over analytical approaches so results are reproducible and auditable.
  • Conducts post-award and post-loss reviews of analytical assumptions, feeding what actually happened back into future models and benchmarks.
  • Coaches Business Development colleagues and junior analysts on framing analytical questions, interpreting outputs, and recognizing the limits of the evidence. Participates in webinars, podcasts, conference sessions, and published thought leadership as appropriate to share expertise with clients and the wider industry.
  • Other duties as assigned by supervisor, which may occasionally be unrelated to the position described here.

EDUCATION REQUIREMENTS:

  • Bachelor’s degree in life sciences, epidemiology, biostatistics, health economics, data science, or a related quantitative field is required
  • Advanced degree (MSc, MPH, MBA, PhD, PharmD) preferred

CERTIFICATIONS/LICENSE/REGISTRATION REQUIREMENTS:

  • ACRP/SOCRA, PMP, or a recognized data science or analytics certification preferred

QUALIFICATIONS/EXPERIENCE:

  • 5+ years of experience in clinical research, clinical trial intelligence, or healthcare data and analytics, with at least 3 years in a role centered on feasibility, site selection, operational analytics, or clinical data analysis
  • Demonstrated experience working directly with sponsor- or CRO-side stakeholders in a pre-sale, consultative, or advisory capacity
  • Practical familiarity with clinical trial data sources — trial registries, investigator and site databases, CTMS and EDC outputs, claims and EHR-derived real-world data, and published literature — including a working understanding of their gaps and biases
  • Experience across multiple therapeutic areas and study phases; exposure to oncology, rare disease, or cell and gene therapy is an advantage
  • Demonstrated ability to conduct hands-on analysis using SQL and at least one analytical environment, such as Python or R, or an equivalent combination of advanced business intelligence, visualization, and modeling tools.
  • Ability to explain methodology and uncertainty to a non-technical audience
  • Strong data visualization and storytelling skills; produces materials that stand on their own when the client forwards them internally
  • Demonstrated ability to communicate data limitations objectively and distinguish evidence-supported conclusions from assumptions.
  • Ability to work to compressed proposal deadlines across several concurrent opportunities, and to judge how much analytical depth a given opportunity warrants
  • Ability to present complex analyses credibly and effectively to senior internal and external stakeholders.
  • Working knowledge of ICH-GCP and FDA regulations as they relate to research
  • Must be able to maintain confidentiality of client, sponsor, and site-level data
  • Advanced knowledge of Microsoft Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook, and CRM platforms

SUPERVISORY RESPONSIBILITIES: None

TRAVEL REQUIREMENTS: 10% to 20%

Pay Range

USD $91,980.00 - USD $143,000.00 /Yr.

Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment based on merit and without regard to race, color, national origin or ancestry, religion or creed, sex, sexual orientation, gender expression, gender identity, age, marital status, pregnancy, family or parental status, disability, genetic information, citizenship, veteran status, or any other legally recognized basis or status protected by federal, state, or local law. We’re looking for a detail-oriented and organized Accounting Specialist to support our finance and operations team. In this role, you’ll manage accounts receivable, accounts payable, sales commission calculations, and financial reconciliations while maintaining accurate financial records.

Reporting directly to the Operations Manager, you’ll work closely with the finance and sales teams to ensure invoices, payments, commissions, and financial reporting are handled accurately and efficiently.

  • Process vendor invoices and ensure payments are made on time.

  • Calculate and process sales commissions accurately based on established compensation plans.

Accounting & Reconciliation

Systems & Financial Reporting

  • Use Salesforce to manage sales data, generate reports, and support commission calculations.
  • Generate financial and operational reports for internal teams.
  • Reconcile information across accounting systems, CRM platforms, and spreadsheets.

Required Experience & Skills

  • At least 2 years of professional experience in accounting, accounts receivable, accounts payable, or a similar role.

  • Salesforce experience is mandatory and non-negotiable. Candidates must have hands-on professional experience using Salesforce to manage sales data, generate reports, and support financial or commission-related processes. Candidates without Salesforce experience will not be considered.
  • Proficiency in QuickBooks or Bill.com is mandatory. Experience with at least one of these systems is required.

  • Strong analytical, numerical, and problem-solving skills.

  • Ability to reconcile data across accounting systems, CRM platforms, and spreadsheets.

What Makes You a Strong Fit

  • You are highly organized and comfortable managing multiple financial responsibilities.
  • You take accuracy seriously, especially when handling invoices, payments, and commission calculations.
  • You can identify discrepancies, investigate their causes, and resolve them systematically.
  • You are confident working across Salesforce, accounting software, and spreadsheets.
  • You communicate clearly with finance and sales stakeholders and follow through on outstanding issues.
  • You can work independently while maintaining reliable records and meeting deadlines.

What Success Looks Like

  • Customer invoices, vendor payments, and account balances are processed accurately and on time.
  • Commission calculations and reports are reliable and aligned with established compensation plans.
  • Financial records and reconciliations remain accurate and up to date.

jobs.title: Data Operations Manager
jobs.description:
Overview

Overview:

HealthEdge is looking for a Data Operations Manager with a focus on data insights who thinks like an engineer, works like a scientist and communicates like a strategist. This hybrid role sits at the intersection of data platform engineering and ITSM-aligned Problem Management – purpose-built to expose the hidden toil, technical debt and repeat failure patterns that drain engineering capacity and impact payer customer availability across our integrated platform of solutions.

You will leverage AI – including Claude and its supporting functions – to ingest disparate operational data sources, model failure trends and surface prioritized insights that drive permanent resolution rather than perpetual remediation.

WHY THIS ROLE EXISTS

Production stability is a business imperative for health plans that depend on HealthEdge solutions to process claims, manage care and engage members. Repeat incidents, unresolved technical debt and untracked toil create invisible drag on engineering velocity – and visible risk to client uptime. This role exists to make the invisible visible, and to turn data-driven findings into engineering action.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Operational Data Engineering

  • Design, build and maintain pipelines that consolidate data from PagerDuty, Jira, ServiceNow, Datadog, Splunk and other operational sources into a unified analytical layer.
  • Develop and curate data models that identify repeat incidents, known error patterns, chronic alert noise and engineering toil consuming disproportionate remediation cycles.
  • Maintain data quality, lineage and governance standards across all ingested sources – ensuring findings are defensible when presented to senior leadership.
  • Leverage AI and automation – including the Claude API and Claude-powered workflows – to accelerate pattern detection, root cause hypothesis generation and report synthesis across large operational datasets.

Problem Management Practice

  • Own and drive the Problem Management lifecycle across HealthEdge client-facing products.
  • Translate incident patterns into structured Problem Records with defined scope, impact quantification, and recommended permanent fix strategies.
  • Partner with Engineering, SRE, Platform and Product teams to embed problem-driven prioritization into sprint planning and tech debt roadmaps.
  • Facilitate Problem Review sessions – leading cross-functional teams from data to decision
  • Define and track KPIs that demonstrate Problem Management value: reduction in repeat SEV1/SEV2 incidents, MTTR improvement, tech debt resolution velocity and engineering hours reclaimed from toil.

AI-Driven Insight & Visualization

  • Build interactive, executive-ready dashboards and data visualizations that make hotspots, failure modes and technical debt load immediately comprehensible to both engineering and business stakeholders.
  • Apply generative AI tooling to synthesize multi-source operational signals into clear, narrative-driven analysis – reducing time from data to decision.
  • Develop automated reporting workflows that surface trending issues and emerging risk patterns without requiring manual aggregation cycles.
  • Support monthly ceremonies by providing KPI and Outcome trending, highlighting influences to trending themes.

Stakeholder Communication & Business Translation

  • Present operational intelligence findings and Problem Management outcomes to Engineering leadership, VP-level+ audiences and cross-functional stakeholders.
  • Influence from a strategic perspective where the most urgent pockets of risk to platform availability exist, and drive prioritization accordingly.
  • Translate technical findings – infrastructure failure modes, code regression patterns, dependency risks – into business value framing that drives prioritization conversations.
  • Author Problem Record summaries, trend analyses and executive briefings that are concise, evidence-based and action-oriented.

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

Technical Skills

  • 5+ years of data engineering experience with production-grade pipeline design, transformation logic and operational data modeling.
  • Proficiency with Python or Scala for data processing; strong SQL for analytical querying against large, event-driven datasets.
  • Hands-on experience with Jira and at least two of the following: PagerDuty, Datadog, Splunk, ServiceNow – ideally in an operational analytics or SRE context.
  • Experience integrating large language model (LLM) APIs – including Anthropic Claude, OpenAI or similar – into data workflows, automated summarization pipelines or insight generation applications.
  • Proficiency building interactive dashboards and data visualizations, Amazon Quick Suite a strong plus.

Operational & ITSM Knowledge

  • Working knowledge of ITIL or equivalent ITSM frameworks – specifically Incident Management, Problem Management and Change Management process disciplines.
  • Demonstrated ability to identify repeat failure patterns in incident or monitoring data and drive structured root cause analysis and resolution workflows.
  • Familiarity with SRE principles – toil quantification, error budgets, SLO/SLA measurement – and how engineering teams use these to prioritize reliability work.

Communication & Leadership

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with demonstrated experience presenting technical analysis to VP or C-level audiences.
  • Ability to translate complex, multi-variable findings into business impact narratives that drive prioritization decisions.
  • Comfortable driving cross-functional alignment – navigating competing priorities across Engineering, Product, Operations and Leadership stakeholders.
  • Self-directed and intellectually curious; you pursue root causes with the same rigor you bring to your data models.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Experience in a healthcare SaaS environment or regulated platform with high availability requirements.
  • Prior role embedded in an SRE, NOC, Platform Engineering or Operations function – particularly one that included formal Problem Management or post-incident review responsibilities.
  • Experience building AI-powered operational tooling – such as automated incident summarization, intelligent alert correlation or AI-assisted root cause classification.
  • Familiarity with HealthEdge products or the payer technology landscape is a meaningful plus.
  • ITIL Foundation certification or equivalent.

Geographic Responsibility: Remote, US

Type of Employment: Full-time, permanent

FLSA Classification (USA Only): Exempt

Work Environment: The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job: 

  • The employee is occasionally required to move around the office. Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision, color vision, peripheral vision, depth perception, and ability to adjust focus.
  • Work across multiple time zones in a hybrid or remote work environment.
  • Long periods of time sitting and/or standing in front of a computer using video technology.
  • May require travel dependent on company needs.

The above statements are intended to describe the general nature and level of the job being performed by the individual(s) assigned to this position. They are not intended to be an exhaustive list of all duties, responsibilities, and skills required. HealthEdge reserves the right to modify, add, or remove duties and to assign other duties as necessary. In addition, reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions of this position in compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act of 1990. Candidates may be required to go through a pre-employment criminal background check.

HealthEdge is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to workforce diversity and actively encourage all qualified persons to seek employment with us, including, but not limited to, racial and ethnic minorities, women, veterans and persons with disabilities.

At Nelson, we've been supporting teaching and learning across Canada for more than a century. As Canada's leading K–12 educational publisher and digital learning provider, we work alongside educators to develop trusted, curriculum-aligned resources, digital learning solutions, and assessment tools that meet the evolving needs of classrooms.

From our longstanding publishing heritage to innovative platforms like Edwin, we bring together quality content, technology, and practical support to help educators create equitable, inclusive, and engaging learning experiences for every student.

If that sounds like you, we'd love to hear from you! Apply to join our team today.

Let's Create Possible, one learner at a time.

About the role

The Scrum Master (SM) is a project manager with experience running projects using the Scrum framework. The SM is responsible for day-to-day leadership and project management of digital products. The SM will participate in the planning of projects and oversee the development and production stages, providing overall workflow/scheduling expertise with the goal of ensuring projects are delivered on time, on budget, and to Nelson’s quality standards.

The SM will leverage the contributions of internal staff including Program Specialists, Content Editors, Content Coordinators, Digital Content Developers, and Rights Acquisitions Project Managers, as well as external vendors including editors, proofreaders, designers, and full-service vendors in the completion of the work. In addition, the SM will work with the Product Manager (PM) to set project scope and priorities. A key aspect of this role is to ensure that the content quality and product vision is maintained throughout the project’s life cycle.

The position requires hands-on project management skills, high attention to detail, excellent verbal and written communication skills, and the ability to work with technical and non-technical staff and vendors. Key to the success of this position is the ability to be agile, work well under pressure, manage competing priorities, and thrive in a technical and quick-changing environment.

Requirements

Duties and Responsibilities

Project Planning

  • Provide support to the Product Manager (PM) as needed through R&D for product vision and conceptualization, including participating in market research activities such as meetings, workshops, and focus groups
  • Participate in project planning meetings to plan for content development and production of product (e.g., author/advisor meetings)
  • Work with Senior Manager, Content Management and PM to estimate timelines and costs (e.g., writing, editing, production, reviewing, proofreading, alt text) for both prototypes and full products

Project Management

  • Collaborate with PM to identify project scope, requirements, and acceptance criteria
  • Apply Scrum project management methodologies to plan, execute, and manage process and workflow for digital content, from conception to go-live/publication, including markup, writing, editing, production (HTML editing, composition), integration of partner content, and creation of metadata and interactive content
  • Guide internal team members through the workflow, monitoring for quality and completeness set by acceptance criteria (e.g. reviews, instructional design), monitoring for alignment with design templates and brand identity, and ensuring that project milestones are met and that work is progressing within project scope
  • Source, engage, and liaise with external reviewers and vendors including designers, editors, illustrators, copyeditors, proofreaders, and indexers
  • Identify blockers and potential project pitfalls, evaluate risk/benefits, and work with project team, other Scrum Masters, and Senior Managers to find solutions
  • Ensure that content-preparation requirements (e.g., manuscript, metadata, etc.) are understood and followed by the project team
  • Understand and follow guidelines for accessibility, web compatibility, and permissions
  • Advise on ongoing updates and revisions to assigned projects based on market feedback
  • Contribute to process improvement initiatives
  • Participate in team meetings and update Senior Manager, Content Management and Product Manager regularly on project status, alerting them to any issues that might require their assistance

Experience and Education

  • Post-secondary education required
  • 3+ years of experience in project management, preferably in an educational publishing or e-learning environment or in digital projects
  • Thorough understanding of project management best practices and familiarity with Scrum; PMP and/or CSM certification an asset
  • Knowledge of publishing processes and workflow for digital products
  • Certificate/degree from college or university publishing program an asset
  • Knowledge of pedagogy and instructional design for K-12
  • Experience working in digital content creation and ability to quickly learn new processes, systems, and software

Skills

  • Superior communication skills, both written and spoken
  • Problem solving orientation with the ability to manage multiple projects and deadlines
  • Strong time-management skills, flexibility to shift between tasks easily, and demonstrated ability to effectively prioritize workload
  • Ability to conceptualize, workshop, document, and socialize rapidly evolving workflow processes
  • Highly organized and motivated with keen attention-to-detail
  • Understanding of editorial standards and processes
  • Understanding of web development and print production and processes
  • Strong customer service orientation
  • Ability to work both independently and within a team environment
  • Collaborative strength – should embrace, support, and practice a collaborative style
  • Comfortable dealing with change and risk in a fast-paced working environment
  • Computer proficiency: Adobe Acrobat, MS Office, Smartsheet, Confluence, Jira

Your projects may involve merchant onboarding, administrative dashboards, patient questionnaires, account settings, product configuration, and other experiences across the platform.

You'll learn how research questions are developed, how appropriate research methods are selected, and how studies are planned and conducted.

jobs.description:
Redwood Automation Solution Designer (RunMyJobs / SAP BPA), SAP Finance Close, Finland

Contract: Duration being confirmed. Start: 15 November 2026. Location: Remote, for consultants based in Finland. Day rate: EUR 400 a day. Language: English.

The programme

An established organisation is automating its SAP finance close on the Redwood platform, the same engine that runs RunMyJobs and that SAP sold for years as SAP Central Process Scheduling (CPS) and SAP Business Process Automation (BPA). The work covers the record-to-report cycle: accruals, balance sheet reconciliation, journal posting and the period-end close, all driven into SAP S/4HANA and ECC.

You will own the solution design. You will work with the finance process owners to understand how the close runs today, decide what to automate and in what order, and set out a design the engineers can build on the Redwood platform. You will then stay with that design through build, testing and go-live, and make the calls when what was designed meets what is real.

What you will work on

Current-state analysis of the SAP period-end close with controllers and finance operations leads. The target automation design: close task lists, dependencies, calendars, approvals and exception paths, written up as the solution design. Accruals, balance sheet reconciliation and certification, and journal posting with its posting controls. The integration design with SAP S/4HANA or ECC and the other source systems, through APIs, files and middleware. Security and controls designed in: role-based access, segregation of duties, audit trails and SOX-aligned evidence. Monitoring, recovery and the non-functional design that keeps the close running. Leading the engineers through build, and reviewing what they deliver against the design at design-authority and go-live checkpoints. Test strategy and acceptance criteria with the finance users.

What you bring

Solution design on the Redwood platform under any of its names: RunMyJobs, SAP BPA by Redwood, SAP CPS or Cronacle. Design of an automated SAP FI/CO period-end close, where you ran the design workshops and wrote the design yourself. Controls built into your designs: role-based security, segregation of duties, audit trails and SOX-aligned evidence. Leading engineers from an approved design through build, testing and go-live. 8 or more years in SAP finance systems, finance automation or record-to-report process design.

Useful but not essential:

Redwood Finance Automation (RunMyFinance). A BPA-to-RunMyJobs migration. CPS or Redwood tasks run from the SAP Financial Closing cockpit, or SAP Advanced Financial Closing. Financial services or another regulated industry.

How to respond

Apply with your CV and your available start date. With it, add three lines on your most recent Redwood or SAP close automation project: which Redwood product it ran on, the finance processes in scope, and which design decisions were yours.

About Yadimen

Yadimen Consulting Limited is an IT consulting company focused on financial services. For this programme we are putting experienced Redwood and SAP finance close automation people in front of the client.

About Bask Health

Bask Health is a software platform that enables entrepreneurs, doctors, and healthcare businesses to launch, manage, and grow direct-to-consumer telehealth businesses.

Our platform brings together patient experiences, clinical workflows, pharmacy operations, and commerce tools in one place.

We're an entrepreneurial, product-focused engineering team that values ownership, technical excellence, and building software that solves real problems. Engineers work closely with product teams and company leadership, take features from idea to production, and have a direct role in shaping the platform.

Engineering at Bask is AI-first and builder-led. We use tools like Cursor and Claude Code throughout development while maintaining high standards for reliability, testing, and software quality.

About the Role

We're looking for a UX Researcher, Patient & Provider Experience to help Bask Health better understand how patients and healthcare professionals interact with digital healthcare experiences.

Bask Health enables entrepreneurs, doctors, and healthcare businesses to launch, manage, and grow direct-to-consumer telehealth businesses. Our platform connects patient experiences, clinical workflows, pharmacy operations, and commerce tools.

As a UX Researcher, Patient & Provider Experience, you'll investigate how people navigate healthcare-related interfaces, complete important tasks, interpret information, and interact with workflows that may involve sensitive or complex information.

This is a hands-on research role focused on evaluating patient and provider experiences through user interviews, usability testing, workflow observation, and qualitative analysis.

Your research will help product teams identify where users encounter confusion, unnecessary complexity, or barriers to completing tasks.

On the patient side, you'll study experiences such as onboarding, intake questionnaires, form completion, account interactions, and the communication of next steps.

You'll investigate whether patients understand the information being requested, can navigate multi-step workflows, and know what to expect after completing an action.

On the provider side, you'll study relevant clinical interfaces and operational workflows, including how authorized healthcare professionals review information, navigate tasks, and interact with the platform.

You'll pay particular attention to how information moves between patient-facing and provider-facing experiences, identifying usability issues that may affect clarity, efficiency, or workflow continuity.

You'll work closely with product designers to evaluate prototypes, test interaction patterns, and improve the organization and presentation of information.

You'll collaborate with product managers to define research questions and prioritize studies that address important product decisions.

You'll partner with engineers to understand technical constraints and ensure findings can be translated into practical improvements.

You'll also collaborate with appropriate clinical and operational stakeholders to understand workflow requirements and ensure research activities respect professional responsibilities and healthcare-related boundaries.

Because these experiences may involve sensitive information, you'll conduct research with careful attention to participant privacy, informed consent, approved research environments, and appropriate data-handling procedures.

You'll evaluate accessibility, comprehension, and the needs of users with different levels of technical familiarity or healthcare knowledge.

You'll synthesize research findings into actionable recommendations that help teams improve usability while preserving the accuracy and intent of healthcare-related workflows.

We're looking for someone who is curious about how people interact with healthcare software, comfortable researching complex user journeys, and able to translate detailed observations into meaningful product improvements.

What You'll Do

  • Conduct UX research across Bask Health's patient-facing and provider-facing software experiences.

  • Apply accessibility and inclusive research principles to study design.
  • Follow appropriate privacy, consent, and sensitive-data handling procedures.

jobs.title: Finance Operations Specialist
jobs.description:
Founded in 2020, Lavender is the largest nurse-owned and operated online psychiatry and therapy office in the United States. Our extraordinary team of 100+ talented and like-minded folks works remotely from across the United States, Canada and the Philippines to collaboratively increase access to high-quality, high-touch mental healthcare. Lavender is a human-first organization and our people embody:

  • A bias towards action
  • A capacity for self-direction
  • Originality and creative instincts
  • Courageous and bold thinking
  • And the potential to achieve even more

If you’re looking for a fast-paced, constantly evolving environment where your voice matters and you can truly have an impact creating high-quality, user-centric mental health services, we want to hear from you!

Lavender is an equal opportunity employer. We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. We strongly believe that diversity of experience, perspectives and background will lead to a better environment for our team and a better experience for our clients. We strongly encourage people of color and members of the LGBTQ+ community to apply.

Join the Lavender team

We are looking for a Finance Operations Specialist to keep Lavender's finances running smoothly behind the scenes: ensuring vendors and partners are paid accurately and on time, keeping cash where each of our entities needs it, and maintaining clear, simple programs that let our teams spend responsibly on their own. You'll start with well-documented procedures so you can hit the ground running quickly—and from there, they're yours to improve, automate, and keep current.

The Opportunity

Reporting to and working closely with our Director of Finance, our accounting team, and leaders across the company, this is a part-time employee role (16–20 hours per week) based remotely in Canada. We're a growing healthcare company with several entities and clients across many US states, so no two weeks look the same. We're looking for someone who notices a gap next to their work and closes it—whether that's a filing deadline without an owner, a recurring travel question, or a spend report a director needs by Friday—with room to grow into cash forecasting and budget tracking as we scale.

Role Details:

  • Employment Type: Part-time Employee (approximately 16–20 hours per week)
  • Location: Remote, based in Canada (with some availability during Eastern Time business hours on payment days)
  • Compensation: $35.00 CAD per hour
  • Target Start Date: Early December 2026

What You'll be Doing

Payments and Vendor Management
  • Own the weekly vendor payment run from start to finish: review incoming bills, prepare payments, route them for approval, and release them on schedule.
  • Pay US and Canadian vendors and partners in USD and CAD across our banking and payment platforms.
  • Keep vendor records complete and current, including W-9s, contracts, payment details, and renewal dates.
  • Protect company funds by following our approval process, confirming any change to a vendor's bank details by phone before approval, and flagging anything that doesn't look right.
  • Serve as our first line of defence against fraud and waste—questioning requests that don't add up, investigating before money moves, and never sending funds just because someone asked.
  • Manage the shared finance inbox so questions get answered and nothing is missed.
  • Own year-end 1099 reporting: collect W-9s throughout the year, track which payees reach reporting thresholds, apply rules and exemptions correctly (for incorporated payees, attorneys, medical providers, and rent), and file on time.
Cash and Month-End Support
  • Prepare the weekly cash snapshot across our entities and the transfers that keep each one funded for approval.
  • Maintain a rolling 13-week cash forecast of payments and transfers built from our payment schedule.
  • Support month-end close with our external accounting team by answering transaction questions and gathering documentation.
  • Reconcile card and bill activity so every charge has an owner, a receipt, and the right code.
Travel and Expense Programs
  • Run our company card and expense program: issue and adjust cards, set limits, keep receipts and approvals on track, and help team members use it smoothly.
  • Manage our travel program (including Navan for booking and Uber for Business for ground transport) with clear guardrails so booking is self-serve.
  • Coordinate travel and spend for company events like our annual summit so 100+ travellers can book within budget.
  • Own our credit card and travel policies—reviewing them each year, improving the programs, and supporting and training the people who use them.
Compliance, Filings, and Insurance
  • Maintain a tax and compliance calendar so every filing and payment has a clear date and owner.
  • Prepare and submit recurring state and local filings (such as monthly Washington excise tax), annual entity filings, and information returns.
  • Set up tax and registration accounts as new entities go live.
  • Support annual insurance renewals (including commercial and malpractice) by gathering information, completing applications, and tracking deadlines.
  • Monitor recurring payments run by other teams (such as client referral rewards) against budget and escalate anything over set limits.
Spend Reporting and Process Improvement
  • Answer "how much did we spend on X?" questions for leaders using data from our spend management and accounting systems.
  • Help department heads track spend against their budgets as we introduce department budgets in 2027, flagging anything trending over budget.
  • Keep procedures current by documenting changes, automating manual steps, and ensuring someone else could step in seamlessly.
  • Proactively look for ways to improve processes and reduce costs, bringing recommendations backed by the numbers.

What You Bring

  • Experience: 4+ years in accounts payable, bookkeeping, or finance operations, ideally at a growing company with more than one legal entity.
  • Payments & Controls: Experience owning payments end-to-end across multiple bank and payment platforms, with strong instincts for internal controls, fraud prevention, and sound judgment around confidential financial information.
  • Tools & Systems: Working knowledge of QuickBooks Online and a modern spend management tool, plus comfort working remotely and asynchronously in Slack, Google Workspace, and Asana.
  • US Tax & Filing Knowledge: Hands-on experience preparing and filing 1099s (1099-NEC and 1099-MISC), including reporting thresholds, rules, and exemptions, plus familiarity with recurring US state or local filings.
  • Communication & Mindset: A self-starter who learns from documentation, asks good questions early, writes clearly and concisely, and can "hold a line kindly"—pointing people to policies and self-serve options while still leaving them feeling helped.
  • Work Setup: A quiet, professional space to work from home (company equipment and onboarding provided).
  • Preferred Qualifications: Experience paying vendors in both USD and CAD; running a travel program (Navan, TravelPerk, or Uber for Business); US healthcare, professional services, or multi-state company experience; and comfort building simple forecasts and models in Google Sheets or Excel.

Why You Should Join Lavender

  • Work for a company that is truly making a difference in the world
  • Remote work
  • A caring, spirited, and experienced team
  • An international work environment that embraces diversity and inclusion
  • Be part of a growing startup where you have the opportunity to help shape the company
  • In-person meetups
  • Competitive compensation ($28.00-$35.00 CAD/hour)
Bring your whole self to work

Lavender believes that nurturing an environment where diversity and inclusion can thrive is critical to our success. We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer and do not discriminate on the basis of any status protected by law, including race, colour, religion, sex, orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, disability, or genetic information.

jobs.description:
Redwood Automation Solution Designer (RunMyJobs / SAP BPA), SAP Finance Close, Hungary

Contract: Duration being confirmed. Start: 15 November 2026. Location: Remote, for consultants based in Hungary. Day rate: EUR 400 a day. Language: English.

The programme

An established organisation is automating its SAP finance close on the Redwood platform, the same engine that runs RunMyJobs and that SAP sold for years as SAP Central Process Scheduling (CPS) and SAP Business Process Automation (BPA). The work covers the record-to-report cycle: accruals, balance sheet reconciliation, journal posting and the period-end close, all driven into SAP S/4HANA and ECC.

You will own the solution design. You will work with the finance process owners to understand how the close runs today, decide what to automate and in what order, and set out a design the engineers can build on the Redwood platform. You will then stay with that design through build, testing and go-live, and make the calls when what was designed meets what is real.

What you will work on

Current-state analysis of the SAP period-end close with controllers and finance operations leads. The target automation design: close task lists, dependencies, calendars, approvals and exception paths, written up as the solution design. Accruals, balance sheet reconciliation and certification, and journal posting with its posting controls. The integration design with SAP S/4HANA or ECC and the other source systems, through APIs, files and middleware. Security and controls designed in: role-based access, segregation of duties, audit trails and SOX-aligned evidence. Monitoring, recovery and the non-functional design that keeps the close running. Leading the engineers through build, and reviewing what they deliver against the design at design-authority and go-live checkpoints. Test strategy and acceptance criteria with the finance users.

What you bring

Solution design on the Redwood platform under any of its names: RunMyJobs, SAP BPA by Redwood, SAP CPS or Cronacle. Design of an automated SAP FI/CO period-end close, where you ran the design workshops and wrote the design yourself. Controls built into your designs: role-based security, segregation of duties, audit trails and SOX-aligned evidence. Leading engineers from an approved design through build, testing and go-live. 8 or more years in SAP finance systems, finance automation or record-to-report process design.

Useful but not essential:

Redwood Finance Automation (RunMyFinance). A BPA-to-RunMyJobs migration. CPS or Redwood tasks run from the SAP Financial Closing cockpit, or SAP Advanced Financial Closing. Financial services or another regulated industry.

How to respond

Apply with your CV and your available start date. With it, add three lines on your most recent Redwood or SAP close automation project: which Redwood product it ran on, the finance processes in scope, and which design decisions were yours.

About Yadimen

Yadimen Consulting Limited is an IT consulting company focused on financial services. For this programme we are putting experienced Redwood and SAP finance close automation people in front of the client.

Key Responsibilities

Team Leadership and Development

  • Recruit, hire, and onboard site-level safety and loss prevention professionals within the region.
  • Set clear performance expectations, conduct regular coaching conversations, and deliver structured feedback and development plans.
  • Build a high-accountability, growth-oriented team culture within the regional HSS function.
  • Identify talent gaps and succession needs; develop internal candidates for expanded roles.
  • Facilitate regional team meetings, knowledge sharing, and collaborative problem-solving across sites.

Safety Program Execution

  • Deploy and sustain enterprise safety standards across all regional facilities, ensuring consistent implementation.
  • Conduct or oversee facility safety audits, gap assessments, and corrective action tracking.
  • Support site leaders and operations teams in embedding safety into daily standard work and leadership routines.
  • Lead or oversee incident investigations within the region, ensuring root cause analysis quality and timely corrective action closure.
  • Represent the region in enterprise safety forums, surfacing trends, risks, and improvement opportunities to the Head of HSS.
  • Coordinate peak readiness reviews to ensure safety standards are maintained through volume surges and labor onboarding.

Loss Prevention and Asset Protection

  • Own regional loss prevention strategy, including shrink reduction targets, security controls, and investigative outcomes.
  • Oversee internal investigations related to theft, fraud, and inventory discrepancy — escalating to HR, Legal, or Law Enforcement as appropriate.
  • Analyze loss trends across the region and drive root cause resolution through operational and procedural improvements.
  • Manage CCTV, access control, and physical security standards across regional sites, partnering with facilities teams on remediation.
  • Build relationships with carrier partners, vendors, and law enforcement contacts to support loss prevention outcomes.
  • Partner with Operations and Finance to quantify and report on shrink, damage, and loss impact at the regional level.

Compliance and Regulatory Management

  • Ensure all regional facilities maintain compliance with applicable OSHA, state, and local regulations.
  • Serve as the regional point of contact for regulatory inspections, responding to inquiries and coordinating any required corrective actions.
  • Monitor regulatory changes with regional applicability and coordinate with the Head of HSS to update procedures accordingly.
  • Oversee Hazmat compliance within the region, including proper storage, labeling, training, and incident reporting.
  • Support site-level readiness for customer-required certifications such as GMP, GDP, CTPAT, or TAPA where applicable within the region.

Metrics, Reporting, and Continuous Improvement

  • Own regional safety and loss prevention KPIs, delivering regular performance reporting to the Head of HSS and regional operations leadership.
  • Drive trend analysis across regional sites to identify systemic risks before they become incidents.
  • Manage corrective action pipelines within the region, ensuring timely closure and verified effectiveness.
  • Champion near-miss and hazard reporting culture across sites, tracking participation rates as a leading indicator.
  • Partner with Ops Excellence to integrate safety and loss prevention improvements into standard operating procedures.

New Site Launches and Network Changes

  • Lead HSS readiness for new site launches within the region, including safety walkthroughs, program onboarding, and staff training.
  • Support automation and equipment commissioning activities from a safety perspective within the region.
  • Ensure staffing and program coverage scales appropriately as the regional network grows.

Required Qualifications

Experience

  • 7+ years of experience in health and safety, loss prevention, or operations compliance.
  • 3+ years of direct people management experience, with a track record of hiring and developing high-performing teams.
  • Multi-site experience in 3PL, eCommerce fulfillment, distribution, or manufacturing environments.
  • Demonstrated experience in loss prevention investigation, shrink management, or asset protection in a high-volume logistics or retail environment.

Technical Knowledge

  • Working knowledge of OSHA standards, state-specific safety regulations, and compliance program management.
  • Hands-on experience managing physical security systems, including CCTV, access control, and inventory protection protocols.
  • Familiarity with incident investigation methodologies and corrective action systems.
  • Comfort with Hazmat regulations and controlled substance handling requirements in a warehouse or fulfillment context.
  • Experience using safety and loss prevention data to drive operational decisions.

Credentials (Preferred)

  • ASP, CSP, or equivalent safety certification, or active pursuit of one.
  • Wicklander-Zulawski (WZ), Reid Technique, or equivalent interviewing certification preferred.
  • Lean, Six Sigma, or continuous improvement background a plus.
  • Familiarity with CTPAT, TAPA, or SOC-related security requirements a plus.

Leadership Profile

  • A builder and developer of people — energized by growing a team, not just managing one.
  • Highly credible with frontline associates and site operations leaders; earns trust through presence and follow-through.
  • Capable of holding the line on standards while maintaining strong, collaborative relationships with operations partners.
  • Analytical and data-driven; able to translate metrics into clear narratives and actionable plans for regional and executive audiences.
  • Comfortable in ambiguity — able to triage competing priorities, escalate appropriately, and keep the team focused under pressure.
  • Strong written and verbal communicator; able to represent the region in enterprise forums and deliver clear guidance to site teams.
