jobs.description:
Covetrus is a global animal-health technology and services leader dedicated to empowering veterinary practice partners to drive improved health and financial outcomes. We bring together products, services, and technology into a single platform that connects our customers to the solutions and insights they need to work best. Our passion for the well-being of animals and those who care for them drives us to advance the world of veterinary medicine.

Managing DIrector, Calibra Pet Nutritition

Location: Remote-based, with regular travel to Brno, Czech Republic

The opportunity


Calibra is entering an important new stage of its growth.

We are looking for an experienced and commercially driven Managing Director to lead the business, strengthen its position and take the brand into new markets, channels and customer segments.


This is a true business leadership role with full P&L accountability. You will own the strategy, financial performance and future direction of Calibra, balancing ambitious growth with strong commercial discipline and operational delivery. You will also be part of the Executive Leadership Team, working collaboratively across the wider Covetrus organisation.


The opportunity goes well beyond growing through existing Covetrus relationships. A core priority will be expanding Calibra’s presence across specialist retail, e-commerce, marketplaces and selected external distribution partnerships, while protecting the credibility and positioning of the brand.


What you will lead

You will:

  • Own and execute the Calibra business strategy, creating a prioritised European expansion plan supported by clear market-level business cases.
  • Take full responsibility for revenue, gross margin, profitability and EBITDA growth.
  • Identify where Calibra can win and make commercially disciplined decisions about the markets, channels and partnerships worth pursuing.
  • Build the retail and e-commerce strategy, including marketplaces, retailer platforms and direct-to-consumer opportunities where commercially viable.
  • Develop the right pricing, margin, trade-term and channel models to support profitable growth without undermining existing veterinary and Covetrus channels.
  • Strengthen brand awareness and preference among both pet owners and pet professionals.
  • Shape the product portfolio and innovation pipeline in partnership with Product Development and Quality.
  • Ensure Manufacturing, Quality and Customer Service can support growth reliably, efficiently and at the right cost.
  • Use data, market insight and AI-enabled technology to accelerate marketing, product development and decision-making.
  • Lead, develop and strengthen a multidisciplinary team across commercial, marketing, operations, production, customer service, project management, product development and quality.
  • Contribute actively to the Executive Leadership Team, providing clear forecasts, transparent reporting.

What success will look like

You will:


  • Established a clear growth strategy and agreed the priority market sequence and supporting business cases.
  • Defined the retail and e-commerce strategy, selected priority partners and launched the first new retail and online channels.
  • Delivered against revenue, gross margin and EBITDA commitments, with a credible path to sustainable year-on-year growth.

What you will bring


We are looking for a commercially sharp and entrepreneurial leader who can move comfortably between strategy and execution.


You will bring:

  • At least 10 years of senior leadership experience, including full P&L responsibility.
  • Strong experience within the animal health industry.
  • A proven record of expanding a business or brand into new international markets.
  • Direct experience of growing brand sales through retail and e-commerce, not solely through owned or group distribution channels.
  • International leadership experience, including responsibility for geographically dispersed teams.
  • Confidence operating within a complex matrix organisation.
  • Experience building investment cases and presenting recommendations for senior approval.

Experience within pet food manufacturing, whether directly operated or outsourced, would be advantageous. Czech language capability would also be beneficial but is not essential.


You will combine:

  • Commercial judgement: The ability to identify where Calibra can genuinely win and focus investment on the opportunities that matter.
  • Financial discipline: A strong grasp of returns, margins, pricing and the economics behind growth.
  • Brand leadership: An understanding of what makes a brand relevant to customers and how to communicate that proposition with clarity.
  • Decisive people leadership: The confidence to set expectations, develop talent and address performance or capability gaps early.
  • Influence and collaboration: The ability to build trusted relationships across functions, countries and external partners.
  • Cultural agility: Comfort leading across markets, cultures and competing priorities without losing momentum.

Why join us?

This is an opportunity to take ownership of an established animal health brand at a pivotal point in its journey.

You will have the platform of Covetrus behind you, together with the freedom and accountability to shape where Calibra goes next. The opportunity is significant: strengthen the core business, expand into new markets, build new retail and digital channels, and make Calibra increasingly relevant to pet owners and pet professionals.


If you are a commercially ambitious leader who understands animal health, brand growth and international expansion, we would love to hear from you.

Apply today and help shape the next chapter of Calibra Pet Nutrition.

Your Opportunity as the Manager, Responsible Sourcing Program

Help shape and lead Smucker’s Responsible Sourcing Program, supporting the prevention and mitigation of social compliance and human rights risks across our global supply chains. Guide program strategy and governance, lead human rights due diligence and risk-management activities, engage suppliers, build strategic partnerships, and support public reporting and external communications. Work across the organization and with key external stakeholders to translate complex human rights considerations, evolving regulations, and social compliance standards into practical actions that protect people, strengthen our supply chain, and support Smucker’s commitments.


Location: Working Remote U.S.


Work Arrangements: Remote with 15% annual travel, ability to work with colleagues on eastern standard time.


In this role you will:


Responsible Sourcing Strategy and Governance

  • Guide Smucker’s Responsible Sourcing strategy, program priorities, governance, and decision-making practices.
  • Lead the development and ongoing maintenance of Smucker’s Supplier Code and related standards, expectations, and guidance.
  • Interpret human rights and social compliance frameworks and translate them into practical expectations for suppliers and internal stakeholders.
  • Monitor evolving regulations, standards, and emerging human rights issues, coordinating cross-functional input and recommending appropriate program changes.

Human Rights Due Diligence and Risk Management

  • Assess human rights and Responsible Sourcing risks using regulatory information, supplier data, Sedex, audit findings, and other available sources.

  • Partner with suppliers and internal stakeholders to monitor corrective actions and remediation, escalating issues or recommending additional action when needed.
  • Apply sound judgment to determine when Responsible Sourcing should lead, support, engage another function, or escalate an issue.

Supplier Engagement, Internal Support, and Partnerships

jobs.title: Senior Sales Assistant
jobs.description:
Ana Luisa is a Brooklyn-based e-commerce jewelry brand with a simple, but clearcut idea that high quality jewelry shouldn't cost the planet. We believe that how we create our pieces matters just as much as why people wear them and that luxury shouldn't be defined so narrowly and designed for so few. We design, craft and deliver exceptional everyday pieces for everyone, priced fairly and produced ethically to create a positive impact for both people and the planet.

Title: Senior Sales Assistant
Department: Wholesale
Reports to: VP of Wholesale
Works closely with: Wholesale Support Manager and Director of Sales
Travel: 6–8 trade shows and markets per year. Must be located in Eastern or Central Timezone

About the Role

The Senior Sales Assistant is the operational backbone of our wholesale business and a trusted partner to our retail accounts. Reporting to the VP of Wholesale and partnering with the Director of Sales, you will own order accuracy, account service, product data, sample and showroom logistics, and market readiness, while also driving process improvements and supporting the growth of our wholesale accounts.

You will act as the day-to-day point of contact for buyers, manage a portfolio of assigned accounts with a high degree of independence, and collaborate with Production, Operations, Merchandising, and Sales. You will also be expected to set standards, train and support teammates, and escalate and resolve issues before they reach the buyer.

Key Responsibilities

Account Management & Buyer Partnership

  • Serve as the primary operational contact for an assigned portfolio of wholesale accounts, proactively communicating order status, availability, payments, shipping updates, and required documents.
  • Build strong relationships with buyers and anticipate their needs ahead of key selling windows and seasonal launches.
  • Partner with the VP of Wholesale and the Wholesale Support Manager on account strategy, identifying reorder opportunities, assortment gaps, and growth potential.
  • Handle shipping extensions, reorders, returns, exchanges, and account escalations, and resolve issues with minimal oversight.

Order Management & EDI

  • Own the full order lifecycle, from order placeholders through EDI transmission, ensuring SKUs, pricing, and quantities are accurate in purchase orders and sales orders.
  • Send order confirmations to accounts before EDI transmission to validate details and keep orders on schedule.
  • Review EDI orders for accuracy, manage transmission approvals, and lead follow-up and issue resolution.
  • Track open POs from receipt through delivery, monitor shipments, and follow up on outstanding or delayed orders, flagging risks to leadership early.
  • Maintain the Master Data and audit order data regularly to protect accuracy across systems.

Inventory, ATS & Sales Reporting

  • Track and regularly update inventory and available-to-sell (ATS) positions, partnering with Production, Operations, and Merchandising to align availability with demand.
  • Pull weekly selling data from key retailers, analyze trends, and review findings and opportunities with the VP of Sales.
  • Build and maintain reports and dashboards (Excel and related tools) that translate sales results and KPIs into clear recommendations.

Product & Collection Management

  • Own product listings in Shopify and MarketTime end to end: creating, updating, and maintaining them.
  • Build and manage collections on both platforms so assortments stay accurate, current, and aligned with seasonal launches.
  • Generate product and collection barcodes for new assortments and maintain product data integrity across platforms.
  • Document and improve product setup processes so launches run on time and error-free.

Samples & Showroom

  • Oversee the organization and shipment of samples to buyers, including showroom and top-of-production (TOP) samples for wholesale accounts.
  • Maintain a complete log of all samples sent and returned, and ensure timely follow-up and recovery.

Markets & Trade Shows

  • Play a leading role in preparation, on-site execution, and follow-up for 6–8 trade shows and markets per year.
  • Coordinate line sheets, samples, order writing, and logistics, and ensure leads and orders captured at market are processed promptly.

Account Development & CRM

  • Conduct outreach to prospective wholesale accounts and support the pipeline from first contact through onboarding.
  • Keep internal CRM boards current so customer and lead records reflect the latest internal and external decisions.
  • Support the Wholesale Support Manager across all business functions for assigned accounts, and lead special projects as assigned.

Leadership, Process & Collaboration

  • Act as a subject matter expert on wholesale order processes, EDI, and platforms
  • Identify gaps and recommend and implement process improvements that increase accuracy, speed, and buyer satisfaction.
  • Serve as a cross-functional partner to Production, Operations, Merchandising, and Sales, keeping teams aligned on timelines and priorities.

What You Bring

  • 4–6 years of experience in wholesale, sales support, retail operations, or order management, ideally in jewelry, accessories, or fashion.
  • Advanced working knowledge of EDI and the wholesale order lifecycle.
  • Strong analytical skills: comfort reading sales results and KPIs, with advanced Excel skills.
  • Experience with Shopify, MarketTime, and NuORDER is a plus.
  • Proven ability to manage buyer relationships and resolve escalations independently.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication with buyers and internal teams.
  • Highly organized and detail-oriented, able to juggle multiple projects and deadlines.
  • Proactive when planning ahead, responsive when things change, and collaborative by default.
  • Experience mentoring or training teammates is preferred.
  • Ability to travel to 6–8 trade shows per year.

jobs.title: Senior Brand Designer
jobs.description:
About Acoustic

At Acoustic, we believe people can feel when a brand is paying attention. Our customer engagement platform helps B2C marketers put that belief into practice by bringing customer behavior, product insights, campaign context, and messaging tools like email, SMS, WhatsApp, and mobile push together in one place. This helps busy marketers understand what deserves their attention now and act while it still matters.

Our audience knows marketing. They recognize a good idea, notice the details, and have seen plenty of software companies make the same promises. That gives us a creative challenge worth taking on: tell Acoustic’s story clearly and distinctively, with copy and visuals that reflect the people, decisions, and everyday realities behind the work.

About the role

You notice when a typeface changes the mood or an unexpected image makes an idea click. You’ve rewatched a video just to figure out how they pulled off that transition. As our Senior Brand Designer, you’ll put those instincts to work for an audience of marketers who know good work when they see it and expect us to make some.

We rebranded this year and now comes the fun part: discovering everything our brand can do. We want to push the boundaries of B2B marketing with work our audience looks forward to seeing. You’ll have real room to shape how we get there. Motion graphics and video will be central to your work, along with design for our website, campaigns, social media, and events.

You’ll report to the Director of Brand & Content, who owns brand strategy and creative direction. As a close creative partner, you’ll turn that direction into design: pitching ideas, adapting our visual identity for new formats and channels, and taking projects from concept through production. Bring your opinions. We want to hear them.

This is a remote role open to candidates in the United States. A portfolio is required: show us work that makes you proud, including motion and video, and tell us which parts you owned.

What you'll do

  • Own projects from brief to delivery. Turn briefs into distinctive concepts for campaigns, product launches, email, thought leadership, sales presentations, and more. Bring the same care to everyday requests, from asset updates and resizes to recurring production work. Partner with writers so the words and visuals work together for each audience and channel.
  • Explain our product and technology visually. With Product and Product Marketing, tell our product story in ways that are clear and interesting to look at. Find the visual explanation, UI mockup, or demo that helps people quickly see what Acoustic does and why it matters.
  • Make motion and video a defining part of our brand. Shape how the brand moves and create animated explainers, product videos, and social content people watch to the end. Edit interviews, screen recordings, and raw footage using tools like After Effects, Jitter, CapCut, and Descript.
  • Keep our brand fresh and consistent. Adapt our visual identity for new channels, formats, and trends while working within our brand strategy. Build templates and guidelines that help teams across the company use the brand well, and review work so everything we publish meets the same bar for craft and accuracy.
  • Create for social and the web. Design carousels, static graphics, and video for organic social that fit how people use each platform. Work with Web and Content on page designs, imagery, and reusable components that help visitors quickly understand what Acoustic offers.
  • Design for events and in-person experiences. Develop creative for booths and activations, and work with vendors on production specs. Connect each event to what people see before and after, and find ways to give the creative a longer life.
  • Use results to sharpen the work. Partner with Demand & Growth to develop and test creative for paid social, display, and other programs. Learn which ideas get the right people to click, watch, or reply, then recommend what to try next and explain
  • Improve how creative gets made. Experiment with AI tools in concept development and production, and decide where hands-on design and editing make the work stronger. Give freelance designers clear direction and feedback, work with teams across the company to clarify needs, and explain your decisions.

Requirements

You would be a great match if you:

  • Have 7+ years of experience in brand design, graphic design, or art direction, in-house or at an agency, ideally for both B2B and B2C brands.
  • Love making video, with strong motion design or editing skills.
  • Sweat the details. You have sharp judgment in typography, layout, color, and composition, and you’re fluent in Figma and Adobe Creative Cloud.
  • Have helped build or evolve a visual identity, including guidelines and templates other people use successfully.
  • Can talk about what happened after the work launched, and how results or feedback shaped what you did next.
  • Use AI with judgment and can explain where it helped and where you stepped in.
  • Ask good questions, explain your work to people outside design, and handle feedback and competing deadlines without losing the details.

Bonus points if you have:

  • Designed for events, conferences, or trade shows.
  • Made complex technology or products feel clear and engaging.
  • Familiarity with marketing technology, customer engagement, or data platforms.
  • Developed and tested creative for paid social or digital ads.
  • Art-directed photography or illustration.
  • Used Claude Design or Sanity.

This role may not be a match if you:

  • Do your best work from a fully defined brief. Here, you’ll often help shape it.
  • Find it hard to let go of a concept when feedback shows it isn’t working.
  • Want the big campaign and identity work but not the everyday requests and production that keep a brand consistent.
  • Would rather not experiment with short-form video or AI tools. Both are a real part of this job.

Benefits

The compensation range for this role is $120,000 - $145,000.

  • Medical, dental, and vision coverage
  • Company-sponsored short-term disability, long-term disability, and life insurance
  • 401(k) program with company match
  • Flexible PTO: take what you need, when you need it
  • Parental leave: 16 weeks for birthing parents and 12 weeks for non-birthing parents

Acoustic provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, genetics, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. We're committed to building a diverse and inclusive team, and we welcome people of all backgrounds, experiences, perspectives, and abilities. If you need accommodation at any point in the hiring process, email us at .

jobs.title: Client Delivery Manager
jobs.description:
Client Delivery Manager

Position Type: Full-Time, Remote
Working Hours: U.S. Business Hours

About the Role

We’re looking for a Client Delivery Manager to own client relationships and delivery across a growing portfolio of engagements. The company helps middle-market businesses identify and implement high-impact AI opportunities, including workflow automation and analytics that improve operational efficiency and support business growth.

You’ll serve as a trusted partner to executive stakeholders, manage client programs from planning through delivery, and work closely with internal technical teams to ensure projects deliver measurable business value. This role requires strong communication, sound business judgment, operational discipline, and the ability to anticipate challenges before they affect clients.

What You’ll Own

Client Relationship Management

  • Serve as the primary point of contact for a portfolio of ongoing clients.
  • Build trusted relationships with C-suite executives and other key stakeholders.
  • Manage day-to-day communications, project updates, and difficult conversations, including project delays and technical issues.
  • Maintain a professional, proactive, and client-focused approach.

Program & Delivery Management

  • Own client roadmaps, project timelines, and delivery milestones from start to finish.
  • Keep internal teams accountable for deliverables and commitments.
  • Identify potential delays or risks early and develop action plans before they affect clients.
  • Maintain accurate client records, project updates, and internal documentation.

Technical & Business Coordination

  • Translate complex client needs into clear, actionable problem statements.
  • Collaborate with internal engineering teams to resolve technical issues and unblock deliverables.
  • Understand modern API capabilities, software workflows, and automation concepts well enough to support effective discussions.
  • Bridge communication between business stakeholders and technical teams.

Business Value & Performance

  • Connect project deliverables to measurable business outcomes.
  • Frame client updates around ROI, time saved, operational improvements, and risk reduction rather than tasks completed alone.
  • Track progress against engagement objectives and communicate results clearly.
  • Help clients understand the value delivered through ongoing work.

Account Growth & Opportunity Identification

  • Develop a deep understanding of each client's business and operational challenges.
  • Identify opportunities to expand engagement scope and introduce additional value-adding solutions.
  • Collaborate internally to develop solutions that support client needs and account growth.

Problem-Solving & Continuous Improvement

  • Navigate ambiguous and complex client challenges.
  • Evaluate trade-offs, prioritize effectively, and make sound business decisions.
  • Turn unstructured problems into clear, practical solutions through internal collaboration.

Required Experience & Skills

  • 3–5+ years of experience in engagement management, program/project management, business development, management consulting, client delivery, or technical account management.
  • Experience in an agency, SaaS, technology, or consulting environment is preferred.
  • Experience working with mid-market businesses is a plus.
  • Exceptional spoken and written English, with the ability to communicate confidently with U.S. executives.
  • Strong executive presence and the ability to operate as a senior delivery partner rather than a junior account representative.
  • Sound business judgment, including the ability to weigh trade-offs and prioritize under ambiguity.
  • Comfort reasoning about APIs, software workflows, and automation concepts, with the willingness and ability to learn technical concepts quickly.
  • Strong organizational skills and disciplined project tracking.
  • Excellent written follow-through, documentation, and stakeholder communication.
  • Availability to work overlapping U.S. business hours, preferably Eastern or Central Time.

What Makes You a Strong Fit

  • You take ownership of both the client relationship and the successful delivery of projects.
  • You anticipate problems and address them before clients need to raise concerns.
  • You communicate confidently with senior stakeholders and handle difficult conversations professionally.
  • You can translate between business objectives and technical execution.
  • You focus on measurable business outcomes rather than simply reporting completed tasks.
  • You are comfortable working independently, making decisions, and navigating ambiguity.
  • You maintain high standards for organization, documentation, and follow-through.
  • You look beyond current deliverables to identify opportunities to create additional value for clients.

What Success Looks Like

  • Clients trust you as their primary partner and have clear visibility into project progress.
  • Delivery timelines, milestones, and internal commitments are managed proactively.
  • Risks and blockers are identified early, with clear action plans in place.
  • Technical teams understand client requirements and remain aligned on priorities.
  • Client updates clearly demonstrate business impact, including ROI, time savings, and risk reduction.
  • Engagements consistently deliver meaningful value to clients.
  • Opportunities to expand accounts and improve client outcomes are identified and communicated.

jobs.title: Lead, Data Success (Life Sciences)
jobs.description:
Prominence Advisors and Tegra Analytics are seeking a Data Success Lead to lead assigned commercial data engagements for life sciences clients. This person will combine strong client-facing skills with hands-on expertise in data warehousing, master data management, data governance, and analytics.

Who We Are

Prominence is a healthcare and life sciences technology and consulting firm dedicated to helping leading organizations do more with their data. With deep expertise across the full ecosystem — spanning providers, payers, and life sciences — we turn complex data into actionable insight.

We deliver a full spectrum of services, including advisory, analytics, optimization, and IT staffing. Our work helps organizations operate more efficiently, improve patient outcomes, and deliver measurable financial impact through smarter use of data. Recognized as a 2x Best in KLAS organization, we partner with more than 120 health systems and 40 life sciences organizations, including 7 of the top 10 U.S. News & World Report-ranked institutions.

Through our life sciences brands, Tegra Analytics and WLH Consulting & Learning Solutions, we extend these capabilities to pharmaceutical and biotech organizations — combining data, consulting, and learning to advance commercial excellence.

By connecting strategy, data, and execution, we help organizations translate data into clarity, strategy into action, and vision into measurable results. At our core, we are a people-first, values-driven organization that believes strong teams and trusted partnerships are what ultimately make healthcare and life sciences smarter.

Job Summary

The Data Success Lead leads the client relationship and technical delivery for assigned engagements. This person works with clients to define needs, designs sound data and business logic, guides analysts contributing to the work, and ensures deliverables are accurate and well documented.

Working in close partnership with the Director of Data Strategy, the Data Success Lead brings experienced judgment to client and technical decisions. They independently lead their assigned work and help maintain continuity when the Director needs support.

Essential Functions and Responsibilities

Client Engagement and Delivery

  • Serve as the day-to-day lead for assigned clients or workstreams, building trust through subject matter expertise, responsiveness, and follow-through.
  • Lead working meetings to clarify requirements, explain methodologies and findings, and resolve data questions.
  • Plan and coordinate assigned deliverables, including timelines, dependencies, quality review, and communication of risks.
  • Bring significant changes in scope, client commitments, or methodology to the Director with a clear recommendation.

Commercial Data and Technical Leadership

  • Design and review data warehouse models, transformations, and production-ready datasets for assigned solutions.
  • Lead healthcare professional (HCP) and healthcare organization (HCO) master data work involving identity resolution, affiliations, specialty, addresses, source precedence, and exception handling.
  • Apply data governance practices such as consistent definitions, documented business rules, lineage, and quality controls.
  • Evaluate and reconcile prescription, sales, claims, CRM, and reference data for commercial reporting, targeting, territory alignment, and incentive compensation support.
  • Develop and review SQL, specifications, analytical methods, and client deliverables.

Process Improvement and Quality Control

  • Improve recurring processes within assigned engagements through appropriate automation and clear SOPs.
  • Establish practical checks for source reconciliation, account changes, eligibility, volume trends, and downstream readiness.
  • Investigate material discrepancies with colleagues, clients, and vendors; document causes and coordinate fixes.
  • Escalate quality concerns promptly and recommend when an affected deliverable should be corrected or held.

Collaboration

  • Provide technical guidance and constructive review to analysts contributing to shared projects.
  • Share delivery risks, workload concerns, and process improvement ideas with the Director.
  • When asked, help resolve immediate blockers or represent Data Success in a meeting to maintain continuity.

Requirements

Education, Training and Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree in Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, Analytics, Business, Life Sciences, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.
  • 5+ years of experience with pharmaceutical or biotech commercial data and direct client or business stakeholder engagement.
  • Strong SQL skills and hands-on experience designing, transforming, reconciling, and validating complex datasets.
  • Experience with data warehousing, customer master data management, and practical data governance.
  • Deep familiarity with commercial data vendors and customer reference sources. Relevant experience may include IQVIA, Symphony Health, OneKey, Veeva OpenData, or MedPro.
  • Experience working with Rx, sales, and claims data and understanding their cadence, coverage, identity, and quality limitations.
  • Experience designing business logic, improving recurring processes through automation, and documenting methods through SOPs or technical specifications.
  • Ability to lead client discussions, manage assigned work, and review analytical output.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with data platforms such as SQL Server and cloud-based platforms such as Snowflake, Databricks, AWS, and Azure.
  • Experience with ETL tools, Python, VBA, scripting, or other approaches to data and reporting automation.
  • Familiarity with Power BI, Tableau, Excel, Veeva CRM, or field-facing commercial applications.
  • Experience with targeting, call planning, incentive compensation, or large-scale customer mastering.

Success Measures

  • Assigned clients receive clear communication, sound recommendations, and accurate deliverables on agreed timelines.
  • Data models, master data, and business rules are reliable, documented, and fit for their intended use.
  • Recurring work within assigned engagements becomes more efficient and consistent.
  • Analysts receive useful technical guidance on shared work.
  • The Director has a trusted partner who can independently lead substantial client and technical work and provide support when needed.

Skills, Knowledge, and Abilities

  • Client Partnership: Builds trust with clients and business stakeholders through subject matter expertise, responsiveness, and follow-through.
  • Technical Judgment: Designs sound data models and business logic, and knows when to bring significant scope or methodology changes to the Director with a clear recommendation.
  • Commercial Data Expertise: Understands the timing, coverage, identity, and quality limitations of prescription, sales, claims, and reference data.
  • Quality Mindset: Establishes practical checks, documents methods, and escalates quality concerns promptly.
  • Communication: Explains methodologies, findings, and risks clearly to clients and colleagues.
  • Guidance and Review: Provides constructive technical guidance to analysts and reviews their work.
  • Ownership: Independently leads assigned work, including timelines, dependencies, and deliverables.
  • Process Improvement: Improves recurring work through appropriate automation and clear SOPs.
  • Continuity: Helps resolve blockers or represents Data Success when the Director needs support.

Physical and Medical Standards, Working Conditions and Environment

  • Must be able to sit or stand at a computer, working remotely and independently from a personal home office.
  • Willingness to travel for onsite meetings and client engagements as needed.


Hours Worked

This is a full-time, 40-hour-per-week position.

This role is part of our active pipeline for upcoming client engagements and is contingent on project availability, with timing aligned to client demand.

Benefits

  • Competitive Salaried Compensation Plans
  • Health Care Plan (Medical, HSAs, Dental & Vision)
  • Retirement Plan (401k)
  • Life Insurance (Basic, Voluntary & AD&D)
  • Dependent & Health Savings Accounts
  • Short Term & Long Term Disability
  • Paid Time Off (Vacation/Sick & Public Holidays)
  • Training & Development Fund
  • Work From Home
  • Charitable Giving to Causes You Believe In

jobs.title: Staff Product Design Engineer — Data
jobs.description:
Hey there!
We’re Fever, the world’s leading tech platform for culture and live entertainment.

Our mission? To democratize access to culture and entertainment. With our proprietary cutting-edge technology and data-driven approach, we’re revolutionizing the way people engage with live entertainment.

Every month, our platform inspires over 300 million people in +55 countries (and counting) to discover unforgettable experiences while also empowering event creators with our data and technology, helping them scale, innovate, and enhance their events to reach new audiences.

Our results? We’ve teamed up with major industry leaders like Netflix, F.C. Barcelona, and Primavera Sound, presented international award-winning experiences, and are backed by several leading global investors! Impressive, right?

To achieve our mission, we are looking for bar-raisers with a hands-on mindset who are eager to help shape the future of entertainment!

Ready to be part of the experience?

Now, let’s discuss this role and what you will do to help achieve Fever’s mission.

About us

Fever is the leading global live-entertainment discovery platform, helping millions of people every month find and enjoy the best experiences in their cities. We combine technology, data and creativity to power experiences in hundreds of cities worldwide, and we work with creators and partners to bring them to life.

The Data and AI team sits at the core of Fever's data-driven philosophy, driving how Fever makes rigorous decisions and builds bleeding-edge technology. We are growing a new group of Design Engineers who will design and build across all of Fever's products, from B2C to B2B, using data to guide every decision and making those products not just correct, but delightful, fast and genuinely useful.

About the role

Think. Design. Build. If that's how you like to work, this role could be for you.

As a Design Engineer you'll shape Fever products end to end, from B2C to B2B: understanding the problem, defining the solution and designing it with real craft. Some projects will end in a polished design. In others, the right call is to take it into code, whether that's a working prototype or a production-ready feature you ship yourself. You'll move comfortably across both, choosing what each problem needs.

What you'll do

  • Work on high-impact projects across Fever: discovery surfaces like the feed and our AI-powered assistant, critical reports and data-driven decision-making tools for our partners and internal teams, immersive funnels, and innovative initiatives that drive the business and raise the quality of our products.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer - Elixir
jobs.description:
Hey there!
We’re Fever, the world’s leading tech platform for culture and live entertainment.

Our mission? To democratize access to culture and entertainment. With our proprietary cutting-edge technology and data-driven approach, we’re revolutionizing the way people engage with live entertainment.

Every month, our platform inspires over 300 million people in +55 countries (and counting) to discover unforgettable experiences while also empowering event creators with our data and technology, helping them scale, innovate, and enhance their events to reach new audiences.

Our results? We’ve teamed up with major industry leaders like Netflix, F.C. Barcelona, and Primavera Sound, presented international award-winning experiences, and are backed by several leading global investors! Impressive, right?

To achieve our mission, we are looking for bar-raisers with a hands-on mindset who are eager to help shape the future of entertainment!

Ready to be part of the experience?

Now, let’s discuss this role and what you will do to help achieve Fever’s mission.

Behind the user-friendly iOS and Android apps and webpage that work across the world is the engineering team. We are in charge of creating, developing, improving, and maintaining all Fever services so that more people can have an amazing experience.

About the role

Location: Spain - 100% Home office friendly.

What are we looking for:

We are looking for a Senior Software Engineer to join the Engineering team with outstanding software development talent proven by great work results/experience. Somebody who cares about code quality and not just getting things done, but getting things done right.

If you're smart, have great energy, can't think about a system without a CI/CD pipeline, and you want to thrive in a fast-paced environment, we are in sync.

What would you do at Fever?

In your first month at Fever:

  • You will be fully integrated into the team. You will participate in planning, grooming, and retrospectives of the team, and you will have met the departments of Fever.
  • You will get familiar with Fever’s tech stack: frameworks used to develop our applications, CI/CD workflows, and infrastructure that support our operations.
  • You will have lots of Pull Requests merged and running in production.
  • You will attend some of the Fever Originals’ experiences, like Candlelight.

After 3 months in Fever:

  • You will be able to come up with solutions to new difficult problems, defining the solution from the architecture design to its implementation.
  • You will continue creating production-grade Python code designed to handle high levels of traffic, measuring the outcome of the functionalities and improving the product.
  • You will participate in some of the hackdays or hackathons we organise with other teams, and you will mostly know everybody from engineering.

In your 6th month at Fever:

  • You will have responsibilities over different parts of the systems, analysing the usage from the users and evolving the platform to meet the users’ needs.
  • You will have participated in the launch of one of our new microservices, from 0 to production.
  • You will mentor other team members through code reviews, architecture design sessions, and pair programming.
  • You will participate in some of the team-building we organise for your team or the whole engineering team.

About you

Must have skills:

  • Strong knowledge of good practices, testing, and design patterns.
  • Experience with event streaming platforms such as Kafka or RabbitMQ.
  • Handling services with high concurrency and high-volume requests.
  • You know how to deliver code from development to production.
  • Experience with RESTful APIs (implementation and consumption)
  • Knowledge of relational databases and SQL
  • You are proficient in business English

We use these technologies, so it would be a plus if you have experience in:

  • Django/Flask
  • PostgreSQL and Redis
  • AWS, Docker, and Kubernetes

Benefits & Perks

  • 23 days of vacation plus half a day on your birthday
  • Private medical insurance sponsored by the company
  • 40% discount on Fever Marketplace
  • Flexibility to work from home
  • English & Spanish conversational classes
  • Wellhub (former Gympass) membership
  • Possibility to receive part of your salary in advance with Payflow
  • Flexible remuneration with Cobee
  • Budget for engineering events and trainings
  • Young and international environment
  • Attractive compensation package consisting of base salary and the potential to earn a significant bonus for top performance.
    • Base Salary: 50K - 75K EUR
    • Total Compensation: 67K - 90K EUR (Including Base, Variable, and Stock Options)

About the process

Fever aims to provide the best and fastest possible experience to our candidates. This is how it would look like:

  • Talent Interview - 1h: An intro to Fever, our culture, and a conversation about your background and experience.
  • Technical Interview - 2h: A deep dive into your technical expertise through a system design discussion and a short coding exercise, giving you the chance to walk us through your reasoning and problem-solving approach — and ask us anything about your day-to-day at Fever.
  • Manager Interview - 1.5h: A conversation about how you communicate context and trade-offs, own outcomes, quantify impact, and think about reliability, scale, and system design decisions.

Thank you for considering joining Fever. We cannot wait to learn more about you!

jobs.title: Senior Benefits Specialist
jobs.description:
Zscaler (NASDAQ: ZS) accelerates digital transformation so customers can be more agile, efficient, resilient, and secure. The Zscaler Zero Trust Exchange platform protects thousands of customers from cyberattacks and data loss by securely connecting users, devices, and applications in any location. Distributed across 200+ public data centers globally and thousands of private sites at the edge, the SASE-based Zero Trust Exchange is the world’s largest in-line cloud security platform.

We believe the future of work is Human + AI and are building an AI-native enterprise where human potential is amplified by machine intelligence to solve the world’s hardest security challenges. Driven by deep customer obsession, we are committed to the mission, outcome, and to each other. We bring these commitments to life through three core behaviors: ownership and collaboration, trust through outcomes and impact, and a challenge culture with ongoing feedback. Ready to make an impact at the company pioneering security transformation in the AI era? Join us at Zscaler.

Role

We are looking for a Senior Benefits Operations Specialist to join our People & Culture team. Reporting to the Senior Manager, People Operations EMEA, you will serve as a subject matter expert in the day-to-day execution and administration of our EMEA benefit programs in a remote role based in Ireland. In this position, you will act as the operational backbone of the benefits function, ensuring that the complete employee lifecycle from onboarding to off-boarding is managed with precision, empathy, and regulatory compliance, focusing on high-touch administration of complex leave cases and seamless benefits concierge delivery.

What you’ll do (Role Expectations)

  • Lead the end-to-end administration for new hire enrollments, leaver processing, and off-cycle qualifying life events while owning the monthly benefits-to-payroll data bridge

  • Manage the submission and tracking of insurance claims for disability and sick leave, conducting quarterly headcount audits to ensure 100% data integrity with all benefit providers

  • Serve as the senior point of escalation for complex employee inquiries, resolving issues within defined SLAs and educating staff on the most beneficial support options

  • Identify process ambiguities to document solutions in Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) and manage the end-to-end invoice reconciliation process for all vendor billing

Who You Are (Success Profile)

  • You thrive in ambiguity. You're comfortable building the path as you walk it, seeing dynamic workplace shifts not as a hindrance, but as the raw material to build something meaningful.

  • You act like an owner. Your passion for the mission fuels your bias for action, operating with integrity and seamlessly navigating between high-level strategy and hands-on execution.

  • You are a problem-solver. You actively seek out challenges and find energy in crafting solutions, knowing that solving tough operational problems delivers the greatest impact.

  • You are a high-trust collaborator. You are ambitious for the broader team, embracing candor delivered with clarity and respect as the truest form of teamwork and the fastest way to build trust.

  • You are a learner. You possess a growth mindset, proactively seeking feedback and pursuing self-development to elevate partnership and deliver purpose-driven work.

What We’re Looking for (Minimum Qualifications)

  • Demonstrated ability to leverage AI technologies and modern digital workflows to drive measurable operational efficiency

  • Bachelor’s degree in HR, Business, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience

  • 8+ years of dedicated experience in HR benefits administration, with an emphasis on benefits operations

  • Project management experience within an HR or people operations environment

  • Technical proficiency in HRIS (Workday preferred), payroll systems, and benefit vendor portals

  • Advanced Excel skills for data auditing, payroll reporting, and invoice reconciliation

What Will Make You Stand Out (Preferred Qualifications)

  • Experience leveraging generative AI tools and process automation platforms to optimize employee service delivery and scale operational workflows

  • Direct experience working within a global, public SaaS or high-growth technology organization

  • Demonstrated ability to operate independently and make sound decisions with minimal guidance in a fast-paced environment

#LI-Remote

#LI-LJ1

Zscaler’s salary ranges are benchmarked and determined by role and level. The range displayed on this job posting reflects the minimum and maximum target for new hire base salaries for this position across all Ireland locations. Individual pay placement within this range is determined based on objective, gender-neutral criteria including job-related skills, relevant experience, and education or training. The base salary range listed for this full-time position excludes commission/bonus/equity (if applicable) and benefits.

Base Pay Range

€64.000—€92.000 EUR

At Zscaler, we are committed to building a team that reflects the communities we serve and the customers we work with. We foster an inclusive environment that values all backgrounds and perspectives, emphasizing collaboration and belonging. Join us in our mission to make doing business seamless and secure.

Our Benefits program is one of the most important ways we support our employees. Zscaler proudly offers comprehensive and inclusive benefits to meet the diverse needs of our employees and their families throughout their life stages, including:

  • Various health plans
  • Time off plans for vacation and sick time
  • Parental leave options
  • Retirement options
  • Education reimbursement
  • In-office perks, and more!

Learn more about Zscaler's hybrid working model and benefits here.

By applying for this role, you adhere to applicable laws, regulations, and Zscaler policies, including those related to security and privacy standards and guidelines.

Zscaler is committed to providing equal employment opportunities to all individuals. We strive to create a workplace where employees are treated with respect and have the chance to succeed. All qualified applicants will be considered for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy or related medical conditions), age, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, genetic information, disability status, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local laws. See more information by clicking on the Know Your Rights: Workplace Discrimination is Illegal link.

Pay Transparency

Zscaler complies with all applicable federal, state, and local pay transparency rules.

Zscaler is committed to providing reasonable support (called accommodations or adjustments) in our recruiting processes for candidates who are differently abled, have long term conditions, mental health conditions or sincerely held religious beliefs, or who are neurodivergent or require pregnancy-related support.

jobs.description:
Overview

Position Overview:

Join HealthEdge as Senior Manager, FP&A – Risk Adjustment and take on a key leadership role in shaping our financial future. In this position, you will lead financial planning and analysis for the Risk Adjustment organization, manage and develop a team of FP&A Analysts, and serve as a trusted financial partner and advisor to Risk Adjustment leadership. You will own the forecasting, budgeting, and reporting cadence for the Risk Adjustment P&L, translate complex financial and operational data into clear insights for executive audiences, and drive the analytical rigor, scalability, and process discipline that allow FP&A to grow with the business. This role combines strong financial acumen and people leadership with advanced analytical and data capabilities to improve forecasting accuracy, reporting efficiency, and scalable decision support.

Reports To: SVP, Financial Planning & Analysis

About Center of Excellence:

Centers of Excellence (COE) are teams whose primary goal is to provide expertise in a specific field. COEs will usually provide support through training, research, and skilled leaders. In the case of HealthEdge, our Centers of Excellence incorporate the Human Resources, IT, Legal and Financial fields, all of which provide support to our Product divisions and allow the enterprise to move forward and achieve its goals.

Team Leadership:

This role directly manages a team of FP&A Analysts supporting the Risk Adjustment organization. The Senior Manager is responsible for hiring, coaching, developing, and performance management of the team; setting priorities and workload; reviewing deliverables for quality and accuracy; and building the technical and business-partnering skills of team members over time.

What You Will Do:

  • Lead the FP&A function supporting the Risk Adjustment organization, serving as the primary financial business partner and trusted advisor to Risk Adjustment leaders
  • Manage, mentor, and develop a team of FP&A Analysts, including workload prioritization, quality review of deliverables, and career development
  • Own the preparation and review of monthly revenue and expense forecasts for HealthEdge's Risk Adjustment P&L, ensuring accuracy and timeliness
  • Direct the build, maintenance, and enhancement of complex financial models supporting monthly forecasts, annual budgets, and long-range planning
  • Oversee preparation and delivery of monthly and year-to-date management reporting packages, including KPI tracking and variance analysis, ensuring insights are actionable for leadership
  • Lead financial analyses, executive commentary, and presentation materials for monthly executive and operational reviews, presenting directly to senior leadership
  • Provide deep technical and analytical expertise, and guide the team, in responding to complex, ad-hoc reporting and data requests
  • Partner with Finance, IT, and business stakeholders on system implementations, upgrades, and migrations impacting financial planning and reporting
  • Champion the design and enhancement of automated reporting, dashboards, and data models to reduce manual effort and improve accuracy and timeliness
  • Develop and maintain a quantitative and qualitative analytics framework that integrates financial, operational, and performance data
  • Identify and lead opportunities for process standardization, automation, and efficiency gains across forecasting, reporting, and analysis workflows
  • Drive continuous improvement initiatives that enable FP&A to scale effectively with the growth of the business
  • Escalate risks, opportunities, and key business drivers to senior finance and Risk Adjustment leadership in a clear, timely manner

  • 7+ years of experience in Corporate FP&A, finance business partnering, or related analytical roles, including prior experience leading or mentoring other analysts

  • Highly organized with a track record of building standardized, efficient, and scalable processes that enable teams to meet tight deadlines in a fast-paced environment
  • Experience leading or participating in financial system implementations, migrations, or planning tool enhancements a plus
  • Advanced Microsoft Excel (financial modeling, complex formulas, large datasets); experience with SQL, BI tools, or automation platforms is a strong plus
  • Experience using Oracle Enterprise Performance Management (EPM) / Planning and Budgeting Cloud Solution strongly preferred

jobs.title: State Government Affairs Associate (West)
jobs.description:
OVERVIEW

The Foundation for Government Accountability (FGA)is hiring a State Government Affairs Associate (West) to keep our reform campaigns moving across our Western states. In this role, you’ll work alongside our State Government Affairs Directors to track bills, manage follow-up with lawmakers, and build materials for the 2027 sessions.

This role is built for someone who wants to win policy fights in more than one state at a time. You’ll have a hand in every Western portfolio, from digging into bill data to pitching legislators in statehouses across the region.

The ideal candidate brings three to five years in state government affairs, campaigns, or policy work. This role is remote and reports to the Senior Director of State Affairs for the Western states. Expect frequent travel, especially during session.

CULTURE AND FIT

The people who consistently succeed at FGA are those whose actions and behavior reflect our five Core Values. If you adhere to these values and answer “yes” to each of the following questions, you may be a fit.

1)Candid to Solve: Being willing to have tough conversations in order to solve issues and build trust.

  • Do you seek out constructive feedback—and provide it to others—to solve issues and build trust with coworkers?

2)Grow or Die: We don’t have a neutral gear; we must consistently challenge ourselves and each other to grow in our talents and skills.

  • Are you aware of your strengths and weaknesses, and do you seek out complementary skills and growth in order to mitigate your weaknesses?

3)Politically Savvy:Policy doesn’t change in a vacuum, but in a political reality that we must understand and account for.

  • Do you agree that embracing the realities of politics is necessary to change public policy?

4)Partnership-Oriented: Internal and external relationships are not transactional. That starts with our team members and the perspective that we need the rest of the team to succeed in order to win personally.

  • Are you comfortable creating your own structure for work, such as setting work hours, your own priorities, and creating clarity and a work plan from a broad goal?

5)Bought in to Win: We’re at FGA because we want to change policy. No one is counting hours or widgets. We are here to get results, and sometimes, that will require going the extra mile or doing a job that isn’t technically ours.

  • Do you fully support FGA’s mission and believe that lives are improved through work, not welfare, and that free markets create more freedom and opportunity than government control?

These values shape how we hire and how we work together. Expect to talk about them openly during the interview process.

ROLES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

As State Government Affairs Associate (West), you will have four primary areas of responsibility:

1) Support the State Government Affairs Directors

  • Manage bill tracking, meeting follow-up, and back-end data.
  • Build and send the materials directors need for lawmakers and partners.

2) Represent FGA in the States

  • Join stakeholder and committee meetings at the direction of the Senior Director of State Affairs to advance FGA’s reforms.
  • Travel with directors on state trips to meet lawmakers and present FGA’s reforms.

3) Work with FGA’s In-State Contractors

  • Build working relationships with the in-state contractors in each director’s portfolio.
  • Join update and strategy calls and manage the follow-up.

4) Build State Plans and Session Reports

  • Work with the directors on pre-session plans for each state.
  • Draft post-session reports once the 2027 sessions close.

REQUIREMENTS

  • Three to five years in state government affairs, campaigns, or policy work.
  • Working knowledge of how bills move through a statehouse, from committee to the governor’s desk.
  • Strong communicator with lawmakers, partners, and teammates.
  • Comfortable using AI to speed up research, drafting, and data work. Quorum or other bill tracking experience a plus.
  • Live in or near the Western states region for frequent travel, especially during session.
  • Match FGA’s Core Values (described above).

TIMING, LOCATION, AND COMPENSATION

FGA is seeking to fill this position as soon as possible. Beyond travel to the states, expect legislative fly-ins and quarterly team meetings.

FGA’s headquarters are in Naples, FL, but nearly all of our staff work remotely from across the country. We build our systems and culture around clarity, flexibility, and strong communication. Key elements include:

  • Quarterly in-person team meetings at which you’ll build deeper relationships, set clear goals aligned with FGA’s big vision, and brainstorm how to seize new opportunities
  • An intensive 90-day orientation to familiarize you with the FGA team, our policies, and how we operate
  • Home office setup, including equipment and communication tools you need to hit the ground running

FGA offers a competitive salary between $90,000–$120,000, depending on experience and qualifications, along with a benefits package that includes a six percent retirement match, health benefits, and generous paid leave.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager, Fraud & Risk
jobs.description:
About Tala

Tala is the AI-native credit infrastructure that connects global capital to the global majority. We combine proprietary risk intelligence with an expanding network of capital and distribution partners to power credit access at scale. To date, Tala has distributed more than $9 billion in capital to more than 14 million customers across Africa, Latin America, and Asia, building the definitive contextual dataset on thin-file borrowers in emerging markets. Tala is now converting that foundation into shared infrastructure that partners, capital providers, and ecosystems can build on.

The company has been named to the Fortune Impact 20 list, CNBC’s World’s Top Fintech Companies twice, CNBC Disruptor 50 for five years, and Forbes’ Fintech 50 list for ten years running.

Given the global nature of our team, we operate on a remote-first approach with office hubs in Santa Monica, CA (HQ); Nairobi, Kenya; Mexico City, Mexico; Manila, the Philippines; and Bangalore, India.

Most Talazens join us because they connect with our mission. If you are energized by the impact you can make at Tala, we’d love to hear from you!

The Role

Tala is on a mission to unleash the economic power of the global majority. We’re building financial services that give people greater access, control, and agency over their financial lives.

As Tala continues to scale, protecting our customers while creating a seamless experience is more important than ever. We’re looking for a Senior Product Manager, Fraud & Authentication to lead the strategy and execution of the systems that keep our customers and platform safe.

As the Senior Product Manager, Fraud & Authentication, you’ll own Tala’s product strategy for fraud prevention, customer authentication, and identity-related experiences across the customer journey.

You’ll tackle complex problems at the intersection of fraud, risk, machine learning, data, engineering, and customer experience.

Your goal will be to help Tala identify and prevent fraudulent activity while minimizing unnecessary friction for legitimate customers.

You’ll work closely with Engineering, Data Science, Analytics, Lending, Finance, Customer Care, Marketing, Legal, and other global teams to turn complex fraud patterns and ambiguous problems into scalable products and systems.

This is a highly cross-functional role for someone who enjoys solving difficult problems with data, moving quickly, and building products that have a measurable impact on both customers and the business.

What You'll Do

Own Fraud & Authentication Product Strategy

  • Define and own Tala’s multi-year product strategy and roadmap for fraud prevention, customer authentication, identity, and related risk capabilities.
  • Identify opportunities to improve fraud prevention across signup, login, account management, and other high-risk customer actions.
  • Balance fraud prevention with customer experience by reducing fraud losses and false positives while minimizing unnecessary friction.
  • Translate complex fraud patterns, emerging attack vectors, and business needs into clear product strategies and priorities.

Build Data-Driven Fraud Products

  • Partner closely with Data Science and Analytics to define model objectives, evaluate model and feature performance, and identify opportunities to improve detection.
  • Help determine appropriate fraud decision thresholds and rules based on data and business objectives.
  • Establish and monitor key metrics such as fraud loss rates, detection accuracy, false-positive rates, customer conversion, and authentication success.
  • Identify data gaps and work with technical teams to improve the data and infrastructure needed to make effective fraud decisions.
  • Collaborate on fraud detection models, rules, feature infrastructure, and decisioning systems.

Lead Product Execution

  • Translate ambiguous fraud and authentication problems into clear product requirements that Engineering teams can execute against.
  • Lead a cross-functional team of engineers and partners to deliver the roadmap.
  • Prioritize initiatives based on customer impact, fraud exposure, business value, technical complexity, and data.

jobs.title: Staff Product Manager, Marketing Automation - US
jobs.description:
Luxury Presence is building the AI growth platform for real estate. Backed by Bessemer Venture Partners and other top investors, we're a Series C company that has hit $100M in annual recurring revenue. More than 90,000 real estate professionals, including over 30% of the WSJ Real Trends top 100 agents in the United States, use us to run and grow their business.

Role Overview

We're looking for a Staff Product Manager to own a core part of how our clients market themselves: the websites, content, and campaigns that get them found, keep them top of mind, and turn attention into business. Our clients are real estate professionals, many of them top producers in luxury markets, and they count on us for the marketing they don't have time to do themselves.

Generating marketing content is easy now. Generating content a top agent is proud to put their name on is not. That bar, across every channel our clients use, is the game we're in. So is proving what works: showing clients how their channels feed each other and which ones are actually driving business.

This is a high-impact, high-visibility role with close collaboration across engineering, design, AI/ML, client success, and sales. You'll own a product area end to end, set its strategy, and grow its scope as we expand into new channels.

What You'll Do

  • Own the product strategy, roadmap, and results for a set of AI-powered marketing products, starting with how our clients get discovered and the content we create for them
  • Make sure our clients get found, whether a prospective buyer or seller searches on Google or asks an AI assistant who to call
  • Raise the quality bar on everything we create on our clients' behalf, so it sounds like them and reflects the brand they've built
  • Design how channels work together, so a client's website, content, email, and social reinforce each other instead of running as separate tools
  • Build the measurement and attribution that show clients, and us, how those channels drive each other and which ones are actually producing business
  • Run structured betas with real clients, set clear hypotheses up front, and keep iterating until clients would be upset to lose what you've built

  • Multichannel instincts. You understand how search, content, email, social, and paid work together as a system, and you want to see the numbers move across all of them, not just one
  • Experience building marketing technology: products businesses use to grow their own customer base

  • You learn fast and use AI as a normal part of how you work: to research, to prototype, and to get to ground truth quickly

Preferred Qualifications

  • You've built email, lifecycle, or campaign tools, or products that generate marketing content with AI

  • Familiarity with premium or luxury brands and how they market differently
  • Experience at a platform where one change reaches many customers' sites or accounts at once

Compensation

Additional Information

Join us in shaping the future of real estate

The real estate industry is in the midst of a seismic shift, and the future belongs to those who break new ground. jobs.title: Director, Retrieval Operations (Inventory Strategy)
jobs.description:
Datavant is the data collaboration platform trusted for healthcare. Guided by our mission to make the world’s health data secure, accessible and actionable, we provide critical data solutions for organizations across the healthcare ecosystem - including providers, health plans, researchers, and life sciences companies. From fulfilling a single patient’s request for their medical records to powering the AI revolution in healthcare, Datavanters are building the future of how data is connected and used to improve health.

By joining Datavant today, you’re stepping onto a driven and highly collaborative team that is passionate about creating transformative change in healthcare.

The Director, Retrieval Operations – Inventory Strategy is responsible for translating client retrieval demand into actionable inventory plans across retrieval channels, operational teams, and vendor partners. This leader owns inventory forecasting, prioritization, routing, allocation, pacing, and performance governance for Payer Retrieval Operations.

In this role, “inventory” refers to the record requests and charts moving through Datavant’s retrieval ecosystem. The Director ensures inventory progresses through the appropriate retrieval channels while balancing client commitments, operational capacity, retrieval yield, service levels, and cost.

This leader will build a scalable, data-driven inventory-planning discipline that connects project demand with workforce capacity and daily production requirements. They will partner closely with Operations, Workforce Management, Call Center leadership, Client Success, Product, Engineering, Analytics, Finance, and vendor leadership to identify risks, establish priorities, and improve retrieval outcomes.

You Will

  • Own the inventory strategy and planning framework for Payer Retrieval, translating client demand, project milestones, and retrieval targets into actionable weekly and daily operating plans.
  • Establish forecasting, segmentation, and prioritization strategies based on client commitments, project pacing, inventory age, chart density, retrieval method, anticipated yield, service levels, and cost, while continuously assessing inventory health and opportunities to improve flow.
  • Own the strategic framework and business rules for routing inventory across retrieval channels based on provider behavior, inventory characteristics, client requirements, capacity, quality, yield, and cost.
  • Evaluate channel and partner performance and adjust inventory distribution to reduce delays, unnecessary touches, and manual intervention while improving retrieval outcomes and cost efficiency.
  • Monitor project performance against client commitments, retrieval targets, historical pacing curves, and operating plans, identifying emerging risks and leading recovery planning for inventory that is behind pace, aging, blocked, unmatched, or otherwise not progressing.
  • Use scenario planning to evaluate changes in demand, capacity, productivity, channel availability, and client priorities and provide leaders with clear, data-supported recommendations.
  • Partner with Workforce Management and operational leaders to connect inventory demand with staffing and capacity plans, translate available capacity into realistic production plans, and adjust prioritization or allocation strategies when constraints arise.
  • Support annual planning, budgeting, and forecasting by connecting client demand, inventory availability, operational capacity, productivity expectations, and financial targets.
  • Establish KPIs, dashboards, and governance routines that measure inventory health, forecasting accuracy, project pacing, routing effectiveness, productivity, retrieval yield, service-level performance, unit economics, and cost.
  • Partner with Business Intelligence and Analytics to deliver accurate, actionable reporting and translate complex operational data into clear insights and executive-level recommendations.
  • Partner with Product, Engineering, and Analytics to continuously refine inventory prioritization and routing logic, define success measures, evaluate operational impact, and establish a roadmap for future iterations.
  • Partner with Call Center leadership, which owns the outreach strategy, to determine how inventory should be segmented between human calls and Voice AI based on inventory characteristics, provider needs, client requirements, complexity, anticipated outcomes, and cost.
  • Work cross-functionally to identify and prioritize automation opportunities that reduce manual effort, improve inventory flow, and increase operational efficiency, supporting implementation, measurement, and ongoing optimization.
  • Lead, coach, and develop the Inventory Strategy team while building strong cross-functional partnerships and serving as a trusted advisor to senior leadership on inventory strategy, project pacing, capacity requirements, operational risks, and retrieval performance.

What You Will Bring to the Table

  • Bachelor’s degree in business, operations, supply chain, analytics, finance, healthcare administration, or a related field, or equivalent relevant experience.
  • Eight or more years of progressive experience in operations, inventory planning, demand forecasting, capacity planning, workforce planning, or a related field, including at least three years leading teams.
  • Experience translating demand forecasts and business objectives into actionable production, routing, prioritization, and capacity plans in a high-volume, multi-channel service or workflow environment.
  • Demonstrated ability to identify performance risks, develop recovery plans, establish operational governance, and influence decisions across organizational boundaries.
  • Strong financial and analytical skills, including experience evaluating productivity, capacity, service, yield, cost, and other operational tradeoffs.
  • Experience partnering with Product and Engineering to develop and iterate operational technology, automation, AI-enabled workflows, prioritization logic, or decision-support capabilities, including defining requirements and measuring business impact.
  • Exceptional executive communication skills and the ability to convert complex analysis into clear recommendations and actions.
  • Proficiency with spreadsheets, data-visualization, business-intelligence, forecasting, or enterprise-planning tools; experience with SQL or similar analytical tools is a plus.
  • Experience in healthcare operations, medical-record retrieval, payer operations, vendor management, or another complex service environment is strongly preferred.
