jobs.title: Director of Product - Network
jobs.description:
We were tired of hearing that healthcare is broken, so we decided to do something about it. At Nomi Health, we believe the care itself isn’t broken — it’s the business of healthcare that gets in the way. Every year, more than $1 trillion is wasted on paperwork, delays, and middle layers that drive up costs and keep people from the care they need.

We’re rebuilding the system so it works the way it should: clear prices you can trust, faster payments that keep providers focused on patients, and data that helps employers make better decisions. Our work has already touched more than 30 million lives — from local communities in Michigan to some of the largest companies in the country.

What You'll Do:

  • Market solution design. Partner with network, go-to-market, and sales teams to define and scope what Nomi can realistically deliver in each new market before it's sold, including provider coverage, TPA capability, and integration sequencing.
  • Partner and TPA data exchange. Write the integration requirements between Nomi and every partner in the claim lifecycle — inbound claims, priced output, remittance, eligibility, file cadence, SLAs, and reconciliation — specific enough that an engineer on either side can build to it.
  • Network configuration and pricing. Own the path from a signed rate sheet to a correctly priced claim: ingestion, normalization, versioning, effective dating, validation, and audit. Set the testing and release bar for anything that touches pricing.
  • Provider data, adequacy, and directory. Own the provider data model and hierarchy — sponsor, tax ID, billing NPI, service location — and make network adequacy and directory accuracy measurable rather than asserted.
  • New segments and group types. Evaluate new group types and segments as they come up, be willing to recommend against ones that don't fit, and defend that recommendation to sales.
  • The payments interface. Recognize when a network change has payment-side consequences and get ahead of it with the financial services and payments teams before it ships.

What We're Looking For:

  • Reimbursement fluency. You understand the difference between billed, allowed, and paid, and you've worked hands-on with real fee schedules and rate methodologies, percent-of-Medicare, per diem, case rate, DRG, percent-of-charge.
  • Domain background. You've built this expertise at a health plan, a TPA, a repricing or payment-integrity vendor, a reference-based-pricing administrator, a provider revenue-cycle organization, or a network contracting organization.
  • Data exchange experience. You're comfortable with 837, 835, and eligibility file exchange, and you've written integration requirements that another team was able to build from successfully.
  • Commercial confidence. You're comfortable representing Nomi directly in front of a broker, a TPA executive, or a health system, and making commitments you can stand behind.
  • A self-directed approach. You're comfortable defining your own priorities and figuring out what matters most, rather than working off a pre-built roadmap.
  • Enough technical fluency to be credible. You can read a data model, write SQL against it, and give an engineer clear enough direction that they're not left guessing. You won't be writing production code yourself.
  • Strong written communication. Requirements documents are a core part of this role, so your writing should be clear, specific, and easy for others to build from.

Preferred Experiences:

  • Experience in self-funded employer health: TPA administration, direct contracting, reference-based pricing, or captives.
  • You've run a platform migration or a vendor claims-system implementation and lived through the reporting gap that follows.
  • Founder or early-operator background, or a track record of using automation and AI to replace manual operational work.

Compensation

Additional Information

Nomi Health delivers disruptive healthcare solutions, in partnership with like-minded employers, public sector organizations, advisors (brokers/consultants), and payers/TPAs. We’re a team of 300+ people who show up every day with the same mindset: don’t settle for “that’s just how it is.” Real change happens when you challenge the system, cut through the excuses, and build something better together.

jobs.title: Senior Marketing Manager
jobs.description:
About Enode

The grid was built for predictable, centralised power. Today it's absorbing intermittent supply from grid scale solar and wind, alongside dynamic demand from EVs, heat pumps, and home batteries. The missing piece is software that can connect and orchestrate these devices at scale.

We’re the layer between the home and the grid. Our platform connects every asset, coordinates every home and shapes thousands as one. Asset connectivity gives energy retailers one API for 1,000+ device models across 100+ brands. Home energy coordination turns that connection into smarter behavior at home, like charging an EV in the cheapest hours or using more of your own solar. Residential flexibility brings connected homes together into a dispatchable resource the grid can count on.

Europe’s largest energy companies build on Enode: retailers, utilities and the teams that trade for them. The platform spans 1.7M+ connected households and 5,000+ MW of controllable load. We’re backed by Y Combinator, Lowercarbon Capital and Creandum.

The decisions made now will shape how the next grid gets built. We’re looking for people who take ownership, think clearly under complexity and care deeply about the craft of building software that matters.

AI is fundamental to how we work

AI is how a team our size keeps rewiring the way we work, fast enough to match what our mission demands. We look for people who reach for AI as a reflex and who can drop a habit that used to work. People who care about unblocking others, not just about what they ship themselves. If that's not quite how you work yet but it's the direction you're heading, we'd still like to hear from you. We assess this in our interview process, alongside everything else we look at.

What we're looking for

We're hiring a Senior Marketing Manager to build Enode's growth engine and shape how energy companies across Europe discover and understand what we do.

Millions of EVs, heat pumps, batteries and solar systems are coming onto the grid, and energy companies need software to connect and coordinate them. We have a strong product, a new brand and a growing list of enterprise customers. We now want to build a marketing function that sharpens how we tell our story and creates a steady flow of demand from the companies we most want to work with.

This is an opportunity to build marketing at a renewable energy tech company in one of the most interesting parts of the energy transition, where your work has a direct effect on how quickly homes electrify.

You'll report to Fredrik, our VP Revenue, and work closely with our account executives, Customer Success and Partnerships teams. You'll also work with Daniël, our Head of Design, and the Design team, who own our brand and visual identity.

You'll have a lot of ownership from day one. There's no team underneath you, so you'll do much of the hands on work yourself, and you'll play a central part in defining what marketing at Enode looks like in 2027 and beyond.

In this role, you will:

  • Build Enode's demand generation engine, creating a steady flow of conversations with the energy companies we most want to work with.

  • Run account based marketing with our account executives, getting to know our key accounts in depth and building relationships with the executives who make decisions.

  • Sharpen our positioning and story, based on a clear understanding of what energy retailers, utilities and traders need and where they're under pressure.

  • Write the copy for campaigns, outreach, our website and LinkedIn, so the way we talk about Enode is clear and consistent everywhere.

  • Shape the marketing roadmap for 2027 and beyond with Fredrik, including priorities, budget, channels and events.

  • Plan and run campaigns and events that put Enode in front of the right people, and learn quickly from what works.

  • Build AI workflows that let you work at the scale of a larger team, from researching accounts and mapping buying groups to personalising outreach and reporting on results.

  • Measure marketing's impact on pipeline in HubSpot and use it to decide where to invest next.

This role will be right for you, if

You're a B2B marketer who enjoys building things. You've created demand for a technical product and seen your work turn into real conversations and deals, working closely with sales on the accounts that matter most. You like getting to the heart of what customers need, and you can turn a complex product into a story a commercial director understands and remembers. You write well and enjoy doing it.

You've likely been the first or only marketer at a company, or you're a senior marketer at a larger company who wants more room to shape things. AI is already part of how you work: you've built your own workflows for research, outreach and analysis, and you're curious about what else it can do. You care about the energy transition and want your work to help speed it up. You bring:

  • Experience building demand generation for a B2B product, including owning a pipeline target.

  • Account based marketing experience with named enterprise accounts, including reaching executives.

  • Strong copywriting and storytelling, with examples you wrote yourself.

  • Experience leading positioning or go-to-market work for a technical product.

  • Familiarity with HubSpot or a similar CRM.

Nice to have:

  • Experience in energy, utilities, mobility or climate tech.

  • A background as the first or only marketer at a startup.

  • Prior exposure to running events that led to meetings and pipeline.

What we offer:

  • Opportunity to join and impact an early-stage climate tech startup with global aspirations as we scale.

  • A mission-driven, fun and caring environment with high drive and ambition.

  • Competitive compensation, including a very attractive employee option program - you’re part of our journey.

  • Access to best in class AI tooling, we think the ceiling on what a small team can do has fundamentally shifted, and we want you to feel that.

  • Real investment in your AI fluency. Dedicated time to build the skill, an internal skills library you can contribute to, and the tooling budget to work properly.

  • Remote-first in Europe, with the option of attending an office in Oslo or receiving a co-working pass on demand.

  • Three annual off-sites to connect with the team in exciting & fun places.

  • Flexible, human-first culture.

  • Stipend for setting up your home office.

------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

A few things to note:

  • Enode is an equal opportunities employer. Don’t meet every single requirement? Studies have shown that women and people of colour are less likely to apply to jobs unless they meet every single qualification. We are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive and authentic workplace, so if you’re excited about this role but your past experience doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway. You may just be the right candidate for this or other roles.

  • Our values are integral to the way we work and are embedded into all our hiring processes. You can read more about our values here.

jobs.title: Junior Performance Marketer (Remote - Greece)
jobs.description:
Our Vision & Products

🚀 EverAI — Building the Future of AI Companionship

One of the Top 15 Largest & Fastest-Growing AI Companies in the World

50 Million Users in 2 years — Help Us Reach 100M first, 500M next

At EverAI, we’re shaping what it means to connect with AI. With 50 million users and counting, we're not just building products — we're creating entirely new categories.

Our flagship product is the world’s largest AI companionship platform, redefining relationships for millions. It is governed by our proprietary moderation system, EverGuard — an internal AI designed to ensure everything we build is safe, ethical, and human-first.

And we’re only just getting started!

Our Team

Alexis Soulopoulos [CEO]

• 10+ years in Tech Executive Leadership

• Co-Founder Mad Paws Holdings (from 0 to IPO)

• Forbes 30 under 30 + Deloitte TechFast50 ’22 & ‘23

Michael Monin [Co-founder & CTO]

Thomas Lacroix [Co-founder & CMO]

Maruša Fasano [CFO/Legal]

• 25+ years in Finance, Strategy, M&A

• Ex-CFO/M&A @Curatible (exited to Blackstone)

• Ex-President of the Board @SotremoSA (exited)

• Co-founder/CFO @SoftOne (exited)

Your Role

You will report to and work closely with our Chief Marketing Officer (CMO), playing a key, hands-on role in the execution and optimization of our high-volume paid acquisition channels.

This is a fast-paced learning environment where you will execute the end-to-end User Acquisition process, from campaign setup and creative iteration to data analysis and reporting. You will have autonomy in your day-to-day execution, with continuous guidance and feedback from the team and senior leadership to accelerate your growth. Your ideas and analytical contributions will be actively sought to improve channel performance.

Your Responsibilities

Campaign Execution and Scaling Support:

  • Assist in the daily management of core paid acquisition channels or DSPs (e.g. Meta, TikTok, Google, etc.)

  • Support the creation of scalable acquisition funnels by ensuring proper tracking implementation and gathering data insights

  • Actively participate in the testing loop by preparing new ad concepts, organizing creative assets, and setting up audience tests

Performance Analysis and Reporting:

  • Monitor campaign and funnel performance using our core tools (Voluum, GA4, internal dashboards) and promptly flag any critical changes or performance anomalies

  • Pull, clean, and organize performance data (CPA, ROAS, retention) to support weekly and monthly strategic reviews

  • Maintain and update internal reporting documents and dashboards

Creative & Funnel Contribution:

  • Support the creative briefing process by gathering performance data and communicating required asset changes and successful angles to the content team

  • Collaborate with Product and Content teams to assist in the launch and testing cycles for landing pages, focusing on conversion rate improvements

  • Assist in documenting and implementing systems designed to streamline creative testing speed and reduce fatigue

Partnership Management & Learning:

  • Build initial rapport with key traffic source representatives, assisting the Senior team in managing communications and reporting performance

  • Research and document potential new acquisition opportunities (networks, formats, tools, etc.)

  • Stay up-to-date on platform rules, policy changes, and algorithm shifts

Challenges You’ll Tackle

In this role, you will be instrumental in supporting our growth goals. Specifically, you will:

  • Help us scale fast: Execute the daily campaign changes needed to grow our budgets while constantly watching the data to keep our cost targets (CAC/ROAS) in check

  • Grow our user base: Your analysis and execution will directly contribute to hitting our goal of growing from 40 million to 100 million users

  • Launch new channels: Handle the foundational setup (tracking, ad setup) required to successfully test and launch completely new advertising platforms

  • Improve conversions: Run A/B tests on landing pages and funnels to find opportunities to make our campaigns more efficient

  • Be the link for creative: Take performance data, translate it into clear suggestions for our creative team, and ensure the new ad concepts are launched and tracked correctly

Your Qualifications

Hard Skills

  • Experience level: Minimum 1 year of experience required in performance marketing or user acquisition

  • Platform curiosity: You have explored and understand the basic structures of major ad platforms (like Meta, TikTok, Google, etc.)

  • Technical aptitude: Ability to quickly learn and master new software, dashboards, and platform interfaces

  • Analytical & Creative ability: You have a good eye for what makes an ad hook effective, and you possess strong analytical skills (comfortable with data/Excel) to learn how to translate data into creative briefs

Nice-to-Haves

  • Familiarity with any analytics or tracking tool (e.g., GA4, Voluum, or basic platform reporting setups)

  • Experience in sensitive or regulated verticals (e.g. dating, femtech, telehealth, etc.)

Soft Skills

🗣 Good communication skills: You are fluent in English and can clearly articulate thoughts and findings

🎯 Driven & Accountable: You are motivated, take full ownership of your tasks, and commit to achieving goals

⚡️ Action-oriented: You thrive in a fast-paced environment and prioritize execution and speed

🧠 Curious & Detail-oriented: You are meticulous with data and possess a strong desire to learn the why behind performance

🧢 Humble learner: You actively seek feedback and are eager to grow in the field of paid acquisition

Why EverAI?

📈 Exponential Growth: From 50M users in 2 years, to 100M next — and 500M beyond

🚀 Track Record of Category-Creating Innovation: We consistently launch world-first AI applications — setting the pace, not following it

🌍 Global Impact: Top-tier user growth, real-world adoption, and cultural relevance

🧠 Proven Leadership: A senior team that’s launched, scaled, and exited & IPO’d multiple scale ups — now fully focused on reshaping AI companionship

👥 Elite Remote Team: 100% remote and built to win — world-class talent from Tier 1 tech companies, with a culture of ownership, velocity, and radical creativity

🛡️ Ethical Core: Our AI ecosystem is governed by EverGuard, our proprietary AI moderation technology, ensuring responsible development at scale

What We Offer

✍️ Contract Type: We prefer B2B, but we’re flexible, what matters is long-term commitment and impact
📍 Work From Anywhere: Fully remote. Choose the environment where you do your best work
🏝️ Paid Time Off: 4 weeks (20 working days) of PTO per year to recharge and reset
👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 Annual Gathering: A yearly in-person meetup to connect, brainstorm, and celebrate wins together
❤️‍🩹 Health & Wellness Support: Monthly allowance of 100 USD for health insurance expenses & access to unlimited 1:1 sessions with psychologists and lifestyle experts through OpenUp (also available to up to three of your family members)
🏢 Co-Working Space Budget: Work from a co-working space up to twice per month (35 EUR / 40 USD per visit) to stay inspired and connected
📚 Learning Budget: Dedicated funds to support your professional growth: courses, books, conferences, events, or certifications
💻 Company Laptop & Equipment: Laptop provided + monitor budget up to 250 USD + keyboard/mouse/mic/headphones budget up to 150 USD
⚡ AI Tools Access: Premium access to ChatGPT, Hugging Face, Claude Code, and any other tool needed to excel at your job, power your ideas and workflows

🎯 Top Tier Talent Is Our Multiplier

We’re a fully remote group of A-players from Tier 1 tech, led by an exec team who’ve launched, scaled, and exited multiple companies. We move fast, and care deeply about what we build — and who we build it with.

We’re looking for exceptional talent ready to ship & distribute world-first AI products at scale, fast, and co-create with us this category-defining business.

If that’s you — reach out and apply!

jobs.description:
Help Us Build The Future of Travel

At Airalo, we're making it easier for people to stay connected wherever they travel. As the world's first eSIM store, we help millions of travelers access affordable mobile data in 200+ countries and regions around the world.

Today, we're a team of 400+ people across 60+ countries, building a product used by travelers every day. We've grown quickly, but we've worked hard to keep what matters: trust, ownership, and the freedom for people to do great work without unnecessary layers or bureaucracy.

We're fully remote by design, genuinely global, and united by a shared mission to make travel simpler for everyone.

Your Next Destination

  • Location: Remote.
  • Contract: Full-time, permanent.
  • Benefits: Learn more about our benefits here in this link - https://airalo-public.notion.site/Benefits-25396a97ffca81fb9bc1f0be479f1be3?pvs=74
  • Languages: English is our main working language day to day, so you'll need to be comfortable communicating in it both in meetings and async.

We're looking for a Staff Data Scientist, Pricing to build the analytical and machine learning capability that pricing runs on, from demand modelling through to the systems that recommend price.

You won't be starting from zero. We've invested in the foundational data and infrastructure that pricing decisions depend on. What's missing is the capability on top: models the business trusts, experiments that settle pricing questions with evidence, and economics defined once so they hold consistently across Commercial, Product and the customer experience.

The arc of the role runs from measurement to prediction to prescription - understanding how demand responds to price, forecasting how it will respond, and ultimately building the models that recommend the price itself.

What You'll Do:

  • Build and own the demand and elasticity modelling capability, quantifying how price affects volume across destination, duration, data tier, and customer segment.

  • Develop machine learning models for demand forecasting and willingness-to-pay, and take them from exploration through to production with the monitoring and retraining that keeps them honest.

  • Move us from predictive to prescriptive by building the optimisation layer that turns forecasts and elasticities into recommended prices under margin, competitive and partner constraints.

  • Design and analyse pricing experiments with statistical rigour, and apply causal methods where clean randomisation isn't possible.

  • Define pricing within our data ecosystem, owning the governed definitions of price, cost and package economics that reporting, analysis and product surfaces all read from.

  • Partner with Commercial and Finance to connect pricing decisions to margin and revenue, and to size opportunities before we commit.

  • Set the analytical standard for pricing at Airalo, from what counts as evidence through to how a model or recommendation gets validated before it influences live pricing.

What You'll Bring:

  • 7+ years in data science, quantitative economics, or applied research, including pricing, monetisation, or marketplace economics work that demonstrably changed decisions.

  • Experience with dynamic or algorithmic pricing systems in production.

  • An advanced degree in Econometrics, Statistics, Operations Research or similar, or equivalent applied depth in demand estimation and the identification problems that make naive price-quantity regressions wrong.

  • Hands-on machine learning experience across the full lifecycle, from feature engineering and model selection through to deployment

  • Familiarity with optimisation and decision-science methods that turn predictions into recommended actions, whether through constrained optimisation, bandits, or reinforcement learning approaches.

  • Proven experimentation expertise, having designed and defended experiments with a clear view on decision frameworks and common failure modes.

  • Experience building analytical capability where none existed before, turning raw data and a business question into something a commercial team uses repeatedly.

  • Strong data modelling instincts, thinking in reusable definitions and single sources of truth rather than standalone analyses.

  • The ability to move comfortably between financial, product and operational data and connect the analysis to a financial outcome.

  • Genuine partnership instincts, translating between analytical rigour and commercial reality so that Commercial and Product come to you early rather than after the decision.

  • Fluency in the Python ML stack alongside strong SQL, with the engineering hygiene to hand over code that others can run and maintain.

  • Excellent communication skills, including the ability to make a methodological argument to people who won't check your standard errors.

Airalo's fully remote Data team is growing, and so is our ambition for how we measure marketing. You'll help Airalo decide where to invest the next dollar by owning how we measure marketing performance: attribution, the data models behind it, and incrementality testing that shows what really works, turning evidence into investment decisions across the globe.

You'll pair solid measurement expertise, including causal inference, with strong core analytics. You'll guide teams on what to measure and test, defend our framework with senior stakeholders, and make sure data changes decisions. This is a small, growing team and a capability that is new to the business: you'll build the process, not inherit it. Expect your time to be split between measurement work (attribution, data modelling and incrementality) and the day-to-day analytics Growth and Marketing rely on.

What You'll Do

  • Support our marketing attribution models and methodology: review how conversions are credited across channels, reconcile platform-reported and first-party numbers, and keep the approach trusted and documented.
  • Design and maintain the marketing data models behind measurement (spend, attribution, orders and customer cohorts) with Analytics Engineering, with clear definitions, tests and documentation.
  • Support Growth and Marketing with ad-hoc and core analytics, such as campaign and market performance, self-serve dashboards and AI-assisted analytics.
  • Design and run geo experiments from simulation-based power analysis and market selection to success criteria and read-out, working with the marketing performance team.
  • Co-own a prioritised quarterly incrementality test roadmap across channels and markets, ranked by decision value, cost, feasibility (including properly powered tests) and learning, and track each test through to a decision.
  • Handle spillover, seasonality and small-market noise, and report incremental CAC and incremental ROAS with honest uncertainty.
  • Turn test results into investment guidance: estimate marginal returns and saturation by channel and market, and recommend where the next dollar should go and where to pull back.
  • Help set and document our causal measurement standards: which method when, what counts as sufficient evidence, and how results calibrate attribution and MMM for budget allocation.
  • Defend the framework under challenge from channel owners and leaders, and pressure-test platform claims.
  • Guide Growth, Acquisition and Finance from business question to testable hypothesis to budget decision, and build literacy on attributed versus incremental performance.
  • Build reusable experiment tooling and templates, work with Analytics Engineering and MarTech on the data experiments needed, and document every test and decision as you build this capability from scratch.

What You'll Bring

  • 3+ years of experience in marketing measurement (attribution, incrementality or marketing mix modelling), with a track record of analysis that changed real budget decisions.
  • Solid grounding in causal inference and experimental design: randomised and quasi-experimental methods such as synthetic control and difference-in-differences, simulation-based power analysis to size and design tests, and knowing when each approach breaks.
  • Strong statistical judgement: you can quantify uncertainty, explain it simply, and resist overclaiming.
  • Hands-on experience with marketing attribution models and their limits, including reconciling platform-reported results with first-party data.
  • Familiarity with how experiments calibrate MMM and attribution, and with marginal-return and budget-optimisation thinking (saturation, diminishing returns).
  • Expert SQL and Python, production-quality code, a modern warehouse (BigQuery or Snowflake) and a BI tool such as Lightdash or Looker.
  • Strong data modelling skills: designing clean, tested and documented models (dbt or similar) for marketing spend, attribution and customer data, and working closely with Analytics Engineering.
  • Strong core analytics skills: marketing and customer metrics (CAC, LTV, retention, funnel and cohort analysis), dashboards and self-serve BI, and the judgement to prioritise ad-hoc requests alongside the test roadmap.
  • Proven ability to influence senior stakeholders: you hold a position under challenge, have shaped a roadmap, and say no with a clear rationale.
  • Comfortable with ambiguity and with data that is still improving: you're a proactive self-starter who is happy to create a new process or capability in a small, fast-growing team.

  • Utilise tools such as Kling, Seedance, Happy Horse and other AI video models/platforms to produce high-quality visual sequences

  • Develop and maintain consistent character appearance, style, and scene continuity across longer narratives using advanced techniques

  • Integrate motion graphic design and colour correction to deliver cohesive final outputs

  • Experiment rapidly with new AI models, tools, and techniques, incorporating them into production workflows and sharing skills with the rest of the team

  • Align with your Content Lead’s creative direction while maintaining a high degree of autonomy in execution and technical decision-making

  • Continuously refine workflows for efficiency, scalability, and output quality

Your Qualifications

Hard Skills

  • 4–6+ years of experience in video production, VFX, or digital art, with a strong portfolio (AI-driven video work is a must)

  • Hands-on experience with the latest AI video tools and models (e.g., Kling, Seedance, Happy Horse, and similar emerging options)

  • Solid understanding of AI image/video generation pipelines, including prompting, batching, consistency techniques, and post-processing

  • Experience with traditional tools like Premiere Pro, After Effects or similar for final assembly and polish

  • Strong grasp of visual storytelling, pacing, composition, and cinematic language

  • Ability to maintain character and scene consistency across sequences in AI-generated content

Soft Skills

🗣 Strong communication & collaboration skills (fluent in English)

🎯 High ownership — able to take ideas from concept to completion independently

⚡️ Experimental mindset — comfortable navigating ambiguity and evolving tools

⏱️ Fast iteration cycles — able to test, fail, refine, and improve quickly

🧠 Curious and self-driven — constantly exploring new AI capabilities and workflows

🧢 Open to feedback and continuous improvement

🍭 #NSFW — Comfortable working with uncensored models and explicit adult content

Bonus Points

  • Experience in AI-native storytelling or filmmaking

  • Background in 3D, VFX, technical art or as a colourist

  • Familiarity with training/customizing models (LoRAs, embeddings, fine-tuning)

  • Prior experience in adult, dating, or adjacent creative industries a huge bonus

  • Experience with ComfyUI

  • Experience with Stable Diffusion / AUTOMATIC1111 and related tooling (Advanced prompting, working with trained LoRAs, refining, upscaling, inpainting etc.)

Why EverAI?

📈 Exponential Growth: From 50M users in 2 years, to 100M next — and 500M beyond

🚀 Track Record of Category-Creating Innovation: We consistently launch world-first AI applications — setting the pace, not following it

🌍 Global Impact: Top-tier user growth, real-world adoption, and cultural relevance

🧠 Proven Leadership: A senior team that’s launched, scaled, and exited & IPO’d multiple scale ups — now fully focused on reshaping AI companionship

👥 Elite Remote Team: 100% remote and built to win — world-class talent from Tier 1 tech companies, with a culture of ownership, velocity, and radical creativity

🛡️ Ethical Core: Our AI ecosystem is governed by EverGuard, our proprietary AI moderation technology, ensuring responsible development at scale

What We Offer

✍️ Contract Type: We prefer B2B, but we’re flexible, what matters is long-term commitment and impact
📍 Work From Anywhere: Fully remote. Choose the environment where you do your best work
🏝️ Paid Time Off: 4 weeks (20 working days) of PTO per year to recharge and reset
👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 Annual Gathering: A yearly in-person meetup to connect, brainstorm, and celebrate wins together

jobs.description:
Who We Are

Launchpad Technologies Inc. is a global technology partner connecting top talent with high-impact projects across North America and beyond. We specialize in Staff Augmentation and product development, helping companies scale with agility while empowering professionals to grow in meaningful, remote-first environments.

About the Role

Launchpad Technologies is looking for an experienced Senior Functional Consultant to join our Professional Services team and support the implementation of financial software solutions for international customers.

This role is ideal for someone who combines a strong understanding of Finance, Accounting, and Accounts Payable processes with hands-on experience implementing and configuring financial software.

You will work directly with customers to understand their business processes and requirements, translate those needs into effective system configurations, guide them through implementation, testing and adoption, and help ensure successful Go-Lives.

We are not looking for expertise in one specific ERP or platform. Experience with SAP, Oracle, NetSuite, Microsoft Dynamics, JD Edwards, or other financial systems can all be relevant. What matters most is your ability to understand financial processes and translate them into practical software solutions.

🗓 Start date: Early 2027
📆 Contract type: Contractor, Full-Time, 100% Remote
🌐 Work hours: Monday to Friday, 7.00 am to 4.00 pm PST

What You’ll Be Doing

  • Lead functional activities throughout financial software implementations, from discovery and requirements gathering through configuration, testing, training, and Go-Live.
  • Work directly with customers to understand their Finance and Accounting processes, challenges, and business requirements.
  • Configure financial software based on customer requirements and agreed solution designs.
  • Apply Finance, Accounting, and Accounts Payable knowledge to recommend practical solutions and best practices.
  • Facilitate discovery sessions and translate business requirements into functional system configurations.
  • Support testing and UAT, troubleshoot functional issues, and help customers resolve process or configuration gaps.
  • Deliver customer training and support adoption of the implemented solution.
  • Collaborate closely with Project Managers, Technical Consultants, developers, and other implementation stakeholders.
  • Communicate risks, dependencies, issues, and customer needs clearly throughout the implementation.
  • Manage functional responsibilities across different customer engagements while maintaining quality and ownership.

What You Need to Succeed

Must-haves

  • 5+ years of relevant experience implementing or consulting on financial software, ERP financial modules, or comparable business applications.
  • Strong practical knowledge of Finance, Accounting, and Accounts Payable processes.
  • Hands-on experience configuring financial software as part of customer implementations.
  • Experience across multiple stages of the implementation lifecycle, such as discovery, requirements gathering, solution design, configuration, testing/UAT, training, Go-Live, and post-production support.
  • Strong customer-facing consulting skills and the ability to communicate confidently with Finance stakeholders.
  • Ability to understand business requirements, identify process gaps, and recommend appropriate functional solutions.
  • Strong ownership, organization, collaboration, and problem-solving skills.

  • Experience with Accounts Payable automation or related financial process optimization.

  • Degree in Accounting, Finance, Business, Engineering, IT, or a related field.

Importantly, a specific ERP, certification, or academic degree is not required when equivalent financial process knowledge and hands-on implementation expertise can be demonstrated.

Our Recruitment Process

  1. Initial Interview – Talent Acquisition (60 minutes): A conversation with our Talent Acquisition Specialist to learn more about your professional background, functional and project management experience, and career goals. We’ll also explore your experience with financial processes and customer-facing implementations, assess English communication skills, and walk you through the role, project, working conditions, and next steps.

jobs.title: Accounting Manager - Mexico remote
jobs.description:
About Proper

Proper is an AI-first accounting service built for property managers and real estate operators. We combine automation, our own technology and a global team of accounting experts to run financial operations that are faster and more accurate than what the industry has settled for.

We are 480 people across the US, Colombia and Mexico, serving 175 property management and real estate clients. We are a San Francisco based company and most of our accounting organisation is in Latin America.

The role

You will run a pod: roughly 20 client accounts, 4 to 6 direct reports, and the 20 or so people who sit under them. Your direct reports are Senior Accountants and Principal Accountants, and each of them leads a small team and owns a set of clients.

You are accountable for three things. Whether those clients stay. Whether the work reaching them is right. Whether the pod makes money.

What makes this job different from most accounting management roles is where you sit. You are not the client's day-to-day contact, and you are not the last person to review every deliverable. Your Senior Accountants do that work and report to you on it. Your job is to know independently whether their picture is accurate, and to coach what you find. That means opening the books yourself, listening to recorded client calls, and forming your own view of an account rather than accepting a status update. If that sounds like less control than you are used to, it is actually more responsibility, and it is the part of the role we care most about.

Key Responsibilities

  • Knowing the truth about every account. Run health-check style reviews on client books, looking for discrepancies and for what they say about how the accounting has actually been done. Review our client health dashboard and act on what it surfaces. Spot check financials and client communications. Track error rates. Stay close to escalations and confirm they get resolved.
  • Coaching your team. This is the biggest part of the week. You will coach Senior and Principal Accountants on two things at once: running their own teams, and running their clients well. That includes reviewing recorded client calls and giving feedback specific enough to change what happens on the next one.
  • Client relationships and value. You check in on accounts on a regular cadence, and you take escalations that need someone more senior. You make sure we are delivering everything the client contracted for, and that our work is not quietly being absorbed back by the client's own team.
  • Quality and process. Individual errors get fixed by the team. Your job is to notice when a pattern of errors means something upstream has to change, and then change it. You will drive documentation and standardisation of client processes, and you will be the front line for rolling out new processes and automation with our Operations, Product and Engineering teams, including making sure the feedback from your team actually reaches them.
  • The economics. You work with Finance and Workforce Management on capacity, cost to serve and gross margin per client, and you connect those numbers back to how your own pod is staffed and run.

Qualifications & Required Skills

  • At least two years managing senior individual contributors or managers, meaning people who had their own reports or owned their own client relationships. Managing a team of processors is not the same job.
  • You have personally owned external client relationships. Clients you can name, where you were the person they emailed.
  • Working knowledge of US GAAP including financial statement presentation. Enough to read a balance sheet, find something that does not tie, and challenge a senior accountant on it.
  • Advanced English. You will be on calls with US property owners.
  • Based in Mexico, with enough working-hours overlap to join US business-hours calls.
  • One process improvement you ran end to end, where you can tell us the number before and the number after.
  • A degree in accounting or demonstrated equivalent knowledge.

Compensation

Additional Information

You’ll work closely with Data Science, Analytics, and Data Engineering to serve Sales, Customer Success, Support, Enablement, and GTM leadership. This is a hands-on Director role. Expect to spend about 70% of your time building (prototyping agents, writing code, designing evals) and about 30% leading the team, setting strategy, and influencing stakeholders.

You’ll build intelligent workflow experiences. That ranges from AI agents and copilots that take manual work off sellers’ plates, to signals for propensity and prioritization, to the data, evaluation, and measurement foundations that make these products reliable and trusted.

The ideal candidate is AI-native. You already run your own work through agents every day, you’ve shipped AI products to production, and you get as excited about a seller’s first “wow, this saved me an hour” moment as you do about a clean architecture.

This is a remote position open to candidates residing in the US.

In this role, you will:

  • Build hands-on. Prototype, ship, and iterate on AI agents, copilots, and workflow automations for GTM teams, from the first demo to a production system people rely on.
  • Build the platform, not just the apps. Own the architecture of the shared GTM AI platform: orchestration, LLM and tool gateways, identity and access, and the MCP and SDK contracts that let the GTM web app, Salesforce, Slack, desktop, and Claude plugins share one set of governed capabilities.
  • Make evals a first-class discipline. Design evaluation frameworks for agent and LLM behavior, including golden datasets, LLM-as-judge, human review loops, and regression suites, and run them in development and production. Use transcript analysis and eval results to find failures, guide what to fix first, and show quality improving over time.
  • Lead with AI day to day. Use agents, coding assistants, and agent harnesses in your own daily work, and build the shared tooling, patterns, and harnesses that make the whole team faster.
  • Stay ahead of the curve. Track new models, agent frameworks, MCP and tool ecosystems, and context engineering, and turn them into practical recommendations for Samsara's GTM use cases: what to adopt, what to test, and what to ignore. Make clear build-versus-buy calls on vendor tools, not just models.
  • Drive adoption with the field. Be the go-to advocate for AI across Sales, CS, and Support. Run demos, earn credibility with reps and frontline managers, collect real feedback, and turn skeptics into power users.
  • Set the strategy. Own the technical and product strategy for GTM AI, including the data foundations, instrumentation, governance, and observability these products depend on. Decide which prototypes move onto the shared platform, which merge, and which retire. Own model routing across vendors and the per-user spend controls that keep AI cost in line with value. Influence senior leaders on AI priorities, investment, and the operating model.
  • Ship revenue-critical intelligence. Own the forecasting, propensity, and CRM data-quality work that sales leadership acts on, and keep it calibrated, validated, and clear about its limits. Be comfortable across data and analytics engineering, and act as a business leader when the work calls for it.
  • Partner across GTM, Product, and Engineering. Work with Sales, Customer Success, Support, Enablement, Operations, Product, and Engineering leaders to find high-value opportunities, define success metrics, and turn them into durable products.
  • Build for trust. Put a pragmatic responsible-AI approach in place: safety, privacy, reliability, and human-in-the-loop workflows with clear approval and escalation paths. Agents that act on CRM and customer data run with per-user, least-privilege permissions, and changes to systems of record get human approval first.
  • Champion, role model, and embed Samsara’s cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale globally and across new offices
  • Hire, develop and lead an inclusive, engaged, and high performing AI Engineering team

Minimum requirements for the role:

  • 10+ years across software engineering, machine learning, data science, or data platforms, including meaningful leadership experience. You still write code regularly.
  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent relevant work experience.
  • Hands-on experience building and shipping LLM applications and agentic workflows to production, including tool use, retrieval, context engineering, and production reliability.
  • Production full-stack and cloud engineering experience (for example Python or TypeScript, AWS, and Databricks), including owning systems that other teams depend on.
  • Demonstrated experience designing and running evaluation frameworks for LLM or agent systems, and using them to drive quality decisions.
  • Daily, fluent use of AI agents and coding assistants in your own work, and a point of view on how they change the way teams build.
  • A track record of shipping internal or customer-facing AI/ML products with measurable business impact.
  • Experience with predictive modeling, experimentation, analytics, and data engineering foundations.
  • Strong product judgment and the ability to turn ambiguous business problems into simple, valuable solutions.
  • Excellent communication with both executives and frontline users. You can demo to a sales floor and present to a VP on the same day.
  • A people-first leadership style with a track record of hiring, developing, and keeping strong technical talent.

An ideal candidate also has:

  • Experience building AI or decisioning products for Sales, Customer Success, Support, Marketing, or other GTM functions, ideally in a fast-growing enterprise SaaS environment.
  • Experience with CRM, customer data, support, and knowledge-management systems (such as Salesforce, Gong, Gainsight, Zendesk, and Databricks), and connecting agents to them (for example, through MCP servers or similar integrations).
  • Experience with agent SDKs and harnesses (such as Claude Code / Agent SDK, OpenAI Agents SDK, LangGraph, or similar) and LLM observability tooling, eval tooling such as Braintrust or MLflow, and model APIs from Anthropic, OpenAI, and Google.
  • Experience operating AI products at scale, including cost management, monitoring, and governance.
  • A visible habit of learning in public, such as writing, talks, open-source work, or internal “what’s new in AI” sessions.

  • Customer Journey Optimization: Pinpoint friction points in the customer experience, create proactive interventions, and turn interactions into automated, personalized journeys.

This is a remote position open to candidates residing in the US except the San Francisco Bay Metro Area, NYC Metro Area, and Washington, D.C. Metro Area.

You should apply if:

  • You want to impact the industries that run our world: Every phone call you answer and every email you send can affect whether truck drivers deliver goods on time and without accidents, whether students get dropped off safely from school, or whether power gets restored quickly after a natural disaster.
  • You thrive the most when solving problems: Our constantly expanding technology and the complexities faced by our customers provide an exciting range of challenges for our Customer Success teams. With a growth mindset and a desire to learn, you will strategically partner with our customers to find unique solutions to help keep their operations safe, efficient, and sustainable.
  • You are a natural relationship builder: Whether the relationship is with our customers or with cross-functional teams in Samsara, you are in constant communication and collaboration with key stakeholders to win as a team.
  • You are the architect of your own career: If you put in the work, this role won’t be your last at Samsara. This Customer Success team is still shaping its future and you will have plenty of autonomy and opportunities to master your craft in a hyper growth environment.
  • You want to be with the best: At Samsara, we win together, celebrate together and support each other. You will be surrounded by the best and brightest professionals out there.

In this role, you will:

About the role:

Samsara's Customer Success team is on the front lines of business value delivery by helping customers adopt our platform, realize measurable business value, and renew and expand with confidence. Billing errors, concession requests, and cancellation or return exceptions currently land with CSMs, CS managers, and several partner teams, each holding part of the picture. As our customer base and billing complexity have grown, these cases take too long, repeat for the same reasons, and pull CSMs away from adoption and renewal work. As the Contract and Billing Resolution Specialist, you will be the single owner of complex billing and contract cases for Mid-Market and Commercial accounts.

You will take a customer's report that something is wrong with their bill, work out what happened across systems and teams, choose the right path to fix it, and see it through, keeping the customer informed. It is part detective, part project manager, part customer advocate. You will also tell the teams who own the underlying systems and processes what keeps breaking.

Your role will be cross-functional, working alongside and connecting Customer Success Managers, Sales, Billing Support, Order-to-Cash, Sales Ops, Deal Desk, Finance, and Legal. This is a new role, and you will help shape the case record, the root-cause tags, and the monthly read-out that define how Customer Success resolves billing and contract cases at Samsara.

This is a remote position open to candidates residing in the US except the San Francisco Bay Metro Area, NYC Metro Area, and Washington, D.C. Metro Area. Relocation assistance will not be provided for this role.

You should apply if:

  • You want to impact the industries that run our world: Every phone call you answer and every email you send can affect whether truck drivers deliver goods on time and without accidents, whether students get dropped off safely from school, or whether power gets restored quickly after a natural disaster.
  • You thrive the most when solving problems: Our constantly expanding technology and the complexities faced by our customers provide an exciting range of challenges for our Customer Success teams. With a growth mindset and a desire to learn, you will strategically partner with our customers to find unique solutions to help keep their operations safe, efficient, and sustainable.
  • You are a natural relationship builder: Whether the relationship is with our customers or with cross-functional teams in Samsara, you are in constant communication and collaboration with key stakeholders to win as a team.
  • You are the architect of your own career: If you put in the work, this role won’t be your last at Samsara. This Customer Success team is still shaping its future and you will have plenty of autonomy and opportunities to master your craft in a hyper growth environment.
  • You want to be with the best: At Samsara, we win together, celebrate together and support each other. You will be surrounded by the best and brightest professionals out there.

In this role, you will:

  • Own complex billing and contract cases for Mid-Market and Commercial accounts, from the first report to a confirmed fix, and keep the customer informed in plain terms, including accounts that are delinquent or facing suspension.
  • Reconstruct the full story behind a billing error across contracts, order forms, segment or ownership changes, reprocessing, and invoicing, including cases with several AE handoffs and no clean record of what was promised.
  • Separate a correction of a Samsara error from a concession, a return, a reprocess, and a contract amendment, and choose the path that fixes the customer's billing, not only the immediate complaint.
  • Drive Billing Support, Order-to-Cash, Sales Ops, Deal Desk, Finance, and Legal to execute the fix.
  • Evaluate and prepare concession requests: confirm whether Samsara was at fault, size the request against policy and the approval matrix, write a short case summary (what happened, root cause, options considered and ruled out, recommendation, and risk), route it to the right approver, and confirm the credit is applied and the customer told.
  • Support cancellation, return, and ETF exceptions: validate eligibility (purchase and renewal dates, trial history, Return ACV, financing partner, documentation), prepare the case for the approving team, act as the Customer Success fallback when the first approver does not respond within the window, and make sure approved outcomes are processed.
  • Be the front door for billing, concession, and cancellation requests: log every request in a single case record, including those that arrive via Slack, email, or Gainsight; redirect them to the right path; and coach CSMs and AEs on what a complete request looks like.
  • Fix repeat causes: tag the root cause on every case, separate one-offs from systemic failures, and deliver a monthly read-out to the teams that own the systems and processes involved.
  • Carry forward the billing improvement work with Support, Finance, and Product, including earlier detection of billing problems that threaten renewals.
  • Champion, role model, and embed Samsara's operating principles, including Keep a High Bar, Be Intellectually Honest, and Solve Problems Together, as we scale.

Minimum requirements for the role:

  • 4+ years of experience in billing operations, order to cash, revenue operations, deal desk, contracts, or a similar finance and operations role.
  • This is a demanding position with high internal visibility that requires strong priority management and high emotional intelligence.
  • Strong investigative skills: you can rebuild a timeline from incomplete or conflicting information across CRM, billing, and contract systems, including when the people involved have left.
  • Sound financial judgment about credits, concessions, reprocessing, and refunds, and a clear way of explaining your recommendation.
  • Customer-facing communication that stays honest and composed in hard conversations, and written summaries a leader can read once and decide on.
  • A record of driving results across teams without authority over them, including working to deadlines in an approval process.
  • Familiarity with order forms, amendments, and terms, and how they flow into billing.
  • Comfort with ambiguity and incomplete precedent, and rigorous case management so nothing drops across weeks and stakeholders.
  • Diplomacy, tact, and poise under pressure when working through customer issues.

An ideal candidate also has:

  • Experience handling escalated or high-dollar billing disputes.
  • Experience with Salesforce, NetSuite, or an equivalent ERP, and CPQ tools. We also use Zendesk, Gainsight, and Sweethawk.
  • Customer Success, Support, or account management background with customer-facing financial or contract work.
  • Experience building or improving billing dispute processes.
  • Exposure to subscription or hardware-plus-subscription billing.
  • AI First: Experience using AI tooling to drive efficiency and outcomes.
  • Strong bias for action and insistence on high standards

You’ll partner closely with IT and business process owners to design and implement controls, spot gaps early, and drive remediation to the finish line. We’re looking for someone who takes real ownership. You bring deep, hands-on SOX expertise, a track record of delivering projects reliably, and the confidence to run with complex work independently. If you take pride in being the person others count on to get it done right, we’d love to meet you.

This is a remote position open to candidates based in Canada.

You should apply if:

  • You want to impact the industries that run our world: Your efforts will result in real-world impact – helping to keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, reduce emissions, and most importantly, ensure workers return home safely.

We set up our employees for success and have built a culture that encourages rapid career development, countless opportunities to experiment and master your craft in a hyper growth environment.
  • You’re energized by our opportunity: The vision we have to digitize large sectors of the global economy requires your full focus and best efforts to bring forth creative, ambitious ideas for our customers.

  • Develop and deliver training to SOX control owners, including process documentation, testing methodology, management review controls, and controls over Information Produced by the Entity (IPE).
  • Conduct walkthroughs across all business process areas and work with business process owners to ensure timely review and updates to the control documentation
  • Collaborate cross functionally to design leading edge practices with a financial compliance mindset across several complex business process areas.

About the role

Samsara is building its Federal business, and we're looking for the Sales leader who will build out the team and strategy. As the AVP of Federal Sales, you will be the first and most senior specialized Federal hire, accountable for taking the Samsara Connected Operations Cloud into U.S. federal civilian agencies as part of Phase 1 and defense agencies as part of Phase 2 on a dedicated, FedRAMP-authorized government cloud environment.

Federal agencies run some of the largest vehicle and asset fleets in the world, and they are modernizing how they manage safety, maintenance, sustainability, and mission readiness. Samsara already partners with state and local government agencies across the country, including statewide programs. This role turns that foundation into a durable federal practice.

You will operate as the leader of a dedicated federal practice: you'll design the team, hire it, set the go-to-market strategy, shape our partner and contract-vehicle approach, and own federal bookings. You'll work hand in hand with Product, Security and Compliance, Legal, Marketing, Partnerships, and Revenue Operations to make Samsara easy for federal agencies to buy and trust. This role reports to the Vice President of Public Sector Sales.

This is a remote position open to candidates based on the East Coast (Maine, New Hampshire, Massachusetts, Rhode Island, Connecticut, New York, New Jersey, Delaware, Maryland, Pennsylvania, Virginia, North Carolina, South Carolina, Georgia, and Florida), with a preference for candidates based in the Washington D.C. metropolitan area. This position requires travel up to 40% of the time.

In this role, you will:

  • Build and own Samsara's federal go-to-market strategy for civilian agencies, including agency prioritization, territory design, and a multi-year plan that sequences investment against certification milestones and the federal budget cycle - with a plan to expand to defense agencies in the future
  • Build Samsara's federal route-to-market with Partnerships: distributors and resellers, contract vehicles such as GSA MAS and GWACs, and co-sell relationships with federal systems integrators
  • Hire, develop, and lead a dedicated federal team of account executives, future business development and capture managers, and solutions engineers, starting with a focused pod and scaling headcount as pipeline and bookings prove out
  • Own federal pipeline and bookings, with clear leading indicators (agency relationships, qualified opportunities, RFI and proposal activity) in the early stage and full bookings accountability once the authorized product is available to transact
  • Develop senior relationships with agency fleet, logistics, operations, and CIO/CISO leaders, and represent Samsara at industry days, federal events, and with government affairs partners
  • Partner with Security and Compliance and Product to translate FedRAMP authorization progress into a clear, accurate customer narrative and to bring agency requirements back into the GovCloud roadmap
  • Work with Revenue Operations, Finance, and Sales Compensation to design federal-specific pipeline stages, forecasting, quotas, and compensation plans for long-cycle selling
  • Partner with Legal, Deal Desk, and Contracts on FAR-compliant terms, teaming agreements, and federal ethics requirements, setting a high bar for compliance across the team
  • Champion, role model, and embed Samsara’s cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale globally and across new offices

Minimum requirements for the role:

  • 12+ years of enterprise technology sales experience, with 8+ years selling to U.S. federal government agencies
  • 5+ years leading federal sales teams, including leaders of account executives, as a second-line manager or above
  • Track record of building or scaling a federal sales practice at a commercial-first SaaS, cloud, or IoT company, including selling through and after FedRAMP authorization
  • Consistent over-achievement of federal bookings targets, with closed multi-year, seven-figure agency contracts
  • Hands-on experience with federal acquisition: GSA Schedule and other contract vehicles, distributor and reseller models, and teaming with federal systems integrators
  • Established relationships with federal civilian agency stakeholders, systems integrators, and the federal partner ecosystem
  • Experience leading business development and capture for competitive federal procurements, from pre-RFP shaping through proposal and award
  • Eligibility to obtain a Public Trust position

An ideal candidate also has:

  • A network that includes experienced federal sellers, capture managers, and solutions engineers who would follow them to a new practice
  • Experience co-selling with federal systems integrators inside a direct sales organization, including clear account ownership and compensation rules
  • Familiarity with Shipley or a comparable capture and proposal methodology
  • Experience designing activity-based or MBO compensation for federal teams before authorized product is available
  • Working knowledge of FedRAMP, FAR/DFARS, Section 508 accessibility, and Buy American and Trade Agreements Act requirements, and how they show up in deals
  • Experience with Department of Defense or National Guard fleet programs, as a foundation for future expansion

jobs.title: Marketing Operations Manager - US Remote
jobs.description:
What is PerfectServe?

PerfectServe is a leading provider of clinical communication and physician scheduling solutions in the health IT space. The company was founded in 1997 and has grown steadily since then, with a notable jump after several major acquisitions were announced in 2019. PerfectServe now has 400+ employees, 30,000+ customers — spanning medical practices, hospitals, and health systems — and $100 million+ in annual revenue.

PerfectServe’s mission is to accelerate speed to care by optimizing provider schedules and routing communications — including messages, pages, calls, and alerts — to the right place at the right time in any care setting. By facilitating real-time information sharing, building better schedules, and automating important clinical workflows, we believe we can help our customers advance patient care and improve the well-being of their clinicians.

Leading analyst firms like Gartner® and KLAS Research have consistently validated our approach:

  1. In 2026, PerfectServe was named highest in execution and furthest in vision in the Gartner Magic Quadrant™ for Clinical Communication and Collaboration — the clear segment leader.
  2. PerfectServe also received two Best in KLAS awards in 2026 — one for physician scheduling and another for ambulatory clinical communications. That makes for 11 Best in KLAS awards over the past 9 years.

At PerfectServe, you'll have a unique opportunity to join a collaborative team with decades of experience that finds new ways to delight our customers every day. This involves consistent efforts to stay on the cutting edge of product development, which includes everything from implementing AI in new and existing solutions to brainstorming with customers about novel workflows. But you don't have to be in product to make in impact — everybody at PerfectServe contributes to important work that moves the business forward.

If you're looking for a well-established, tech-forward company full of smart people doing meaningful work, you've found the right place!

The Manager of Marketing Operations is responsible for the operational foundation enabling Marketing to execute, measure, and scale effectively. Reporting to the Revenue Operations leader, this role serves as a key operational partner to Marketing leadership, translating go-to-market strategy into the processes, systems, data, and insights that connect marketing activity to pipeline and revenue.

This role owns the day-to-day mechanics of marketing operations, including lead lifecycle management and routing, marketing automation, campaign operations, attribution execution, funnel analytics, marketing data quality, and the marketing technology stack. This role will work closely with Marketing and Sales Operations to create clear visibility across the buyer journey and ensure leads and accounts move between Marketing and Sales with speed, consistency, and the right context.

This is a hands-on role for someone who can move comfortably between systems, data, process, and business partnership. The right person will understand that great Marketing Operations is not simply about administering marketing technology or reporting campaign results. It is about building the operating infrastructure that allows Marketing to understand what is working, invest intelligently, and create measurable impact on pipeline and revenue.

Key responsibilities

Funnel and lead lifecycle operations

  • Own the operational execution of the lead and account lifecycle from initial engagement through handoff to Sales.
  • Design lifecycle stages, qualification criteria, scoring models, and routing logic in partnership with Revenue Operations, Marketing, and Sales, then implement and maintain them
  • Manage lead and account routing to ensure high-quality opportunities reach the appropriate BDR or seller quickly and accurately.
  • Monitor MQL-to-Sales acceptance, meeting conversion, opportunity creation, and other key funnel transitions to identify leakage and areas for improvement.
  • Maintain and monitor SLAs between Marketing, BDRs, and Sales, surfacing breakdowns and partnering with leaders to resolve them.
  • Ensure funnel definitions and system logic remain consistent across Marketing and Sales platforms.
  • Assess the cross-functional impact of marketing operations initiatives, ensuring alignment across systems, processes, and teams.

Marketing automation and campaign operations

  • Own the operational infrastructure required to execute scalable, measurable marketing campaigns.
  • Manage marketing automation workflows, segmentation, campaign structure, audience logic, and operational QA.
  • Partner with Marketing teams to ensure campaigns are properly configured, tracked, and measurable.
  • Establish campaign governance and naming conventions that create consistent and reliable reporting.
  • Identify opportunities to automate repetitive processes and improve campaign execution speed and accuracy.

Marketing analytics and funnel performance

  • Collaborate with data analysts to create dashboards and reporting that provide visibility into funnel performance, campaign contribution, pipeline generation, conversion, velocity, and marketing effectiveness.
  • Analyze performance across channels, campaigns, segments, products, personas, and stages of the buyer journey.
  • Identify funnel leakage, conversion trends, engagement patterns, and opportunities to improve Marketing's contribution to pipeline and revenue.
  • Move beyond reporting activity and volume to helping Marketing leadership understand what is driving business outcomes and where performance is changing.
  • Partner with Sales Operations to provide a connected view of the funnel from initial engagement through opportunity creation and revenue.

Attribution and measurement

  • Design and own the attribution framework: select models, define sourced vs. influenced logic, and recommend changes as the funnel and buying journey evolve
  • Ensure campaigns, contacts, accounts, and opportunities are structured appropriately to support reliable attribution and influence reporting.
  • Maintain data and process integrity across the systems used to measure marketing contribution.
  • Provide Marketing leadership with visibility into sourced and influenced pipeline, conversion, and campaign performance.
  • Help distinguish between activity metrics and the measures that indicate meaningful progression toward pipeline and revenue.

Marketing technology and data

  • Manage the day-to-day effectiveness and administration of marketing-specific technology within the broader GTM technology ecosystem.
  • Partner with Revenue Operations on technology evaluation, implementation, integration, consolidation, and governance.
  • Maintain integrations and data flows between marketing automation platforms, Salesforce, intent and account intelligence platforms, and other marketing systems.
  • Own the strategy for data quality, enrichment, duplication, consent, and other issues affecting the usability and reliability of marketing data.
  • Identify opportunities to use automation and AI to improve segmentation, routing, data enrichment, campaign execution, and insight generation.
  • Continually evaluate whether technology is creating meaningful leverage or unnecessary complexity.

Account-based and intent operations

  • Operationalize account segmentation, targeting, intent signals, and account-based programs in partnership with Marketing and Sales.
  • Ensure intent and engagement signals are surfaced to the appropriate Sales and BDR teams in a usable and actionable way.
  • Support workflows that connect target-account activity across Marketing and Sales.
  • Measure engagement and progression within priority accounts and help identify signals that warrant Sales action.
  • Partner with Sales Operations to ensure account ownership, routing, and marketing activity are aligned.

Planning and marketing performance

  • Support annual and quarterly Marketing planning with funnel analysis, historical conversion data, pipeline requirements, and scenario modeling.
  • Partner with Revenue Operations and Marketing leadership to translate revenue goals into measurable funnel requirements.
  • Track performance against Marketing pipeline and funnel objectives throughout the year.
  • Support Marketing leadership in understanding where investment is producing results and where assumptions may need to change.

Cross-functional partnership

  • Serve as a trusted operational partner to Marketing leadership and the broader Marketing organization.
  • Partner closely with Sales Operations to ensure clean handoffs, shared definitions, reliable data, and visibility across the entire Marketing-to-Sales funnel.
  • Work with Field Enablement to ensure sellers and BDRs understand how to interpret and act on marketing-generated signals, intent, campaigns, and programs.
  • Surface operational issues quickly and coordinate resolution across Marketing, Sales, BDR, Revenue Operations, Finance, Field Enablement, and other teams as needed.
  • Create repeatable processes that allow marketers to spend more time building effective programs and less time navigating systems, reconciling data, or troubleshooting operational issues.

Qualifications

  • 5+ years of experience in Marketing Operations, Revenue Operations, Demand Operations, or a related B2B SaaS operations role.
  • Experience supporting complex B2B marketing and sales organizations with enterprise and/or multi-product go-to-market motions.
  • Strong experience with marketing automation platforms such as Marketing Cloud Account Engagement/Pardot, Salesforce CRM, including lifecycle management, lead and account routing, campaign architecture, and data integration.
  • Demonstrated experience with funnel analytics, lead scoring, attribution, campaign measurement, and marketing performance reporting.
  • Experience with intent data, account-based marketing (ABM) platforms such as 6sense and Vector, enrichment tools such as Clay and ZoomInfo, and other GTM technologies.
  • Strong analytical capabilities, including experience with BI/reporting tools and the ability to translate complex data into actionable insights.
  • Strong understanding of B2B SaaS funnel metrics, including MQL conversion, Sales acceptance, opportunity creation, pipeline contribution, velocity, and attribution.
  • Ability to work across Marketing and Sales and translate the needs of both functions into scalable processes.
  • Strong business judgment, attention to detail, and ability to balance recurring operational responsibilities with larger improvement initiatives.
  • Bias toward simplification, automation, scalability, and high-quality data.

Why Join PerfectServe?

At PerfectServe, we are transforming healthcare communication and collaboration to help clinicians deliver better care. You’ll work with a dedicated and mission-driven team in an environment that values growth, transparency, and innovation.

We offer a salary range of $100,000-120,000 USD per year, with compensation tailored to your background, strengths, and potential to grow within the team.The salary range listed for this role reflects our commitment to pay transparency and is based on market data, internal equity, and the scope of responsibilities. compensation will be determined by a combination of factors, including the candidate’s experience, skills, and the specific team or product area they support. We regularly review compensation across the company to ensure fairness and consistency. If you are a current employee and have questions about how your compensation aligns with our ranges, we encourage you to speak with your manager or People Operations.

Benefits:

  • Remote first work environment
  • Health, Dental, Vision, Life and Disability Insurance options available day one.
  • 401K - with match and immediately vested.
  • 17 company holidays, 2 floating holidays plus competitive paid time off policy
  • Internal Advancement Opportunities

PerfectServe offers unified healthcare communication solutions to help physicians, nurses, and care team members provide exceptional patient care. PerfectServe’s cloud-based solutions enhance patient safety and reduce provider burnout by automating workflows, speeding time to treatment, optimizing shift schedules, empowering nurse mobility, and engaging patients in their own care.
