jobs.title: Staff P&T Incident & Technology Risk Operations Manager
jobs.description:
Hi there! Thanks for stopping by 👋

Are you actively looking for a new opportunity? Or just checking the market? Well… you might just be in the right place!

We're looking for a Staff P&T Incident & Technology Risk Operations Manager to join our Product & Technology Operations team.

In this role, you will architect and drive the operating mechanisms that help Product & Technology respond effectively to incidents, reduce enterprise risk, and help provide leaders clear visibility into where attention and action are needed. You will facilitate bringing together fragmented processes and practices, help establish common standards, assist in improving communications and follow-through, and help ensure the right data reaches engineering teams, executives, and security leaders.

You’ll work at the intersection of Product &Technology Operations, Engineering, and Security. You will also help connect broader enterprise risk areas, including responsible AI, application and infrastructure security, identity and access, data protection, digital supply-chain risk, shadow IT/AI, security compliance, and operational resilience - into a coherent leadership view without becoming the functional ownership of each domain.

This is a high-impact individual contributor position focused on operational excellence rather than line management. We are looking for a senior hands-on specialist who thrives at the center of complex engineering and security challenges, partnering across technical teams to establish clear standards, streamline incident and vulnerability workflows, and help teams resolve critical operational risks efficiently without adding unnecessary processes.

What you’ll be doing:

Unify and Evolve Incident Management Mechanisms:

  • Maintain a consistent P&T-wide incident management framework, defining clear roles, severity levels, escalation paths, and communication standards.

  • Facilitate post-incident reviews (RCAs/post-mortems) and ensure action items are tracked to completion for systemic engineering improvements.

Drive Security Incident and Vulnerability Operating Processes:

  • Optimize intake, prioritization, escalation, and remediation workflows for security incidents and vulnerabilities alongside Engineering and Security.

  • Build tracking views that highlight material vulnerabilities, aging trends, and exceptions requiring leadership attention.

Build an Integrated View of Technology Risk:

  • Synthesize insights across AppSec, AI governance, IAM, supply chain, data protection, and compliance into a unified, actionable view of operational risk.

  • Identify recurring patterns across incident and vulnerability data to drive systemic fixes without duplicating team accountability.

Lead Reporting, Communications, and Executive Readiness:

  • Track core KPIs and prepare concise dashboards and briefings for the CTO, Security leadership, and board-level reviews.

  • Run lightweight operating cadences and remove workflow friction across Engineering, Security, Product, Legal, and Compliance to keep remediations moving.

What you need to bring:

  • Deep Operational Experience: Significant experience designing, implementing, or operating incident management, technology operations, security operations, or technology risk mechanisms within a complex enterprise environment.

  • Framework and Process Design: Proven track record of architecting and embedding durable incident management frameworks, post-incident RCA programs, communications protocols, and follow-through mechanisms across distributed engineering teams.

  • Data and Executive Communication: Exceptional skills in helping translate complex, fragmented technical data into clear executive dashboards, narrative briefings, and board-level materials.

  • Structured Problem Solving: Exceptional ability to assist teams in bringing order to ambiguous operational challenges, isolating systemic root causes, and building automated and durable mechanisms over manual workarounds.

  • Poise Under Pressure: Strong situational judgment, calm demeanor, and clear analytical thinking to help navigate high-severity incidents or urgent executive escalations.

  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Highly collaborative mindset with a track record of building trusted peer relationships across engineering, operations, security, and executive leadership.

  • As a global company with employees and clients outside of Quebec, fluency in English as a working language is required for this position.

Be a changemaker

You’ll enjoy:

  • A flexible work environment that empowers you to do your best work

  • A culture that celebrates performance

  • The chance to make an impact in a team that’s big enough for career growth, but lean enough to make your voice heard

  • Career-defining opportunities

Plus benefits designed to keep you happy, healthy and fulfilled.

  • Flexible paid time off and remote work policies

  • Equity options, because this is your company too

  • Contributions to your pension plan. Your future matters

  • Training opportunities to grow your skills and career

  • Health and wellness credit so you feel your best

  • Time off to volunteer and give back to your community

  • Interest groups, employee led networks, social committees to sponsored sports teams

  • Computer purchase program to get your personal Macbook

  • Enhanced parental leave to support growing families

Fuel your growth. Find your people.

At Lightspeed, your growth is our priority. We invest in you with continuous learning opportunities, global mobility and benefits designed to support you—all within a driven, diverse and inclusive team that’s passionate about empowering our communities

Please note that we ask applicants to disclose any criminal convictions, and we conduct criminal record checks as part of our hiring process for this role.

To all recruitment agencies: Lightspeed does not accept unsolicited agency resumes. If we have not directly engaged your company in writing to supply candidates for a specific vacancy, Lightspeed will not be responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes.

Lightspeed is a proud equal opportunity employer and we are committed to creating an inclusive and barrier-free workplace. Lightspeed welcomes and encourages applications from people with disabilities. Accommodations are available on request for candidates taking part in all aspects of the selection process.

Where to from here?

Obviously, this has to be mutually beneficial: we want you to step into a role you love, and we want to offer you a place you’re proud to come to every day. For a glimpse into our world check out our career page here.

Lightspeed is building communities through commerce, and we need people from all backgrounds and lived experiences to do that. We were founded in 2005, in Montreal’s gay village and our original members were all part of the LGBTQ+ community. The ethos of our business has been about inclusion from the very beginning, and we strive to provide a workplace where everyone belongs.

Who we are:

Powering the businesses that are the backbone of the global economy, Lightspeed's one-stop commerce platform helps merchants innovate to simplify, scale, and provide exceptional customer experiences. Our cloud commerce solution transforms and unifies online and physical operations, multichannel sales, expansion to new locations, global payments, financial solutions, and connection to supplier networks.

Founded in Montréal, Canada in 2005, Lightspeed is dual-listed on the New York Stock Exchange (NYSE: LSPD) and Toronto Stock Exchange (TSX: LSPD). With teams across North America, Europe, and Asia Pacific, the company serves retail, hospitality, and golf businesses in over 100 countries.

Lightspeed handles your information in accordance with our Applicant Privacy Statement.

jobs.title: Principal Account Executive, Home Care
jobs.description:
About the Role

A Place for Mom (APFM) is seeking a strategic, results-driven Principal Account Executive, Home Care to drive growth within the home care segment by developing and expanding partnerships with large home care franchise systems, multi-location operators, and corporate organizations that own or manage multiple home care agencies. In this enterprise sales “hunter” role, the Account Executive builds the APFM value story to win the corporate order top-down. This role is responsible for engaging executive-level stakeholders to secure corporate partnerships and large-scale orders while increasing agency participation, referral volume, and network capacity across affiliated locations.

The Principal Account Executive will take a consultative, enterprise-focused approach to selling, navigating complex organizational structures, and influencing stakeholders across corporate leadership, franchise business coaches, and individual franchise agencies. Success in this role is defined by establishing APFM’s value with strategic franchise accounts and landing corporate orders, which in turn grow APFM’s network capacity, participating agency penetration, and referral volume. To support the corporate sale, this individual will also work closely with Home Care Acquisition Managers (HCAMs), who drive grassroots adoption and agency-level sales, and Customer Success Managers (CSMs), who lead agency-level onboarding, enablement, and retention, to accelerate selling velocity, align corporate and local strategies, and expand APFM’s penetration across franchise and corporate networks.

The ideal candidate is a proven enterprise seller who combines a demonstrated history of consultative sales success with strong executive presence, analytical rigor, and the ability to lead cross-functional teams toward shared commercial objectives.

Responsibilities

  • Own the full enterprise sales cycle with franchise organizations and other multi-location operators, from prospecting and securing executive access through negotiation and close, to land corporate orders that bring locations into APFM’s network at scale.

  • Build a compelling, tailored APFM value story for each strategic account, grounded in its business model, growth priorities, and location-level performance data, that makes the case for a corporate-level commitment.

  • Develop and execute strategic enterprise account plans for home care franchise systems, large corporate operators, and organizations with multiple home care agencies to win corporate orders, drive revenue growth, and achieve corporate sales objectives.

  • Build relationships with C-suite executives, corporate leadership, franchise business coaches, and other senior decision-makers to establish APFM as a strategic partner and secure large-scale corporate orders.

  • Identify opportunities to expand existing relationships, recognizing that some agencies may already participate in APFM’s programs through independently established agency relationships, and translate that existing engagement into corporate orders.

  • Drive enterprise-wide adoption and increase the penetration of APFM’s programs across eligible franchise locations, affiliated agencies, and corporate-owned networks.

  • Grow referral volume and network capacity by developing strategies that increase the number of participating agencies and expand engagement within existing accounts.

  • Partner closely with HCAMs to accelerate agency-level selling, align grassroots sales efforts with corporate priorities, and increase the velocity of local adoption and program utilization, building the location-level momentum that helps win each corporate order.

  • Guide Customer Success Managers (CSMs) on agency-level enablement, including the HCAM-to-CSM handoff at go-live, so local execution reflects each corporate partner’s priorities, and use the adoption results and upsell triggers CSMs surface as proof points to win and expand corporate orders.

  • Develop executive-level presentations and business reviews that communicate APFM program performance, highlight growth opportunities, and establish clear plans for expanding participation and referral volume.

  • Monitor strategic account performance, agency participation, network capacity, referral trends, and sales pipeline progression to assess progress against growth objectives and adjust strategies accordingly.

  • Establish measurable account-level goals and hold cross-functional partners, including HCAMs and CSMs, accountable for execution, ensuring that corporate agreements translate into agency participation, sustained retention, and incremental business.

  • Maintain accurate account plans, forecasts, pipeline reporting, and performance metrics within APFM’s CRM and reporting systems.

  • Represent APFM in executive meetings, industry events, and strategic partnership discussions to strengthen relationships and identify new opportunities for growth.

Skills and Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, Healthcare Administration, or a related field required.

  • Minimum of 7 years of B2B sales experience, with a proven track record of achieving and exceeding revenue targets.

  • Demonstrated success in consultative selling, closing enterprise deals, strategic business development, and navigating complex sales cycles.

  • Experience selling through franchise or multi-location/channel structures, winning corporate-level commitments that drive adoption across individually owned locations.

  • Strong executive presence, with the ability to build credibility and influence senior executives, corporate decision-makers, franchise leadership, and other key stakeholders.

  • Experience managing cross-functional teams, including sales and customer success partners, and driving results through influence and collaboration without direct authority.

  • Proven ability to turn data into clear, compelling insights that uncover growth opportunities, influence decisions, and build the case for investment.

  • Strong analytical, financial, negotiation, presentation, and relationship-management skills.

  • Experience in home care, senior care, or a related healthcare services industry preferred.

  • Highly organized and self-directed, with the ability to manage multiple strategic accounts, prioritize opportunities, and execute against ambitious growth objectives.

  • Willingness to travel as needed to support executive engagement, strategic account development, and field execution. Estimated 25% travel.

Compensation

Base Salary: $122,500

Bonus: $82,075

Benefits:

  • 401(k) plus match

  • Dental insurance

  • Health insurance

  • Vision Insurance

  • Paid Time Off

jobs.title: Growth Associate
jobs.description:
Overview of the role

We’re on a mission to modernize insurance, making it simpler, more accessible, and customer-first. The insurance industry is a $1T market that’s remained largely untouched by the digital revolution, and PolicyMe is here to change that. As a remote-first, Toronto-based startup with big ambitions, we’re building the future of insurance in Canada and beyond.

This isn't a traditional marketing job. It's a problem-solving role on our paid growth team. Acquiring insurance customers profitably and at scale is one of the hardest problems in the industry.

You'll be the number two to our Senior Growth Marketing Manager, who owns the budget and results for our paid channels: a multi-million dollar budget across Meta and Google and multiple insurance lines. She joined PolicyMe as a generalist with no marketing background and grew into running the channel. We're looking for the next person who can do the same.

Expect to spend your first year or so deep in paid growth. After that, people who do well here take on more: owning a channel outright, creating your own team, launching a new product, or moving into another part of growth.

What you'll be doing:

  • Own channels as you earn it. Run campaigns on Meta and Google, taking on more budget and decisions as you prove your calls.
  • Run creative testing. Decide what to test, brief designers and creators, and call what to scale or kill.
  • Find what drives our cost to acquire a customer. Dig into Looker, ad platforms, and spreadsheets, question the data, and turn it into decisions on where money goes.
  • Build with AI. Create the workflows and automations that let a small team run a large budget.
  • Help launch new products, like Home & Auto, by testing them fast.

What are we looking for:

  • 2 to 4 years in a technical, creative, marketing, or growth role. Paid ads experience is a bonus, not a requirement.
  • A builder: you've made something real with AI, code, or automation tools, at work or on your own.
  • An artist: you have a creative side, strong taste, and criteria to understand why an ad, a video, or a message works, and who it's for.
  • Curious about customers: you want to understand what people worry about and why they buy.
  • A clear communicator: you write briefs and recommendations people can act on without a follow-up call.
  • Driven: you go above and beyond, follow through, and do your homework before anyone asks.
  • A fast learner: you've gone from zero to genuinely good at something, quickly and mostly on your own.

Why join us:

  • Generous PTO - 20 vacation days
  • A comprehensive benefits plan with premiums paid in full by PolicyMe
  • Investment in your professional development, including an L&D budget, AI tooling budget, performance reviews twice a year and ongoing feedback to ensure you reach your highest potential
  • An extremely high performing, low-ego, remote-first team that is truly disrupting an old industry
  • Option to work from home or our Toronto-based office (bonus: we cover the costs to bring all our employees in-person twice a year for experiential socials!)
  • Access to stock options based on performance
  • Compensation: The total target cash compensation for this role is $90,000–$115,000 CAD, based on experience. We’ll walk through the details together during the interview.

Compensation

Additional Information

About PolicyMe:

At PolicyMe, we are Canada’s leading digital insurance solution, offering straightforward and affordable financial protection for families from coast to coast. Our product suite includes Life Insurance, Critical Illness Insurance, and Health & Dental Insurance, all tailored to Canadians' evolving needs. We also offer B2B2C solutions, partnering with organizations to provide seamless digital insurance options. Founded by a team of insurance experts and technology entrepreneurs, PolicyMe is committed to making insurance simpler and more accessible. Are you actively looking for a new opportunity? Or just checking the market? Well… you might just be in the right place!

Lightspeed is seeking a Senior Staff Portfolio Operations Manager to join our Product & Technology Operations team.

In this role, you'll help Product & Technology leaders understand portfolio performance, investment priorities, and business outcomes. Using data and business insights, you'll support informed decision-making around priorities, investments, and strategic trade-offs.

The role will begin with a six-month assignment leading Product Operations for our Hospitality vertical. During this time, you'll partner with Product & Technology leaders to support roadmap development and execution, manage cross-functional dependencies, and strengthen planning and delivery practices. Following this initial assignment, you'll transition into a permanent, cross-portfolio Business Operations role spanning Hospitality, Retail, and Financial Services.

Reporting to the Director of Business Operations, Product & Technology, you'll collaborate closely with Product Operations leads, vertical leaders, Finance, and other cross-functional partners.

This is a senior individual contributor role suited to someone who brings experience in software product development, strong business judgment, and the ability to influence senior leaders, challenge assumptions, and drive change without relying on formal authority.

Location: Lightspeed is currently seeking candidates based in Canada. Candidates in Canada but residing outside the Eastern Time Zone must be flexible and willing to adjust their working hours as needed to accommodate EST-based collaboration and business requirements.

What you'll be doing:

  • Lead Hospitality Product Operations

    • Partner with Hospitality Product & Technology leaders on roadmap planning and execution, managing priorities, dependencies, and delivery risks.

    • Identify opportunities to improve how teams plan, communicate, and execute against priorities, breaking down silos and strengthening cross-functional collaboration.

    • Partner with Product Operations leads and vertical leaders to resolve shared challenges, build alignment, and coordinate action.

    • Establish consistent planning and review processes that support collaboration and timely decision-making.

  • Strong analytical and financial acumen, with experience developing portfolio reporting, dashboards, financial models, and investment tracking to support business decisions and evaluate trade-offs.

  • Proven ability to translate complex data and business performance insights into actionable recommendations that inform strategic priorities, investment decisions, and operational improvements.

  • Experience partnering with and influencing senior leaders and cross-functional stakeholders, building alignment, challenging assumptions, and driving decisions without relying on formal authority.

  • Strong business judgment and problem-solving skills, with the ability to independently identify opportunities, anticipate challenges, and drive initiatives forward in ambiguous environments.

  • Experience improving operational processes, governance, and ways of working within a complex technology organization, balancing strategic priorities with hands-on execution.

  • Exceptional communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to simplify complex concepts, adapt messaging to different audiences, and build trusted relationships across Product, Technology, Finance, and other business functions.

jobs.title: Accounting Manager
jobs.description:
At Serve Robotics, we’re reimagining how things move in cities. Our personable sidewalk robot is our vision for the future. It’s designed to take deliveries away from congested streets, make deliveries available to more people, and benefit local businesses.

The Serve fleet has been delighting merchants, customers, and pedestrians along the way in Los Angeles, Miami, Dallas, Atlanta and Chicago while doing commercial deliveries. We’re looking for talented individuals who will grow robotic deliveries from surprising novelty to efficient ubiquity.

Who We Are

We are tech industry veterans in software, hardware, and design who are pooling our skills to build the future we want to live in. We are solving real-world problems leveraging robotics, machine learning and computer vision, among other disciplines, with a mindful eye towards the end-to-end user experience. Our team is agile, diverse, and driven. We believe that the best way to solve complicated dynamic problems is collaboratively and respectfully.

JOB OVERVIEW

The Accounting Manager is responsible for overseeing the daily accounting operations, ensuring the accuracy and completeness of financial data, and managing the accounting team. This role plays a critical part in ensuring financial integrity, compliance with relevant regulations, and timely financial reporting. The Accounting Manager will also work closely with senior management to provide insightful financial analysis and support strategic decision-making.

JOB DUTIES

  • Oversee general ledger activities, including month-end and year-end close processes, ensuring accurate and timely reporting.

  • Prepare and review monthly financial statements, management reports, and financial forecasts to provide actionable insights to senior management.

  • Ensure compliance with local, state, and federal regulations, including audits and adherence to Generally Accepted Accounting Principles (GAAP).

  • Conduct research on complex accounting issues, including new accounting pronouncements, and assess their impact on the company’s financial statements. Provide guidance and recommendations for implementation of new standards (e.g., lease accounting, revenue recognition, etc.).

  • Implement and maintain a strong system of internal controls, ensuring accurate financial data and mitigating risks of fraud or error.

  • Prepare the accurate and timely recognition of revenue, ensuring compliance with revenue recognition standards (ASC 606).

  • Partner with sales and operations to ensure correct recording of revenue transactions.

  • Oversee AP/AR processes, ensuring timely and accurate invoicing, collections, and payments.

  • Oversee and monitor inventory accounting processes, including physical inventory counts, inventory reconciliations, and valuation methods.

  • Ensure proper cost of goods sold (COGS) calculations and reporting of inventory levels.

  • Ensure compliance with lease accounting standards (ASC 842), including maintaining accurate records of leases, calculating right-of-use assets, and lease liabilities, and ensuring proper amortization schedules.

  • Coordinate external audits and provide necessary documentation and support for the completion of audits.

  • Identify opportunities for process improvement and automation within accounting systems to enhance efficiency and accuracy.

EXPERIENCE, QUALIFICATIONS, & SKILLS

Required Experience, Qualifications, and Skills

  • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or related field.

  • 6+ years of total accounting experience preferably at a mid-sized or large public company

  • 4+ years public accounting experience

  • 2-3 years managing a team and/or multiple Accounting functions

  • Proficiency with accounting software (e.g., Netsuite) and advanced Microsoft Excel skills.

  • Strong understanding of GAAP, particularly in areas like revenue recognition (ASC 606), lease accounting (ASC 842), and equity accounting.

  • Excellent organizational, and communication skills, with the ability to work under pressure and meet tight deadlines.

  • Strong analytical skills with a high level of accuracy in financial reporting and data management.

  • Ability to identify, troubleshoot, and resolve accounting discrepancies and process inefficiencies.

Preferred Experience, Qualifications, and Skills

  • CPA certified.

  • Experience with robotics or manufacturing companies.

  • Experience working in a newly public company is a significant plus.

  • Familiarity with SOX compliance and financial reporting for public companies is highly desirable.

Additional Information:

Location: Remote - San Francisco, Los Angeles, Denver, Austin Preferred

jobs.title: Director, Client Analytics Partnerships

jobs.title: Senior Manager, Services Portfolio & Learning Architecture
jobs.description:
Who is Tenable?

Tenable® is the Exposure Management company. Over 40,000 organizations around the globe rely on Tenable to understand and reduce cyber risk. Our global employees support 65 percent of the Fortune 500, 50 percent of the Global 2000, and large government agencies. Come be part of our journey!

What makes Tenable such a great place to work?

Ask a member of our team and they’ll answer, “Our people!” We work together to build and innovate best-in-class cybersecurity solutions for our customers; all while creating a culture of belonging, respect, and excellence where we can be our best selves. When you’re part of our #OneTenable team, you can expect to partner with some of the most talented and passionate people in the industry, and have the support and resources you need to do work that truly matters. We deliver results that exceed expectations and we win together!

Applicants must be authorized to work for any employer in the U.S. without sponsorship. We are unable to provide sponsorship for work visas of any kind at the time of hire, or at any point during employment. This includes, but is not limited to: F1-OPT, F1-CPT, H-1B, TN, J-1, etc

Your Role:

The Senior Manager, Services Architecture & Education leads the Portfolio Architects within the Global Services Portfolio, serving as the strategic link that converts overarching portfolio strategy into technically credible consulting services and end-to-end Education programs. Carrying a dual mandate, this role is accountable for leading an experienced team of technical experts through an evolving operating model while acting as the authoritative technical design voice across the entire Global Services suite.

This position owns service design, Education strategy, offering creation, the On-Demand Training (ODT) and Instructor-Led Training (ILT) curricula, and the Training Subscription model. The Senior Manager builds, standardizes, and scales the creation and maintenance engine necessary to keep all consulting offerings and educational content continually aligned with Tenable’s rapidly evolving product roadmap, feature releases, and version retirements.

Working with minimal supervision as a key member of the Services Portfolio Leadership Team, the Senior Manager sets high-bar technical and instructional standards, balances team capacity across creation, optimization, and lifecycle maintenance, and collaborates seamlessly with cross-functional leadership—including Portfolio Strategy & Innovation, Portfolio Enablement & Creative, Program Management, and PS Product Champions—to drive portfolio adoption and operational excellence.

ORGANIZATION STRUCTURE:

  • Reports to: Senior Director, Services Portfolio
  • Direct reports: Portfolio Architects (Associate Services Architects, Services Architects, and Senior Services Architects)

Your Opportunity:

Service Design & Offering Creation

  • Service Architecture: Own the architecture, methodology, scope, and outcomes of consulting service offerings, and the technical requirements and validation behind them. Each offering has a named Services Architect who owns its technical design, with the Manager accountable.
  • Offering Creation: Direct the creation of net-new offerings and Education against the quarterly roadmap set by Portfolio Strategy & Innovation, and lead improvements to existing services alongside the Portfolio Strategy & Innovation Lead.
  • Technical Substance: Make sure the team owns the technical, service, and Education substance of its work, and that the content is accurate before it is handed to Portfolio Enablement & Creative for writing and design.
  • Standards & Quality: Set and maintain service design, content, and lab standards and templates, and review the most strategic offerings before release.

Education Strategy & Training Subscription

  • Education Strategy: Set the direction for Professional Services Education across on-demand (ODT), instructor-led (ILT), and hybrid delivery.
  • Curriculum Ownership: Be accountable for the TRG master curriculum and the ODT and ILT source content, including review on a defined cadence and consistency between delivery formats.
  • Training Subscription: Direct the priorities and evolution of the Training Subscription and track its adoption.
  • Education Authoring: Ensure Architects author and maintain Education content, including in Articulate, to the standard required for technical accuracy and sound learning design. Work with Portfolio Enablement & Creative, where digital learning production needs specialist support.
  • Education Governance: Work with the Education Governance Lead on standards, approvals, versioning, and controls. The Manager owns the Education strategy, and Governance owns the controls.

Portfolio Maintenance & Lifecycle

  • Maintenance Health: Be accountable for overall maintenance health across services and Education. Run maintenance as a formal lifecycle (identify, triage, assign, update, validate, publish, communicate, close) carried out by named asset owners, without creating a permanent maintenance team.
  • Capacity Allocation: Allocate team capacity between creating, improving, and maintaining content, and report the mix, overdue maintenance, and retirements at the quarterly portfolio review.
  • Roadmap Alignment: Work with Product Management and Portfolio Strategy & Innovation to plan updates well ahead of product release, and to decide what to refresh, retire, or replace.
  • Feedback Loop: Act on maintenance and improvement items routed from field feedback triage and the PS Product Champions Forum, and close the loop visibly with the field.

Team Leadership & Delivery

  • People Leadership: Recruit, onboard, manage, and develop the Portfolio Architects, including performance management and career progression across the Associate, Services Architect, and Senior Services Architect levels.
  • Change Leadership: Lead the team through the move to the new operating model, including the transition of long-tenured team members, and set clear expectations for the Architect role.
  • Capability Building: Build team capability in service design, Education design, and delivery, and in the use of modern authoring and AI-enabled production approaches.
  • Delivery Oversight: Oversee dependencies, costs, and schedules across team projects, assess risks, and take corrective action to ensure on-time, within-budget delivery.
  • Budget: Manage the team’s budget and make the case for resources, tooling, and lab environments.
  • Protecting Creation Time: Protect focus time for the team, including the Friday focus day, so that deep creation and maintenance work is not displaced by meetings.

Leadership & Cross-Functional Engagement

  • Portfolio Leadership Team: Contribute to the weekly Portfolio Management Call, bringing creation, Education, maintenance, capacity, and the decisions required, and to the quarterly portfolio review.
  • Strategy & Innovation: Work with the Portfolio Strategy & Innovation Lead on the annual and quarterly roadmap, business cases, and launch readiness, providing technical and Education input.
  • Enablement & Creative: Work with the Portfolio Enablement & Creative Manager on briefs, handoffs, and review cycles to ensure creative output includes accurate technical content.
  • Program Management: Work with the Portfolio Program Manager on milestones, dependencies, and launch readiness.
  • PS Product Champions: Use the PS Product Champions to validate content and to maintain delivery playbooks, worksheets, and guidance, with Architects validating where needed.
  • Stakeholders: Interface with leaders in Product, Customer Success, Customer Care, Sales, and Partners, including direct customer and partner engagement where needed.
  • Escalations: Act as the senior escalation point for portfolio content issues that the team cannot resolve.

What You'll Need:

Experience

  • Security Foundations: 10+ years of overall experience in Information Security.
  • Vulnerability Management & Cybersecurity: 5+ years of experience in vulnerability management and broader cybersecurity operations, preferably with the Tenable product suite.
  • Services Experience: 7+ years of professional services, consulting, technical support, sales engineering, or technical training experience.
  • Education & Curriculum: Proven experience setting Education strategy and designing and delivering technical curricula across on-demand, instructor-led, and hybrid formats, including subscription or learning platform offerings.
  • People Management: 3+ years of experience leading technical, content, or consulting teams, including line management and leading experienced teams through change.
  • Delivery Lifecycle: Exposure to the full offering or product delivery life cycle: requirements analysis, design, testing, and implementation.
  • Cross-Functional Leadership: Experience with cross-functional and cross-organisational program management, including gathering customer and stakeholder requirements.

Knowledge and Education

  • Education: B.S. or M.S. degree in Computer Science or a related field preferred; equivalent experience considered.
  • Technical Depth: In-depth knowledge of Windows and Linux operating systems and of TCP/IP networking, with working knowledge of web application, container, and cloud security (AWS/Azure) and ICS/SCADA systems.
  • Learning Design & Authoring: Working knowledge of instructional design frameworks and of authoring tools such as Articulate, sufficient to set standards and review the team’s work.
  • Business Acumen: Both business and technical acumen, including budget management and capacity planning.
  • Certifications: CISSP, CISM, or PMP preferred.

And Ideally:

  • Communication: Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to present to executive, customer, and partner audiences.
  • Collaboration: Strong interpersonal skills with the ability to influence and work effectively across teams and at a senior level.
  • Autonomy: Strong initiative and the ability to work with minimal supervision, remotely and as part of a geographically distributed team, in an agile environment.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager, Operations & Commercialization
jobs.description:
At Serve Robotics, we’re reimagining how things move in cities. Our personable sidewalk robot is our vision for the future. It’s designed to take deliveries away from congested streets, make deliveries available to more people, and benefit local businesses.

The Serve fleet has been delighting merchants, customers, and pedestrians along the way in Los Angeles, Miami, Dallas, Atlanta and Chicago while doing commercial deliveries. We’re looking for talented individuals who will grow robotic deliveries from surprising novelty to efficient ubiquity.

Who We Are

We are tech industry veterans in software, hardware, and design who are pooling our skills to build the future we want to live in. We are solving real-world problems leveraging robotics, machine learning and computer vision, among other disciplines, with a mindful eye towards the end-to-end user experience. Our team is agile, diverse, and driven. We believe that the best way to solve complicated dynamic problems is collaboratively and respectfully.

The Senior Product Manager, Operations & Commercialization owns products that make Serve’s fleet welcome in neighborhoods, reliable in service, and delightful for customers and partners. This role translates the needs of the public, operators, field teams, merchants, customers, and delivery partners into capabilities that improve delivery quality, fleet utilization, and the cost of robot revenue. Partnering with Operations, Growth, Engineering, Autonomy, Data, Safety, and commercial teams, this PM drives products from discovery through launch and iteration, using evidence and field insight to focus on the highest-impact improvements.

Qualifications

  • Own the product roadmap for Operations & Commercialization by translating the needs of operators, field teams, merchants, customers, and commercial partners into high-impact priorities.

  • Define and own success measures for operational performance and delivery quality including successful and on-time deliveries, customer and merchant defects, reliability, supply hours, fleet utilization, and cost efficiency; establish baselines and targets and make performance visible by market, partner, and platform where useful.

  • Maintain an evidence-based view of the most important failure modes and opportunities using operational data, customer and partner feedback, and field observation to identify root causes, shape requirements, and reassess priorities as evidence changes.

  • Build scalable operational workflows for robot supervision, deployment, and dispatch that reduce manual work and improve fleet productivity.

  • Improve delivery reliability with capabilities for issue detection, remote interventions, exception handling, incident follow-up, and service recovery that maximize successful deliveries.

  • Elevate the customer and public experience through intuitive, dependable interactions that strengthen merchant satisfaction and help make Serve robots welcome in neighborhoods; spend time with operators, field teams, merchants, and customers to ground decisions in real workflows.

  • Enable commercial launches by partnering with the Logistics Platform team to define product capabilities, integration requirements, onboarding workflows, and SLA guardrails that streamline launches and drive partner success.

  • Scale market deployments with repeatable product capabilities and workflows that accelerate launches, reduce operational complexity, and support expansion.

  • Own products from concept through launch and iteration by defining problem statements, requirements, success criteria, rollout plans, and adoption measures; align teams, make tradeoffs, and ensure successful rollout.

  • Drive fast, focused execution with Engineering by scoping and sequencing improvements, favoring small releases, rapid learning, and frequent testing over unnecessary over-engineering while maintaining release readiness and reliability.

  • Use analytics and AI-enabled tools where useful including LLM-based analysis or agents to explore operational data, accelerate root-cause investigation, and turn findings into actionable requirements and priorities; rapidly prototype workflows, dashboards, and proofs of concept to validate ideas before committing significant engineering capacity.

  • Coordinate cross-functional quality initiatives with Analytics, Engineering, Operations, Program Management, Safety, Support, and Field Operations; keep owners, dependencies, risks, and decisions visible, escalate blockers early, and close the loop on defects and root causes.

Responsibilities

  • 6+ years of product management experience taking software products from discovery through launch and iteration, with clear ownership of product outcomes.

  • Experience building tools or platforms for operationally complex environments such as logistics, mobility, marketplaces, field services, or enterprise workflows.

  • Strong user-discovery skills and the ability to translate frontline workflows, technical constraints, operational data, and partner feedback into prioritized requirements.

  • Technical fluency with APIs, data flows, connected systems, and product analytics; ability to partner effectively with Engineering and Design.

  • Demonstrated ability to define and use metrics to improve reliability, delivery quality, efficiency, user experience, or business performance.

  • Strong prioritization and judgment: able to make clear, defensible tradeoffs across competing problems and adjust direction as evidence changes.

  • Practical experience using AI-enabled tools or LLMs to accelerate data exploration, root-cause investigation, workflow improvement, or product prototyping, with sound judgment about validating results.

  • Track record of shipping iteratively with Engineering, balancing speed, learning, release readiness, and reliability.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication, stakeholder management, and ability to influence cross-functional teams in ambiguous, fast-changing environments.

What Makes You Stand Out

  • Experience building products for operational teams where software decisions directly affect real-world performance, safety, and unit economics.

  • Familiarity with fleet management, dispatch, remote assistance, incident management, maintenance, or field-service systems, particularly across multiple markets.

  • Experience building partner-facing APIs, integrations, onboarding workflows, or multi-sided marketplace products.

  • Hands-on analytics skills such as SQL and dashboards, or experience using AI agents, LLM tools, and code-interpreters to investigate operational data and prototype workflow improvements.

  • Experience owning delivery-quality or reliability metrics, conducting root-cause analysis or incident reviews, or supporting release management.

Additional Information

Periodic travel to operating markets and partner sites may be required to observe workflows, support launches, and validate product performance. The role requires comfort working with live physical operations while balancing rapid iteration with reliability and safety.

jobs.description:
Who is Tenable?

Tenable® is the Exposure Management company. Over 40,000 organizations around the globe rely on Tenable to understand and reduce cyber risk. Our global employees support 65 percent of the Fortune 500, 50 percent of the Global 2000, and large government agencies. Come be part of our journey!

What makes Tenable such a great place to work?

Ask a member of our team and they’ll answer, “Our people!” We work together to build and innovate best-in-class cybersecurity solutions for our customers; all while creating a culture of belonging, respect, and excellence where we can be our best selves. When you’re part of our #OneTenable team, you can expect to partner with some of the most talented and passionate people in the industry, and have the support and resources you need to do work that truly matters. We deliver results that exceed expectations and we win together!

Applicants must be authorized to work for any employer in the U.S. without sponsorship. We are unable to provide sponsorship for work visas of any kind at the time of hire, or at any point during employment. This includes, but is not limited to: F1-OPT, F1-CPT, H-1B, TN, J-1, etc

Your Role:

We are seeking an expert, data-driven Manager, Integrated Search & Google Media to own our paid search and Google media ecosystem while managing essential SEO and GEO strategies. In this role, you will also drive the strategy and execution across Google Ads, Bing Ads, YouTube and YouTube TV ads, and broader Google advertising properties.

As our primary Paid Search authority, you live and breathe Google Ads, master modern AI-driven campaign structures (Performance Max, Smart Bidding, AI creatives), and stay at the forefront of search evolution. You bring a deeply curious, proactive personality and a passion for experimentation - constantly testing new ideas, interrogating performance data, and willing to try bold new approaches to stay ahead of trends.

In addition to scaling our paid search and improving our ROI, you will manage critical SEO/GEO initiatives with direction and guidance from our Senior Manager, SEO/GEO and partner closely with our Performance Marketing Theater Leads - translating theater-based goals into execution-ready search strategies to generate awareness, create and capture demand that turns into pipeline, and holding accountability for regional numbers.

Your Opportunity:

Paid Search, Bing and Google Ecosystem

  • End-to-End Media Management: Own the strategy, launch, optimization, and scaling of high-ROI performance campaigns across Google Search, Bing Ads, YouTube and YouTube TV ads, and Google Display/Discovery.
  • AI & Platform Innovation: Master advanced ad features (Smart Bidding, auto-generated assets, AI bidding algorithms) to continually scale performance and improve audience targeting.
  • Theater Collaboration & Numbers Accountability: Partner hand-in-hand with Performance Marketing Theater Leads to understand regional goals, revenue targets, and market considerations. Deliver actionable paid search strategies that generate pipeline and directly meet theater targets.
  • Paid Search Experimentation & Optimization: Lead end-to-end campaign and post-click experimentation across paid search. Build structured testing frameworks to optimize ad performance, landing page experiences, and alternative lead capture mechanisms - driving continuous improvement in message alignment and conversion.

Technical SEO & GEO

  • Technical SEO & Metadata Management: Perform ongoing technical SEO optimizations, site audit reporting and prioritization, meta tag creation, and optimization to ensure high crawlability, indexability, and keyword alignment.

Integrated Search Strategy, Analytics & Reporting

  • Incremental Lift & Shared Reporting: Partner with Senior Manager, SEO/GEO on incremental lift analysis and reporting (Paid + Organic) to prove total search performance, identify cannibalization risks, and maximize incremental pipeline.
  • Keyword & Competitive Intelligence: Conduct regular keyword tracking, reporting, and competitive insights analysis to map competitor SERP dominance, keyword gaps, and prompt share across both paid and organic environments.
  • Tracking & Data Quality: Perform continuous UTM and URL cleanup/optimization across paid landing pages, organic pages, and tracking scripts to guarantee clean attribution, accurate reporting, and frictionless landing page experiences.

What You'll Need:

  • 5+ Years of Hands-On Experience: Proven track record managing complex, multi-region paid search and video budgets across Google Ads, Bing Ads, YouTube and YouTube TV ads.
  • Google Ads / AdWords Mastery: Expert-level fluency across the Google Ads platform- Search, Video, PMax, Audience targeting, and automated bid management.
  • Hands-On Technical SEO & GEO Capabilities: Demonstrated ability to perform technical site audits, meta tag optimizations, keyword tracking, and modern GEO/Prompt tracking across AI search platforms.
  • Theater/Regional Business Alignment: Experience working directly with regional theater or growth leads to turn market-specific targets into conversion-driven campaign tactics with direct revenue accountability.
  • Analytics & Attribution Expertise: Advanced skills in GA4, Google Tag Manager, dashboard tools (Looker Studio, Tableau), and multi-touch attribution modeling.
  • AI-Forward Search Mindset: Strong understanding of how search behavior is shifting toward generative AI and how to leverage modern AI tools to accelerate copy generation, landing page strategies, and performance insights.
  • Able to work in a hybrid/on-site capacity at our office in Columbia MD or Boston MA. This position is US-based only.
  • May perform other duties and responsibilities that management may deem necessary from time to time.

And Ideally:

  • Google Ads Certifications (Search, Video, Display) & GA4 Certification.
  • Experience with SEO/GEO monitoring software (e.g., SEMrush, Conductor, Amplitude).
  • Experience working in global B2B performance marketing environments with matrixed theater structures.

jobs.title: Sr Manager, Enterprise Data Platform & Governance
jobs.description:
The Kestra team has over 400 years of experience in the external and internal cardiac medical device markets. The company was founded in 2014 by industry leaders inspired by the opportunity to unite modern wearable technologies with proven device therapies. Kestra’s solutions combine high quality and technical performance with a wearable design that provides the greatest regard for patient comfort and dignity. Innovating versatile new ways to deliver care, Kestra is helping patients and their care teams harmoniously monitor, manage, and protect life.

The Senior Manager, Enterprise Data Platform & Governance owns Kestra’s enterprise data platform and the standards that govern how data is used across the company. Reporting to the CIO, this role leads the transition to Microsoft Fabric, defines the enterprise data architecture, and operationalizes the Master Data Management (MDM) program. The role sets the rules, certified data models, and guardrails that allow analysts embedded in business functions to build their own reports and insights safely and consistently. This is a platform and governance leadership role, not a report development role. The Senior Manager directs outsourced engineering, administration, and development resources today, with the opportunity to build an internal team as the platform matures and serves as a trusted advisor to functional leaders as Kestra builds the governed data foundation required for AI, automation, and its evolving enterprise systems.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES:
Data Platform and Architecture

  • Own the design, implementation, and operation of the enterprise data platform, including the Microsoft Fabric transition plan from the current Azure-based environment.
  • Define and maintain the enterprise data architecture, including Lakehouse design, semantic models, data ingestion patterns, and environment strategy across development, test, and production.
  • Manage platform capacity, performance, reliability, and cost, and recommend licensing and capacity adjustments to the CIO.
  • Maintain continuity of enterprise analytics as source systems evolve, including Salesforce, Microsoft Dynamics 365, and Bonafide, and retire legacy custom reports as they are rebuilt on certified models by functional analysts or delivery resources.
  • Prepare the data platform for AI and automation use cases, including Microsoft Copilot experiences, such as Copilot in Fabric and Power BI and Microsoft 365 Copilot, on governed semantic models, and data products that support embedded insights within business workflows.

Master Data Management

  • Operationalize the MDM program, including master data domains, ownership, stewardship processes, data quality rules, and supporting tools.
  • Partner with functional data owners to establish and sustain stewardship roles and data quality metrics.
  • This role sets enterprise data standards, definitions, quality rules, and controls; data owners decide on the content, quality thresholds, and access for their domains within those standards.

Data Governance and Self-Service Enablement

  • Own governance for all users creating reports, dashboards, and BI content from the data platform, including workspace standards, publishing and certification rules, access controls, and change management.
  • Implement data protection controls in partnership with the Director of IT Security and Compliance, including sensitivity labeling of PHI, PII, and financial data, data loss prevention, and role-based access.
  • Make the governed path the easiest path by providing certified datasets, templates, documentation, training, and office hours for self-service users.
  • Serve as the expert guide and technical mentor to data analysts embedded in functions across the company, raising capability and consistency without becoming the default report developer.
  • Establish clear intake and decision rights that distinguish enterprise data standards, owned by this role, from functional analysis, owned by business teams.

Leadership and Advisory

  • Act as a trusted advisor to functional leaders on data strategy, metrics definitions, and how data can improve decisions and operations.
  • Influence leaders and teams outside direct reporting lines through sound judgment and constructive resolution of competing priorities, and communicate platform roadmaps, risks, and tradeoffs to executive audiences in concise, business-oriented terms.

Resource and Vendor Management

  • Manage outsourced developers, administrators, and other technical resources that support the data platform, including scope, prioritization, quality, and delivery.
  • Support sourcing, statements of work, and supplier performance management for data platformservices, and monitor spending against budget.
  • Coordinate with the Director of Information Technology on application integrations and system changes that affect the data platform.

Compliance and Quality

  • Ensuring enterprise data assets and platform processes comply with HIPAA, SOX, and other applicable requirements.
  • Support validation of data platform components and reports for regulatory and audit readiness, including documentation and retention of validation evidence.
  • Adhere to Pledge of Confidentiality
    • Information regarding a patient of this company shall not be released to any source
      outside of this company without the signed permission of the patient. Furthermore,
      information will only be released internally on a need-to-know basis. All Team Members
      will not discuss patient cases outside the office or with anyone not employed by this
      company unless they are directly involved with the patient’s case.

COMPETENCIES:

  • Ability to be a self-starter, seek new and better methods, and work with minimum supervision
  • Demonstrates deep expertise in profession and industry best practices
  • Ability to collaborate within a Team environment and across functions
  • Ability to influence without authority and to say no constructively while preserving working relationships
  • Capability to discern relevant facts and in turn, effectively resolve issues by making good decisions (compliance, quality, integrity, ethics, and critical thinking ability)
  • Ability to be flexible in a fast-paced goal-oriented environment
  • Demonstrates the understanding of deadlines and time limits, ability to accomplish goals, and the desire to win

QUALIFICATIONS:
Education/Experience Required:

  • BS or BA required, preferably in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, Business, or related field; MS or MBA preferred
  • Minimum of 10 years’ experience in data engineering, data architecture, or business intelligence
  • Minimum of 5 years’ experience leading enterprise data platform or data governance programs
  • Minimum of 3 years’ experience managing technical teams, including outsourced or offshore resources
  • Hands-on architecture experience with Microsoft Fabric, Azure Data Factory, Azure Synapse, Databricks, or comparable modern data platforms
  • Experience designing semantic models and governing self-service BI environments, preferably Power BI
  • Experience implementing data governance and data protection controls for regulated data such as PHI or PII
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including experience presenting to senior leaders
  • Must have the highest ethical standards and personal integrity

Preferred:

  • Experience operationalizing a Master Data Management program
  • Experience with Microsoft Purview, sensitivity labeling, and data loss prevention
  • Experience with Salesforce, Microsoft Dynamics 365, or healthcare billing system data
  • Experience preparing data platforms for AI, machine learning, or Microsoft Copilot use cases, including Copilot in Fabric and Power BI or Microsoft 365 Copilot
  • Prior experience in medical technology, DME, or other life science or healthcare industries experience supporting SOX controls or validated systems

SUPERVISORY RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Directly supervise team members including but not limited to conducting performance reviews,
    providing feedback, and helping to set professional development goals.

WORK ENVIRONMENT:

  • Fast-paced environment
  • Noise level typical of an office environment
  • Kestra manufactures and provides life-saving products regulated by the Federal Food and Drug
  • Administration and under contract with Medicare. Kestra maintains a drug free workplace and testing is a condition of employment.
  • Extended hours when needed

PHYSICAL DEMANDS:

  • Frequent repetitive motions that may include wrists, hands and/or fingers, such as keyboard and mouse usage
  • Frequent stationary position, often standing or sitting for prolonged periods of time
  • Occasional phone and other business machine use
  • Occasional lifting required, up to 20 pounds

TRAVEL:

  • Occasional travel, less than 10%

OTHER DUTIES:
This job description is not designed to cover or contain a comprehensive listing of activities, duties or responsibilities that are required of the Team Member. Duties, responsibilities, and activities may change, or new ones may be assigned at any time with or without notice.

BENEFITS:

Kestra offers a very competitive benefit package including Medical, Dental, 401K with Match, etc.

Pay equity is an important part of Kestra’s Culture. Our compensation ranges are guided by national and local salary surveys and take into consideration experience level and internal equity. Each role is benchmarked based on the job description provided If your qualifications and/or experience level are outside of the posted position, we encourage you to apply as we are growing fast and roles that are coming soon may not be posted.

At SiteMinder, we believe our success comes from our people. We build diverse, inclusive teams where different voices, backgrounds and perspectives are valued. Our differences drive innovation for our customers, and our people bring the ideas, expertise and energy that help us keep moving forward. We’re better together.

What We Do...

Right now, somewhere in the world, a hotel is taking a booking or increasing their revenue through technology you could help build. SiteMinder is the world’s leading hotel commerce platform. For more than 20 years, we’ve helped hotels attract guests, maximise revenue, forecast demand and perform at their best. Today, our platform supports 56,000+ hotels in 150+ countries, connects to 3,000+ partners and powers more than 140m reservations and AU$85 billion+ in hotel revenue each year.

That’s the kind of impact your work can have here. You’ll solve meaningful challenges with AI, simplify complexity and build solutions that help hotels perform. Supported by clear purpose, a strong platform and teams who care about what they’re building, you’ll have the opportunity to shape the future of an industry that never stands still.

About the Account Executive role...

Are you ready to take the next step in your SaaS Sales career? Do you want to be part of the technology shaping the future of the travel industry? Join our international, dynamic and outgoing team in Germany!

You will become a trusted advisor to hotel owners, building awareness about how our products can benefit their property. You will have the chance to learn about the challenges that accommodation providers face, and offer a solution that will bring value to their day-to-day and bottom line. Joining SiteMinder as the leader in dynamic hotel revenue management, you will be at the forefront of innovation in the sector.

We won't throw you into the deep end - you'll be trained on our products, industry and sales processes. We have a month-long sales training and onboarding program to make sure you are set up for success. You will be supported by a dedicated sales coach and a buddy, as well as your team leader, who will coach and motivate you to achieve your professional goals.

We know that an attractive compensation package is a key motivator in sales. SiteMinder offers you not only this, but also a working environment that represents ambition, collaboration, self-development and customer-centricity. If you identify with our core values (We Hustle, We Come Together, We Grow, We Make Things Simple) and you are a sales hunter at heart, we want to hear from you!
